jobs.title: Procurement Account Lead
jobs.description:
Be a part of a revolutionary change.

At Swedish Match, we’ve chosen to do something incredible. We’re totally transforming our business and building our future on one clear purpose – to deliver a smoke-free future. Swedish Match is an affiliate of PMI and have been a leader in the industry for more than 200 years.

With huge change comes huge opportunity. So, wherever you join us, you’ll enjoy the freedom to dream up and deliver better, brighter solutions and the space to move your career forward in endlessly different directions.

In the Nordic region, we are 1,600 employees based in Sweden, Denmark, Finland and Norway working in various functions and teams, and together we are collaborating to deliver a smoke-free Nordics.

Bring us your curiosity and a desire to challenge the everyday, and we’ll give you lots of responsibility. You’ll help us improve, inject innovation, and create new ways of working.

We are now recruiting for a new Procurement Account Lead to join our outstanding Indirect Materials and Services (IM&S) Procurement team, to be based in Stockholm!

Your purpose –

As Procurement Account Lead, you will manage assigned categories as a leader and a strategic point of reference with a commercially focused and customer-centric approach. By providing proactive procurement expertise you will assure, protect and bring value to PMI, at the same time you will collaborate daily with a variety of functional partners to build and deliver plans that meet market needs. You will also play a key role in ensuring the procurement organisation delivers an adaptable and agile partnership that delivers an optimum mix 'product availability-quality-service level-price'.

Your ‘day to day’ –

    Stakeholder Engagement & Customer Centricity: Meet regularly with business partners to build collaborative relationships and to understand their needs and objectives. Align local, regional and global sourcing plans and influence collaborators to deploy global or regional initiatives locally.
    Industry, Market and Supplier Strategy: Apply industry knowledge to regularly benchmark and anticipate business needs for sourcing strategies.
    Demand Management and Sourcing Plans: Translate business requirements into actionable plans by capturing potential long-term opportunities and mitigating risks. Contribute to PMI’s regional and local strategy definition and include global and regional sourcing strategies in local plans.
    Negotiation & Partnership: Master tools to coordinate and steer negotiations and proactively build levers. Align with partners on expected outcomes and foster cross-functional collaboration to implement efficient initiatives like offshoring, outsourcing and process optimization.
    Contractual Framework: Monitor legal templates to encompass local legislative requirements, Business’ needs, IP rights, RSP Principals, company protection and exclusivity clauses. Advise colleagues and internal stakeholders on the impact of relevant clauses for contracting.
    Supplier Relationship Management (SRM): Segment the supply base and establish different types of supplier relationships based on defined criteria. Link supplier capabilities and local business and procurement objectives. Work with key suppliers on value creation and risk reduction initiatives.
    Procurement model & Compliance: Contribute to the Procure-to-Pay process: understand how different functional processes interact with each other and recommend relevant improvements; put in place key control measures and relevant targets to assure Procurement process compliance and efficiency at market/cluster level.



Who we’re looking for -

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds who bring leadership, innovation, and a growth mindset. You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

    A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, or a related field
    5+ years of experience in procurement sourcing, preferably across Sales & Marketing categories
    Validated experience in Supplier Relationship Management, and evidence of developing beneficial relationships
    Demonstrated experience of delivering proactive and strategic procurement support to partners
    Strong financial and commercial awareness
    Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
    A collaborative, inclusive working style and a passion for achieving excellence together
    Strong work ethic and a self-starter who is comfortable working both as part of a team, as well and acting with autonomy to consistently deliver excellence



What we offer:

Our success depends on the people who come to work every single day with a sense of purpose and an appetite for progress. Join Swedish Match and you too can:

    Seize the freedom to define your future and ours. We’ll empower you to do things differently, experiment and explore.
    Be part of an inclusive, diverse culture, where everyone’s contribution is respected; collaborate with some of the world’s best people and feel like you belong.
    Enjoy flexibility of hybrid way of working - split your time between working from our office or the comfort of your home, where it works best for you in line with business needs.
    Pursue your ambitions and develop your skills with a global business – our staggering size and scale provides endless opportunities to progress.
    Take pride in delivering our promise to society: to create a smoke free future.

jobs.title: 2 Butiksslagtere - nathold
jobs.description:
Himmerlandskød er en dansk, familieejet fødevarevirksomhed med eget slagteri, opskæring og forædling af dansk okse- og kalvekød i Himmerland.

Fordelt på to lokationer i Himmerland, i henholdsvis Aalestrup og Farsø, beskæftiger vi +250 medarbejdere.

I Farsø udbener og videreforarbejder vi det kød, der er slagtet på vores eget slagteri i Aalestrup. Vi søger lige nu to butiksslagtere til natholdet på vores hakkekødslinjer. Stillingerne er fuldtid på 34 timer om ugen og aflønnes på timeløn. Der ydes desuden 3 timers natkompensation.

Arbejdstiden er 21.30–05.00, søndag til torsdag.

Som medarbejder på vores hakkekødslinjer er du med til at sikre, at produktkvaliteten er i orden, samt at gældende krav til hygiejne og fødevaresikkerhed overholdes.

Forventninger til vores nye kollega:

  • Du er uddannet butiksslagter eller har erfaring med produktion af hakkekød
  • Du er grundig, præcis og selvkørende, og du kan holde overblikket, selv når det går stærkt.
  • Du er mødestabil.
  • Du taler og forstår dansk eller engelsk.
  • Du er fleksibel og ansvarsbevidst.

Ansøgning og kontakt:

Hvis du kan se dig selv i en af ovenstående stillinger og har lyst til at sikre dig en fremtid i en spændende dansk fødevarevirksomhed, så send din ansøgning til: job@himmerlandskoed.dk.

Ved spørgsmål er du velkommen til at kontakte produktionschef Robert Svanholm på tlf. 21 68 79 50

Opbevaring af din ansøgning:

I forbindelse med at du søger job hos Himmerlandskød, registreres din ansøgning og dine data. Din ansøgning bliver brugt til at vurdere, om vi nu eller på et senere tidspunkt kan tilbyde dig et job. Dine personlige oplysninger bliver naturligvis behandlet fortroligt. Vi sletter dine personoplysninger, når ansøgningsrunden er afsluttet (efter maks. 6 måneder).

jobs.title: Junior CNC Machinist / CNC Operator
jobs.description:
Start your CNC career with a modern manufacturing company.

 

EasyPartz is looking for a motivated Junior CNC Machinist / CNC Operator who wants to build a long-term career in precision manufacturing.

You will become part of an experienced machining team and develop your skills through daily hands-on work, practical shop-floor learning, and mentorship from experienced CNC machinists. We are looking for people who enjoy practical work, take pride in producing high-quality components, and are eager to continuously develop their technical skills.

International candidates are welcome. For qualified applicants, EasyPartz can support the Danish work permit and visa application process where applicable.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Operate CNC milling and turning machines under the guidance of experienced machinists.

  • Assist with machine setup, tooling, and workholding.

  • Read and interpret technical drawings and manufacturing instructions.

  • Perform in-process and final measurements using inspection equipment.

  • Monitor machining operations and report deviations.

  • Maintain a clean, safe, and well-organized workplace in accordance with 5S principles.

  • Follow company procedures for quality, safety, and production reporting.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement and efficient workshop operations.

 

Requirements

We are looking for candidates who have:

  • Vocational education or practical experience in CNC machining, machining technology, metalworking, or a related mechanical field.

  • Basic understanding of CNC machining principles and manufacturing processes.

  • Ability to read technical drawings and use standard measuring equipment, or the willingness to develop these skills quickly.

  • Good mechanical aptitude and attention to detail.

  • A responsible attitude towards quality, safety, and teamwork.

  • English communication skills sufficient to work effectively in an international production environment.

  • Motivation to relocate to Denmark and build a long-term career with EasyPartz.

Experience with CNC milling, CNC turning, Fusion 360, Fanuc, Haas, or robotic machine tending is considered an advantage but is not required.

 

What We Offer

  • Permanent full-time employment.

  • Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.

  • Pension and private health insurance.

  • Mentorship from experienced CNC machinists.

  • Modern CNC machines and manufacturing technologies.

  • A clean, well-organized, and safety-focused production environment.

  • Opportunities for professional growth and career progression within the company.

  • Support with relocation and Danish work permit processes for qualified international candidates.

 

About EasyPartz

EasyPartz is a growing Danish precision machining company located in Søborg, just outside Copenhagen. We specialize in CNC milling and turning, producing high-quality precision components for customers across Europe in industries where quality, precision, and reliability are essential.

We are building a digitally driven manufacturing environment, continuously investing in CNC technology, automation, robotics, and digital production systems. By combining skilled craftsmanship with modern manufacturing technologies and Lean principles, we are creating a workplace focused on innovation, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

We believe that our people are our greatest asset. Whether you are starting your career or expanding your experience, you will work alongside skilled professionals in a collaborative environment where learning, responsibility, and continuous development are part of everyday work.

 

Apply

Please send us:

  • Your CV

  • A short introduction about yourself

  • Information about your education and machining experience

Applications are reviewed continuously, and the position will be filled as soon as the right candidate is found.

jobs.title: Professor / Associate Professor in Biomedical Innovation
jobs.description:
The Department of Biomedicine at Faculty of Health Sciences at Aarhus University invites applications for a position as Professor / Associate Professor per 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is a full-time permanent position.

This initiative is a direct extension of Aarhus University’s Strategy 2030, in which research-based innovation and entrepreneurship are central strategic priorities. To strengthen the university’s capacity to translate research into innovation, the university leadership has established a number of new research and innovation positions across Aarhus University. These positions are intended to foster an innovation mindset throughout the university while generating tangible societal impact through research, innovation, entrepreneurship, and collaboration.

The primary focus for this position is research-based innovation. We are looking for scientists with medical research background who sees opportunities in collaboration with the strong existing research groups at Aarhus University and Aarhus University Hospital and leading international institutions.

About the Department
The Department of Biomedicine provides research-based teaching of the highest quality and is responsible for a large part of the medical degree programme. The department employs approx. 600 people from all over the world, and they make use of the department's modern laboratory, core and animal facilities. The Department of Biomedicine focuses on innovation and entrepreneurship. You can read more about the department here and about the faculty here.

Your job responsibilities as Professor / Associate Professor
We offer an attractive career opportunity for researchers with a strong track record in medical research and innovation. The successful candidate is expected to:

  • strengthen the department’s research, innovation, and research-based teaching, and contribute to the academic development of Aarhus University and its national and international profile.

  • conduct original, internationally recognized research and demonstrate scientific excellence at the highest international level.

  • have experience with commercialization of research and technology including protection of intellectual property (IP) rights.

  • contribute to the Faculty of Health Sciences’ strategic priorities in innovation and collaboration by supporting the commercialization of research, building innovation capacity, and developing collaborations with external partners.

  • actively engage in Aarhus University’s innovation and entrepreneurship ecosystem and contribute to translating research into societal impact through innovation, entrepreneurship, spinouts, and collaborations with industry.

  • contribute to academic citizenship by actively engaging in the department's academic community and fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and respectful working environment.


An attractive start package can be negotiated.

You will report to the Head of Department Thomas G. Jensen.

Your competences as Professor / Associate Professor
You are ready to take co-responsibility for the development of the department's activites and for ensuring that we maintain a good work environment. You naturally involve yourself in interdisciplinary collaboration at departmental, faculty and university level as well as nationally and internationally. As a leader, you inspire others and build strong relationships with students, colleagues and partners.

We expect you to be fluent in oral and written English. International applicants are expected to learn Danish.

In the assessment of the candidates, consideration will be given to:

  • the ability to promote and utilize research results

  • experience with innovation activities

  • the ability to contribute to the development of internal and external cooperation

  • track record in attracting funding

  • visions within the research and innovation area

  • track record for commercialisation of research results, including protection of intellectual property

  • track record for fostering collaboration with industry

  • business development

  • experience and insight to the Danish life science industry

  • patenting, licensing and technology transfers

  • visions within the innovation area


In order to be assessed as qualified for a Professor position, you must meet these academic criteria.

In order to be assessed as qualified for an Associate Professor position, you must meet these academic criteria.

If you wish to apply for both positions, please submit two separate applications.

Shortlisting will be used.

Questions about the position
If you have any questions about the position, please contact Head of Department Thomas G. Jensen tel.: (+45) 2778 2805.

Your place of work will be the Department of Biomedicine, Høegh-Guldbergs Gade 10, DK-8000 Aarhus C, Denmark.

We expect to conduct interviews in the beginning of November 2026.

Terms of employment - professor

  • In making the appointment, emphasis will be placed on a high degree of original production at an international level and experience from teaching at different levels as well as contributions to the development of teaching activities and teaching material, hereby documenting that the applicant has developed the academic discipline from a research and teaching perspective.

  • Moreover, there will be an assessment of the applicant’s ability to perform research and teaching management tasks.

  • The yearly base salary for a fulltime professor is DKK 866.461,38 (including a position related supplement, a pre-agreed professor supplement and pension (18.07%)). Additional supplement(s) can be negotiated dependent on experience, special qualifications and performance of special functions. Professors have the authority to negotiate pay on their own behalf.



Terms of employment – associate professor

  • Appointment as an associate professor requires research and teaching qualifications at the level that can be achieved through the satisfactory completion of a period of appointment as an assistant professor, but may also be obtained in other ways.

  • The applicant is required to have completed a university pedagogical programme or an equivalent programme.

  • The yearly base salary for a fulltime associate professor is DKK 706.233,06 (including a position related supplement, a pre-agreed associate professor supplememt and pension (18.07%)). Additional supplement(s) can be negotiated dependent on experience, special qualifications and performance of special functions. Authorisation supplement(s) will be granted, if relevant for the position. Your local eligible trade union representative at Aarhus University negotiates your salary on your behalf.



Other terms of employment

  • Further information on the appointment procedure can be found in the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

  • The appointment is in accordance with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (Akademikerne).

  • Remuneration is in accordance with the above, and the Salary agreement catalogue for staff at Health.

  • Researchers recruited from abroad are offered a special researcher tax scheme with a lower tax rate.

  • Travel and moving expenses may be covered according to the employee in question and, to a limited extent, the accompanying family.

  • Further information on qualification requirements and job description can be found in the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.



Application - professor
Your application must include the following:

  • Motivated application

  • Curriculum Vitae

  • Diploma

  • Template for applicant - professor

  • A list of publications

  • A teaching portfolio. We refer to Guideline on the use of teaching portfolios

  • The ten publications stated as the most important in the 'Template for applicant - professor' must be submitted

  • Research plan, which is part of the 'Template to applicant - professor' can be uploaded separately (optional)

  • Coauthor statement(s) can be uploaded (optional)

  • References/recommendations can be uploaded separately in the e-recruitment system (optional)



Application – associate professor
Your application must include the following:

  • Motivated application

  • Curriculum Vitae

  • Diploma

  • Template for applicant - associate professor

  • A list of publications

  • A teaching portfolio. We refer to Guideline on the use of teaching portfolios

  • The five publications stated as the most important in the 'Template for applicant - associate professor' must be submitted

  • Research plan, which is part of the 'Template to applicant - associate professor' can be uploaded separately (optional)

  • Coauthor statement(s) can be uploaded (optional)

  • References/recommendations can be uploaded separately in the e-recruitment system (optional)


We refer to the faculty’s Guidelines for applicants.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

International applicant?
Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including assistance with relocation and career counselling to expat partners. Please find more information about the International Staff Office and the range of services here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

jobs.title: Vehicle Technician wanted for Arctic Campers fleet - Kvaløya
jobs.description:
🚐 Vehicle Technician / Fleet Maintenance Agent

Arctic Campers AS -- Kvaloya

Arctic Campers AS is looking for a skilled and versatile Vehicle Technician / Fleet Maintenance Agent to join our team in Tromso, Kvaloya.

You will play a key role in maintaining and preparing our fleet of camper vans to ensure they meet the highest standards of reliability, safety, and quality.

This is a hands-on position combining mechanical maintenance, vehicle systems work, tyre management, and camper van conversions.

🔧 Responsibilities

As part of the fleet team, you will be responsible for:

  • Maintenance, servicing, and repair of company vehicles and camper vans

  • Mechanical work including engines, transmissions, wheel assemblies, and related components.

  • Managing the tyre system together with the Fleet Manager, including:

    • Inspection schedules

    • Replacement planning

    • Seasonal tyre management

  • Diagnosing and repairing vehicle or camper vans electrical systems

  • Working with auxiliary batteries, electrical installations, and gas systems

  • Supporting camper van conversion and modification projects

  • Preparing and fitting new vans for operational use

  • Ensuring vehicles meet company quality and safety standards

  • Collaborating closely with the Fleet Manager on maintenance planning and repairs

✅ Qualifications

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has experience in vehicle mechanics or automotive maintenance

  • Is comfortable working on mechanical, electrical, and technical vehicle systems

  • Has experience with diagnostics and troubleshooting

  • Is organized and capable of managing maintenance schedules

  • Is practical, adaptable, and solution-oriented

  • Can work independently while coordinating with the fleet manager

  • Has a valid driving licence

Experience with camper vans, RV systems, auxiliary electrical systems, or gas installations is a strong advantage.

🌍 What We Offer

  • A dynamic work environment in a growing camper van rental company

  • Hands-on work with modern camper vans and vehicle systems

  • Opportunities to participate in vehicle builds and conversions

  • A small and flexible team with high responsibility and autonomy


    📩 Apply by sending your CV and a short introduction to:

    work@arcticcampers.no

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Arctic Campers is Norway's largest camper van rental company, offering 200 camper vans across two locations: Oslo and Tromsø. With over 10 years of experience, we specialize in helping tourists explore and enjoy the stunning Norwegian nature. Our goal is to provide unforgettable adventures, giving you the freedom to discover Norway at your own pace.

jobs.title: Front desk agent - Your summer & autumn job with a view from Kvaløya
jobs.description:
🌞 Join Our Summer & Autumn2026 Team in Tromsø!

Are you energetic, positive, and ready for an exciting summer experience in Tromsø?

We are now building our Summer 2026 team and looking for motivated people who enjoy working in a dynamic environment with great colleagues and happy customers.

About the Position -- Front Desk Agent

As a Front Desk Agent, you will be responsible for managing the customer pickup experience and ensuring a smooth and professional handover of our rental vehicles (camper vans and RVs).

This includes welcoming customers at the front desk, completing rental documentation, explaining vehicle features, and conducting handovers both inside the office and outside at the vehicle.

You will also be responsible for:

  • Keeping the front office tidy, organized, and presentable at all times

  • Handling phone inquiries and customer communication

  • Coordinating bookings and vehicle pickups

  • Organizing airport pickups when required

This job can be highly rewarding and at the same time very busy. The right candidate should be service-minded, structured, and able to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment. You should be confident working independently while also supporting the operational team when needed.

We offer several onboarding timelines throughout the season. While the first start date is 04/05, it is possible to begin later depending on availability and operational needs. Please indicate your preferred start period in your application.

The working language of the company is English. Norwegian is not compulsory.

Your Tasks as a Front Desk Agent

  • Welcoming customers and managing the vehicle pickup process

  • Explaining rental terms and vehicle functions

  • Handling payments, deposits, and rental documentation

  • Answering phone calls and customer inquiries

  • Coordinating vehicle pickups and returns

  • Organizing airport pickups when required

  • Keeping the front office clean, tidy, and organized

  • Supporting operational tasks when needed (vehicle preparation, basic inspection, reporting issues)

We Are Looking For Someone Who:

  • Is service-minded and positive

  • Has strong communication skills

  • Is structured and organized

  • Works well independently and in a team

  • Handles busy periods with a calm and professional attitude

  • Is punctual and reliable

  • Holds a Driver Licence B (appreciated)

  • Masters additional languages such as French, German, Spanish, or Italian (strongly appreciated)

What We Offer

  • Work with a fun and interactive team

  • Great opportunities to grow and develop with the team

  • Award wage payment (Norwegian "tarif" payment)

  • Work wear provided

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Arctic Campers is Norway's largest camper van rental company, offering 200 camper vans across two locations: Oslo and Tromsø. With over 10 years of experience, we specialize in helping tourists explore and enjoy the stunning Norwegian nature. Our goal is to provide unforgettable adventures, giving you the freedom to discover Norway at your own pace.

jobs.title: Field agent - Your summer job with a view from Kvaløya
jobs.description:
🌞 Join Our Summer 2026 Team in Tromsø!

Are you practical, solution-oriented, and ready for an exciting summer experience in Tromsø?

We are now building our Summer & Autumn 2026 team and looking for motivated people who enjoy working in a dynamic environment with great colleagues and happy customers.

About the Position -- Field Agent

As a Field Agent, you will be responsible for preparing rental vehicles (camper vans and RVs) for customer use and ensuring they meet company standards and are road-safe at all times.

This includes carrying out thorough inspections, completing vehicle check-outs upon return, and handling the necessary administrative follow-up.

You will also be responsible for:

  • Performing minor repairs and general maintenance tasks

  • Ensuring the fleet remains in good working condition

  • Identifying and reporting technical or safety issues

  • Taking appropriate action within your scope of responsibility

Typical technical tasks may include tyre changes, brake pad replacement, and simple bodywork repairs.

This job can be highly rewarding and at the same time physically demanding and busy. jobs.title: Liikuntakoutsi
jobs.description:
Kuhmo on Suomen metsäkeskeisin kaupunki, joka on tunnettu korkeatasoisesta musiikki- ja kirjallisuuskulttuurista, erityisesti kamarimusiikista ja Kalevalasta sekä yhteisöllisestä elämäntavasta, jossa arvostetaan hyvän jakamista, osaamista ja laatua. Kuhmo - täyttä elämää metsän ja kulttuurin valtakunnassa!

Kuhmon kaupungin kasvun ja oppimisen palvelualueella on haettavana määräaikainen liikuntakoutsin työtehtävä Tuupalan yhtenäiskoulussa ajalla 10.8.2026 - 30.6.2027. Työ voi alkaa sopimuksen mukaan myös myöhemmin.

Haluatko olla mukana lisäämässä lasten ja nuorten liikettä, hyvinvointia ja osallisuutta? Etsimme innostavaa ja kehittämismyönteistä liikuntakoutsia vahvistamaan Kuhmon perusopetuksen liikunnallista toimintakulttuuria sekä tukemaan lasten ja nuorten aktiivista elämäntapaa. Tehtävässä pääset kehittämään uusia toimintamalleja ja rakentamaan pysyviä käytäntöjä lasten ja nuorten hyvinvoinnin tukemiseksi yhdessä koulun oppilaiden, aikuisten ja muiden toimijoiden kanssa.

Liikuntakoutsin työtehtävät pitävät sisällään esim.
liikunnallisen toimintakulttuurin kehittäminen yhdessä Liikkuva koulu -tiimin ja koulun henkilökunnan kanssa
välituntitoiminnan organisoimista, välkkäritoimintaa sekä muita oppilaiden osallisuutta vahvistavien toimintamallien kehittämistä
liikunnallisten tapahtumien ja kampanjoiden järjestäminen yhdessä muiden toimijoiden kanssa
liikuntatietoisiin opetus- ja toimintatapoihin ohjaamista ja kannustamista
oppituntien taukojumppaa
vähän liikkuville lapsille ja nuorille suunnattujen liikunta- ja hyvinvointitoimien suunnittelua ja toteuttamista
Move!-prosessin kehittämiseen osallistuminen
Tuupalan yhtenäiskoulun liikunnallisen vuosikellon ideointi yhdessä koulun oppilaiden, aikuisten ja muiden toimijoiden kanssa
osallistuminen hankkeen seurantaan, arviointiin ja raportointiin.

Edellytämme tehtävään soveltuvaa koulutusta, kuten liikunta-, kasvatus-, terveys- tai hyvinvointialan ammatillinen tai korkeakoulututkinto tai muu soveltuva koulutus. Työaika on 38,25h/vko ja palkkaus on KVTES:n mukainen tasopalkka 2 612,32 € kuukaudessa. Työsuhteen koeaika on pituudeltaan puolet palvelussuhteen kestosta.

Tehtävään valitun on toimitettava nähtäväksi hyväksytty lääkärintodistus terveydentilastaan sekä lasten ja nuorten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (504/2002) mukainen voimassa oleva rikosrekisteriote 30 päivän kuluessa valintapäätöksen tiedoksisaannista.

Odotamme sinulta kokemusta lasten ja nuorten liikunnan, kasvatuksen tai ohjaustoiminnan parista. Arvostamme intoa ja halua kehittää uutta, oma-aloitteista ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta sekä organisointitaitoja. Hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja kyky toimia yhteistyössä eri-ikäisten lasten, nuorten ja aikuisten kanssa on työssä onnistumisen kannalta tärkeää. Toivomme sinulta myös innostunutta ja kannustavaa asennetta liikunnallisen elämäntavan edistämiseen ja kykyä kohdata lempeästi ja kannustavasti erilaiset liikkujat. Perusosaaminen tietojärjestelmien (mm. MS Office, Teams, Wilma, Webropol) käytöstä auttaa tehtävän hoitamisessa.

Tuupalan yhtenäiskoulussa opiskelee lukuvuonna 2026-27 n. 450 oppilasta vuosiluokilla 1-9. Tarjoamme sinulle merkityksellisen ja monipuolisen työn kuhmolaisten lasten ja nuorten hyvinvoinnin edistämiseksi. Saat mahdollisuuden kehittää uusia toimintamalleja ja vaikuttaa koko koulun liikunnalliseen toimintakulttuuriin. Saat työssäsi mahdollisuuden hyödyntää omaa asiantuntemustasi ja kehittää ammattitaitoasi. Työyhteisön tuki ja yhteistyöverkostot auttavat sinua tehtävän menestyksellisessä hoitamisessa.

Mielenkiintoisen työn lisäksi Kuhmo tarjoaa monipuoliset harrastusmahdollisuudet, upean luonnon ja rauhoittavan elämänrytmin. Kaikki palvelut ovat kävelymatkan päässä toisistaan. Henkilöstöetuna tarjoamme mm. E-passin.

Tervetuloa mukaan rakentamaan liikkuvampaa, aktiivisempaa, osallistavampaa ja yhdenvertaisempaa arkea kuhmolaisille lapsille ja nuorille!

Tehtävään haetaan Kuntarekry.fi-palvelun kautta osoitteessa www.kuntarekry.fi. Hakuaika päättyy keskiviikkona 5.8.2026 klo 15.00. Haastattelut voidaan aloittaa jo hakuaikana.

Hakemukseen on liitettävä kelpoisuuden osoittavat todistukset ja cv. Alkuperäiset todistukset esitetään haastattelussa tai muulla sovittavalla tavalla.

jobs.title: Vice President Field Services
jobs.description:
Who we areâ¦

Verra Mobility is a global leader in smart mobility. We develop technology-enabled solutions that help the world move safely and easily. We are fostering the development of safe cities, working with police departments and municipalities to install over 10,000 red-light, speed, and school bus stop arm safety cameras across North America. We are also creating smart roadways, serving the world's largest commercial fleets and rental car companies to manage tolling transactions and violations for over 8.5 million vehicles. And we are a leading provider of connected systems, processing nearly 165 million transactions each year across 50+ individual tolling authorities.

â¯

What you'll be doingâ¦

As Vice President, Field Services, you will be a visionary and strategic leader responsible for orchestrating the success of our North American Field Services organization. You will oversee regional field operations, the Remote Technical Support Team (Command Center) department, Fleet Management, driving operational excellence, innovation, and scalability across a complex network of internal teams and third-party partners. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of field services, balancing long-term strategy with hands-on execution. Your leadership will be essential in transforming operations through data-driven decision-making, continuous improvement, and a relentless focus on customer experience and cost control.

â¯

  • Lead and evolve the Field Services organization, including internal teams and third-party vendors, to deliver consistent, high-quality service across the U.S. and Canada.
  • Oversee Command Center operations to ensure real-time monitoring, incident response, problem management, and service continuity.
  • Direct Fleet Management strategy, optimizing asset utilization, maintenance, and lifecycle planning.
  • Manage multiple operational P&Ls, including forecasting, budgeting, and performance tracking.
  • Champion a customer-focused culture and lead change management initiatives that align with enterprise goals.
  • Develop and execute strategic plans across people, processes, and technology to support growth and scalability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and resolve operational challenges, improve service delivery, and enhance field technician support.
  • Apply continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean and Six Sigma to streamline processes and reduce defects.
  • Monitor key performance indicators and use data analytics to drive decision-making and operational enhancements.
  • Represent Field Services in executive forums, contributing to enterprise-wide strategy and planning.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What we're looking forâ¦

You are a visionary and strategic leader with a proven ability to scale and transform complex operations while driving service excellence across diverse teams and geographies. You bring a strong command of operational strategy, financial acumen, and performance management, paired with a deep understanding of field services, command center operations, and fleet management. Your communication skills enable you to influence and align stakeholders at all levels, while your analytical mindset supports data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement. You thrive in dynamic environments, lead through change with confidence, and foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and customer focus.



You'll need to have:

  • BS/BA degree required
  • 7+ years of experience leading Field Services operations
  • 7+ years of experience leading Remote Technical Support (Command Center) operations
  • 2+ years of experience leading Fleet Management operations
  • Experience leading geographically dispersed teams across North America or globally.
  • Demonstrated success leading enterprise-wide initiatives at the executive level, including demonstrated skills ranging from work direction, motivation, coaching/feedback, and developing assigned staff with the expected outcome of consistently positive client experience and SLA attainment.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, ability to take the initiative, use good judgment, demonstrate a strong sense of urgency and follow-up, and carry multiple projects through to completion.
  • Qualified candidates will possess exceptional statistical/analytical skills, exemplary problem-solving abilities, and show initiative to get ahead of potential out-of-compliance processes .
  • Proven track record of building and maintaining good internal and external working relationships.
  • Demonstrated business process engineering/re-engineering experience using Six Sigma, Lean, or other formal process improvement methodology.
  • Excellent verbal/written communication and presentation skills, including a collaborative management style.

â¯

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

  • MBA or Master's in Operations Management, Engineering, Supply Chain, or related field.
  • Lean Six Sigma Training and Certification (Green belt or Black belt)
  • PMP (Project Management Professional)
  • ITIL4 Certification
  • Experience in the photo enforcement industry

â¯

Where you'll be workingâ¦



In this remote role, you'll have the flexibility to work from home full-time, allowing you to create an optimal work environment. You'll also have regular check-ins and team meetings scheduled through virtual platforms to ensure collaboration and support. This role requires up to 50% travel across North America to engage with teams, oversee operations, and support strategic initiatives.

Aligned with Verra Mobility Values

  • Do What's Right â We've committed to doing the right thing for each other and for our customers â integrity is our DNA
  • Lead With Grace â We embrace the importance of our colleagues and customers and always treat them with kindness and grace.
  • Own It â We foster a culture of accountability and excellence, where going the extra mile is standard practice.
  • Win Together â We are ambitious and like to win, but we know we win more when we include others and work together.



Verra Mobility Values



An ideal candidate for this role naturally works in alignment with the Verra Mobility Core Values:

  • Own It. We focus on high performance and drive toward breakthrough outcomes. Our employees ensure accountability, optimize and align work, focus on the customer, and cultivate innovation.
  • Do What's Right. We champion integrity and good character. Our team members model ethical behavior, demonstrate good judgment and are courageous.
  • Choose Courage Over Comfort. We lean into the conversations, decisions and actions that move the business forward, even when they feel uncomfortable. We challenge assumptions, address issues early and prioritize progress over ease.
  • Win Together. We believe in growing and inspiring people together. We seek people who collaborate, value differences, think and act globally, foster an engaging work environment, and recognize and develop others.

In no event will we retain such data more than two (2) years following the closure of the recruitment process relating to the role for which you applied or in the event other related job opportunities arise within the company. jobs.description:
Máš rád pohyb, silový tréning a chceš pomáhať ľuďom zbaviť sa bolesti a zlepšiť kvalitu života? Nezáleží na tom, či už si skúsený tréner alebo len stojíš na začiatku svojej cesty. Ak máš správny prístup, chuť učiť sa a pracovať na sebe, radi ti pomôžeme vyrásť. V Bratislave – Rači otvárame nové prémiové tréningové centrum ATG Slovakia s rozlohou 562 m2, postavené na princípoch funkčného silového tréningu, dlhovekosti kĺbov a pohybu bez bolesti. Naším cieľom je vytvoriť miesto, ktoré spája výhody -vedenie a usmerňovanie klientov počas semi-privátnych tréningov, -dohľad nad správnou technikou cvičenia, -vedenie individuálnych (1-on-1) tréningov, -pomoc pri každodennom fungovaní centra, -podieľanie sa na rozvoji ATG Slovakia podľa svojich silných stránok. Neočakávame desiatky certifikátov ani dlhoročnú prax. Omnoho viac si ceníme charakter, pracovnú morálku a ochotu napredovať. Ideálny kandidát: má úprimný záujem pomáhať ľuďom zlepšovať ich zdravie, pohyb a výkon, šport je prirodzenou súčasťou jeho života a má vlastné tréningové skúsenosti, chce sa neustále vzdelávať a profesijne rásť, je spoľahlivý, disciplinovaný a vie fungovať v tíme, nebojí sa prevziať zodpovednosť a prispieť k budovaniu výnimočného projektu.
Výhody:Školenie prácu v úplne novom prémiovom centre s viac ako 400 m2 tréningovej plochy, špeciálne ATG vybavenie, centrálnu trávnatú zónu a moderné silové stanovištia, priame mentorstvo od ATG Level 3 trénera, systematické vzdelávanie a možnosť získať jedinečné know-how, účasť na odborných seminároch doma aj v zahraničí, spoluprácu s európskym centrom ATG Europe možnosť dlhodobého kariérneho rastu,

jobs.title: Strojárski technici
jobs.description:
Kandidát na túto pozíciu musí mať priame skúsenosti s obsluhou, riadením, kontrolou a optimalizáciou technologických procesov čistenia odpadových vôd vrátane spracovania kalov a prevádzky technologických zariadení v súlade s prevádzkovým poriadkom ČOV.

Súčasťou tejto práce je taktiež:

Pravidelná technická údržba, čistenie a nastavovanie strojnotechnologických zariadení ČOV, odstraňovanie bežných prevádzkových porúch a spolupráca s externými servisnými technikmi.

Sledovanie a dopĺňanie chemikálií a prevádzkových médií potrebných pre plynulý chod ČOV, bezpečné nakladanie s chemickými látkami.

Zabezpečovanie a výkon odborných činností v oblasti ochrany životného prostredia (vodné hospodárstvo, čistenie odpadových vôd, nakladanie s odpadmi, ochrana ovzdušia).

Monitorovanie a vyhodnocovanie kvality odpadových vôd, účinnosti čistenia a technologických ukazovateľov; vedenie evidencie a spracovanie pravidelných hlásení pre úrady a interné potreby.

Sledovanie a hodnotenie environmentálnych aspektov a rizík vyplývajúcich z výroby a návrh opatrení na ich minimalizáciu.

jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti sociálnej práce a poradenstva
jobs.description:
Sme tím ľudí, ktorí sa na ulicu pozerajú inými očami a veria, že aj malé kroky môžu prinášať veľké zmeny. Do nášho nízkoprahového denného centra pre ľudí bez domova hľadáme inštruktora/ku sociálnej rehabilitácie, ktorý/á bude mať na starosti: - Individuálnu a skupinovú sociálnu rehabilitácia, so zameraním na rozvoj praktických, sociálnych a pracovných zručností, ktoré podporia klientov k samostatnosti, nezávislosti a sebestačnosti - Poskytovanie podpory a motivácie v procese minimalizácie rizík v životnej situácii klienta, posilňovanie zodpovednosti, sebavedomia a dôvery vo vlastné schopnosti. - Prípravu a realizáciu voľnočasových aktivít a praktických tréningov pre klientov. - Vedenie a vyhodnocovanie personalizovaných rehabilitačných plánov klientov sociálnej služby. - Úzku spoluprácu so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, odbornými zamestnancami a ďalšími členmi tímu. Rozvrh pracovného času: Práca je rozvrhnutá na 40h týždenne od pondelka do piatka s pružným pracovným časom. Kto sme? Naša sociálna práca stojí na princípoch nízkoprahového prístupu a harm reduction – snažíme sa byť čo najbližšie k človeku, jeho možnostiam a realite života na ulici. Služba je dostupná pre každého bez rozdielov – aj pre ľudí bez dokladov, bez finančných prostriedkov či pod vplyvom návykových látok. Každého prijímame bez hodnotenia, vytvárame bezpečný priestor a budujeme dôveru, ktorá umožňuje postupné sprevádzanie k zmene v tempe, ktoré je pre človeka v danej situácii zvládnuteľné.
Výhody:1200 - 1350 EUR mesiac V prípade dosiahnutého VŠ vzdelania v určených odboroch mzda 1250 EUR brutto a s min. ročnou skúsenosťou 1350 EUR brutto . V prípade absolvovaného akreditovaného kurzu mzda 1200 EUR brutto a s min. ročnou skúsenosťou 1300 EUR brutto . V našej organizácii Ti ponúkame: - Sickdays zdravotné platené voľno nad rámec dovolenky - dovolenka navyše za odpracované roky - MultiSport karta s príspevkom zamestnávateľa - pravidelné skupinové aj individuálne supervízie, praktické školenia počas roka - 20percent zľava na vybrané predstavenia SND v Bratislave - zvýhodnená celoročná registrácia v Staromestskej knižnici v Bratislave - odmena pri uzatvorení manželstva, narodení dieťaťa, za odpracované roky - zamestnaneckú pôžičku - rekreačný a športový príspevok po 2 rokoch - krátkodobé vypožičania služobného auta na súkromné účely Predovšetkým Ti však ponúkame: - individuálnu a cielenú podporu v rámci procesu zaúčania nového zamestnanca tzv. buddy systém - priestor na vzdelávanie a rozvoj - prácu v podporujúcom a ľudskom kolektíve, ktorá má ZMYSEL - možnosť NAHLIADNUŤ HLBŠIE do života ľudí so skúsenosťou so životom na ulici

jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti stratégie a rozvoja
jobs.description:
Obchod nie je len o predaji. Je o dôvere, vzťahoch a príležitostiach. Do nášho tímu hľadáme človeka, ktorý vie nadväzovať nové kontakty, budovať dlhodobé partnerstvá a hľadá riešenia, ktoré prinášajú spokojnosť klientom aj výsledky spoločnosti. Ak máš obchodného ducha, baví ťa komunikácia a chceš pracovať v prostredí hotelierstva, kongresov a eventov, radi ťa spoznáme. Čo bude tvojou úlohou? - aktívne vyhľadávať nové obchodné príležitosti a získavať nových klientov, - budovať a rozvíjať dlhodobé vzťahy s obchodnými partnermi, - prezentovať hotel a naše služby firemným klientom, agentúram a organizátorom podujatí, - pripravovať obchodné ponuky na mieru a viesť obchodné rokovania, - spolupracovať s jednotlivými oddeleniami hotela pri realizácii podujatí, - sledovať trendy na trhu a prichádzať s novými obchodnými príležitosťami, - podieľať sa na plnení obchodných cieľov a ďalšom rozvoji hotela, - organizovať konferencie, firemné stretnutia, oslavy aj výnimočné eventy.
Výhody:ubytovanie, Prémie 25 percent zo základného platu 1400 €, t.j. do 350 € podľa prémiového poriadku spoločnosti. Štvrťročné odmeny na základe dosiahnutého hospodárskeho výsledku. Čo ponúkame? ✨ Prácu, pri ktorej budeš stretávať zaujímavých ľudí a podieľať sa na realizácii výnimočných podujatí. Okrem toho môžeš očakávať: - stabilné zázemie úspešnej spoločnosti, - motivujúce finančné ohodnotenie vrátane bonusovej zložky, - priestor na vlastnú iniciatívu a realizáciu nápadov, - profesionálny tím, ktorý si navzájom pomáha, - možnosti odborného a kariérneho rastu, - zamestnanecké benefity a zvýhodnené využívanie hotelových služieb, - príjemné pracovné prostredie Prečo práve Kubínska Resorts? Sme Kubínska Resorts – spoločnosť, ktorá zastrešuje tri jedinečné hotely. Každý z nich má svoj charakter, klientelu aj príbehy. Práve preto u nás nezažiješ stereotyp. Jeden deň pripravuješ obchodné stretnutie pre firemnú konferenciu, kongres, ďalší teambuilding či firemnú lyžovačku. Hľadáme človeka, na ktorého sa môžeme spoľahnúť. Obchodný manažér je partnerom nielen našich klientov, ale aj celého tímu. Oceníme zodpovednosť, spoľahlivosť, schopnosť dotiahnuť veci do konca a prirodzený cit pre budovanie dlhodobých vzťahov. Ak si energický, rád komunikuješ, nebojíš sa výziev a baví ťa rozmanitá práca, u nás dostaneš priestor realizovať vlastné nápady, ovplyvňovať obchodné výsledky a byť súčasťou spoločnosti, ktorá sa neustále rozvíja. Nehľadáme len kolegu. Hľadáme človeka, ktorý chce rásť spolu s nami. Ak si sa v tomto opise našiel našla, pošli svoj životopis. Tešíme sa, že sa spoznáme.

Do you want to be part of the energy transition to renewables, or do you see yourself as the cyber guardian? If your response is yes, continue to read our job offer. We are working on all these products and are growing our team!

About the Role

You will drive quality assurance of our tools and platforms. You have an entrepreneurial spirit with a pragmatic, hands-on mindset focused on achieving progress as well as an open-minded, intellectually curious approach to everything you do.

Your responsibilities will be:

Set up and/or coordinate testing activities
Create detailed, comprehensive test plans and test cases
Creating and maintaining tests for the application
Configuring and making sure the automated tests are running properly
Clarifying and discussing with the BA and PO what needs to be tested


About the Team
If tackling complex challenges in a wide range of industries excites you, then join our innovative team, where you are at the forefront of creating new ingenious solutions in a collaborative way.

Our team is an empowered tech counterpart for business units, responsible for the design and implementation of inventive data projects. We develop new analytics capabilities and improve Swiss Re's risk assessment capabilities.

Joining us, you will learn not only how insurance premiums are modelled and how data analytics can enrich business but also improve in stakeholders' management, agile development practices and tools used to drive impactful projects.

Ak v sebe cítiš túto schopnosť, u nás nájdeš miesto, kde ju môžeš naplno využiť.

Hľadáme technicky zdatnú/zdatného a komunikatívnu / komunikatívneho kolegyňu/kolegu, ktorá/ktorý sa nebojí strojov, no rovnako dobre sa cíti aj pri práci s ľuďmi. Na tejto pozícii prepojíte dva svety – vo fľaškovni sa postaráte o bezproblémový chod a nastavenie našej modernej plniacej a etiketovacej linky, zatiaľ čo mimo nej budete sprevádzať turistov a s hrdosťou prezentovať vína Villa Vino Rača zahraničným návštevám v anglickom alebo čínskom jazyku. Ak hľadáte stabilitu a prostredie, kde víno nie je len produkt, ale skutočná vášeň, radi Vás privítame v našom tíme!

Osobnostné predpoklady a zručnosti
•    Technické myslenie a zručnosť (nebojíte sa zobrať do ruky náradie).
•    Zmysel pre detail – neujde vám krivo nalepená etiketa ani neštandardný zvuk motora.
•    Zodpovednosť, dochvíľnosť a schopnosť pracovať samostatne.
•    Komunikatívnosť.
•    Proklientsky prístup.
•    Plynulá znalosť mandarínskej čínštiny a angličtiny (hovorená aj písomná).
•    Kultúrna znalosť čínskych trhov a spotrebiteľských trendov.
•    Fyzická zdatnosť (práca si vyžaduje pohyb a manipuláciu s materiálom).
•    Schopnosť rýchlo sa učiť a zachovať chladnú hlavu pri riešení technických problémov.
•    Vzťah k vínu a úcta k poctivej vinárskej tradícii.

Zamestnanecké výhody, benefity
•    Stabilná práca v renomovanom slovenskom vinárstve s istotou dlhodobého zamestnania.
•    Gastrokarta, ktorá ponúka stravné vo výške 9,30 €/deň (s príspevkom zamestnanca 1,50 €).
•    Kompletné pracovné oblečenie pre letné aj zimné obdobie.
•    Zamestnanecká zľava na naše vína.
•    Práca v priateľskom kolektíve, kde si navzájom pomáhame.
•    Pracovná doba: Pondelok až piatok: 7:00 hod – 15:30 hod (vrátane prestávok na oddych a občerstvenie). Voľné víkendy!
•    Zmluva na 1 rok s automatickým predĺžením na dobu neurčitú.

Vašou každodennou úlohou bude:
•    Nastavovanie a kalibrácia: Príprava a prestavovanie plniacej linky pre rôzne formáty fliaš a typy etikiet.
•    Technický dozor: Riešenie drobných technických porúch a bežná údržba strojového vybavenia.
•    Obsluha a plynulý chod: Zabezpečenie bezproblémového chodu výroby a dohľad nad prácou na linke.
•    Dohľad nad kvalitou: Kontrola fliaš, správneho nasadenia uzáverov a precízneho nalepenia etikiet (aby každá fľaša vyzerala perfektne).
•    Príprava na expedíciu: Balenie hotových produktov do kartónov, ukladanie na palety a práca s paletizačnou technikou.
•    Sanitácia: Udržiavanie čistoty a hygienických štandardov v priestoroch fľaškovne (čistota je u nás na prvom mieste).
•    Reprezentácia a degustácie: Sprevádzanie domácich i zahraničných turistov po vinárstve a odborná prezentácia našich vín v anglickom alebo čínskom jazyku.

jobs.title: Finanční analytici a špecialisti v oblasti finančníctva, poisťovníctva a ostatných finančných služieb
jobs.employer: Swiss Re Europe S.A., organizačná zložka Slovensko
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about supporting the critical work of underwriting and claims within Life and Health insurance? Do you have an eye for detail and a commitment to operational excellence, ensuring that every case is managed efficiently and accurately? Are you eager to contribute to process optimisation and the successful transition toward AI-enabled underwriting practices? If you thrive in providing expert administrative and operational support, collaborating with colleagues across functions and locations, and ensuring high-quality outputs, then this Claims and Underwriting Assistant opportunity could be the perfect next step in your career. Join our UK & Ireland Combined Underwriting & Claims (CUW) team to play a key role in case assessments, reporting, governance, and the delivery of portfolio insights.



About The Role




To act as a senior operational support to the UKI Combined Underwriting & Claims (CUW) function, providing subject-matter expertise, advisory authority, and oversight across case induction/ assessments, AI-enabled underwriting support, reporting, governance, and operational excellence.

The role will support the transition from manual case handling to enhanced AI-supported underwriting processes, while ensuring robust controls, high-quality outputs, and portfolio-level insight delivery. The incumbent will operate as a trusted advisor to CUW team on operational effectiveness, portfolio performance, and process optimisation.



Key Responsibilities




Provide review and advisory input on CUW underwriting cases and claims summaries.
Provide underwriting sign-off on D2C underwriting and claims within authority
Issue non-binding technical recommendations on underwriting positions and risk considerations prior to CUW decision-making.
Escalate material risks, inconsistencies, or governance concerns to CUW leadership.
Define quality standards and oversee case induction and partial CUW outputs.
Act as subject matter advisor on complex cases during the AI transition phase.
Support CUW KPI and portfolio reporting, delivering analysis and trend insights
Strengthen operational controls, user access, and system governance.
Drive automation efforts such as UCR and CCR as well as general operational efficiencies
Drive standardisation and documentation of CUW operational processes.
Support client service pack preparation with analytical commentary and performance insights.


Skills & Experience




Strong underwriting and/or claims knowledge (preferably within UKI or similar markets)
Ability to translate CUW philosophy into technical decisions
Strong Power BI / Excel proficiency.
Proven ability to operate at senior stakeholder level.
Excellent written summarisation skills with high accuracy.
Ability to balance operational detail with strategic perspective.

kŕmenie koní podľa stanovených dávok a režimu,

Práca je fyzicky náročná, vykonáva sa prevažne vonku a vyžaduje si zodpovedný prístup, spoľahlivosť a pozitívny vzťah k zvieratám. Často zahŕňa aj prácu cez víkendy a sviatky.

Job Title: National Account Manager

Location: National (UK)

Salary: Â£50,000-Â£55,000

Company Overview

At Au Vodka, we pride ourselves on being a luxury vodka brand that embodies sophistication, innovation, and craftsmanship. Our premium product range offers a distinctive taste experience, wrapped in a bottle that is as luxurious as the spirit inside. With a strong focus on quality, exclusivity, and premium service, we are growing rapidly in the UK and international markets.

As a brand that truly understands what it means to stand out, we're looking for a passionate and dynamic National Account Manager to drive the next phase of growth and further establish Au Vodka within the wholesale and on-trade sectors.

About Au Vodka

Au Vodka isnât just a drinks brand, itâs a movement.

Born in Wales and recognised globally, weâve redefined what a modern FMCG brand can be. From our iconic gold bottles to boundary-pushing flavours, weâve built a brand that stands out, scales fast, and connects with a new generation of consumers.

Our ambition is bold: to become the first FMCG business founded in Wales to reach a $1 billion valuation.

We think global, move fast, and build category-defining brands from unexpected places.

Already sold across multiple international markets, weâre not just part of the spirits industry, weâre disrupting it.

Role Overview

The National Account Manager will be responsible for managing and growing strategic relationships with the UK's leading national pub companies and key leisure accounts. The primary goal is to secure new business, grow existing partnerships, and maximise distribution, visibility and rate of sale across national managed estates. You will play a pivotal role in strengthening Au Vodka's position within the premium on-trade channel through long-term commercial partnerships.

Key Responsibilities

  • Account Management & Relationship Building
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with national accounts, ensuring exceptional customer service and engagement.
  • Develop a deep understanding of each account's business, challenges, and opportunities to maximise sales and brand visibility.
  • Work closely with national pub companies and leisure partners to maximise distribution, menu presence, activation opportunities and visibility across managed estates.
  • Sales & Revenue Growth
  • Develop and execute sales strategies to drive volume and revenue growth within the national pub company and leisure channel.
  • Achieve agreed sales targets and KPIs across the assigned ledger.
  • Negotiate and secure national listings, ranging agreements, Joint Business Plans (JBPs), and activation plans with national pub companies and key leisure customers.
  • Brand Activation & Marketing
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to deliver tailored activation plans, national campaigns and customer-specific promotions across managed pub estates and leisure venues.
  • Ensure that all accounts are supplied with branded materials, POS, and other tools to elevate the Au Vodka experience in the on-trade environment.
  • Support the creation of tailored promotional campaigns, events, and activations specific to each customer to drive brand awareness and loyalty.
  • Market Intelligence & Reporting
  • Stay ahead of industry trends, market dynamics, and competitor activity to provide valuable insights that influence sales strategy.
  • Monitor sales performance and report on account activity, opportunities, and challenges on a regular basis to senior management.
  • Provide accurate forecasts and pipeline updates to ensure stock levels and availability align with customer demand.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Work closely with the marketing, logistics, and customer service teams to ensure smooth operations, from order placement through to delivery and after-sales support.
  • Collaborate with the wider sales team to share insights, best practices, and opportunities for cross-selling.
  • Negotiation & Contract Management
  • Negotiate pricing, terms, and conditions with accounts, ensuring mutually beneficial agreements that align with brand positioning and margin goals.
  • Manage and execute contract renewals, agreements, and promotional support to drive long-term partnerships.
  • Customer Service Excellence
  • Address any customer queries or issues promptly and professionally, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction.

jobs.title: Programme Manager
jobs.description:
ResultsinHealth (RiH) is looking for an energetic Programme Manager to join our Procurement and Supply chain Management (PSM) team in Leiderdorp. We are recruiting a new colleague with a hands-on mentality who is driven, diplomatic, organized, enthusiastic, tenacious, positive and cheerful.

Responsibilities
- Manage the RiH PSM portfolios: Ensure implementation and follow-up of multiple concurrent country workplans and services,
- Provide administrative support for RiH Experts on contracting, invoicing, communication, travel bookings, visas, report editing, and completeness of deliverables,
- Participate in New Business activities, develop expressions of interest for funders,
- Support the development and rollout of new initiatives, including RiHRecruit.com,
- Coordinate recruitment, maintenance, and management of RiH pool of Experts,
- Regular communication with RiH experts and partners backstopping teams,
- Provide coordination and support on supply chain assignments and Global Fund technical areas when applicable (based on skills and interest),
- Assist with improvements to RiH work processes and tools, strategic initiatives,
- Represent RiH at conferences, meetings and trainings when appropriate,
- Coordinate the provision of materials for RiH communication and outreach,
- Coordinate organization and liaison for meetings or training with experts/clients and in-house capacity building

ResultsinHealth is an international development advisory firm located in The Netherlands.
RiH is dedicated to effective disease prevention and to improving access to health care. We strengthen health systems and monitor the progress of program implementation. Based on our work and recommendations, donor agencies and governments make evidence-based decisions on spending for medicines and health products and controlling risks in supply chains for optimized efficiency.

Our largest client is the Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria (GF). Since 2003, RiH has been a trusted and respected partner in evaluating supply chains in countries that receive GF grants. We work in more than 50 countries worldwide with a large group of experts, mainly pharmacists and laboratory specialists.

RiH is a lean and flexible organization recognized for its responsiveness to specific needs while providing excellent and solutions-oriented services to its clients. Recently, we launched RiHRecruit.com; global recruitment services for challenging roles in public health.

Visit our website for more information about our company and the vacancy: www.resultsinhealth.org

jobs.title: Support Engineer
jobs.description:
Voor deze functie zoeken wij bij voorkeur iemand met werkervaring als Support Engineer, systeembeheerder, ICT-beheerder of in een vergelijkbare technische supportfunctie. Je hebt ervaring met het oplossen van incidenten op het gebied van werkplekken, Microsoft 365, servers, netwerken en cloudomgevingen. Ervaring met Microsoft 365 en Azure is belangrijk. Basiskennis van routers, firewalls, VPN en wifi is vereist. Ervaring met VoIP, migraties, ITIL, SCRUM of Prince2 is een pre. Het is vooral belangrijk dat je zelfstandig problemen kunt analyseren, klantgericht communiceert en technische oplossingen duidelijk kunt uitleggen.

NDC-IT is een groeiende en nuchtere IT-dienstverlener uit Zaandam. Wij helpen organisaties met moderne werkplekken, Microsoft 365, cloudoplossingen, infrastructuur, telefonie en cybersecurity. Onze klanten zijn actief in onder andere de zorg, bouw, logistiek en zakelijke dienstverlening.

Voor uitbreiding van ons technische team zoeken wij een Support Engineer die houdt van afwisseling, verantwoordelijkheid en direct klantcontact. Je ondersteunt gebruikers, analyseert storingen en beheert onder meer Microsoft 365-omgevingen, werkplekken, servers, netwerken en cloudoplossingen.

Geen dag is hetzelfde. Het ene moment los je een complex incident op, het volgende moment werk je mee aan een migratie, implementatie of verbeterproject. Daarbij kijk je verder dan alleen de directe oplossing: je onderzoekt de oorzaak en denkt mee over hoe problemen structureel kunnen worden voorkomen.

Je krijgt veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en ontwikkeling. Afhankelijk van je kennis en interesses kun je doorgroeien richting Microsoft cloud, infrastructuur, projecten of cybersecurity.

Je werkt in een klein en betrokken team met korte lijnen, brede technische kennis en een informele werksfeer. Wij zoeken iemand die klantgericht communiceert, zelfstandig kan werken en graag technische uitdagingen omzet in praktische oplossingen.

jobs.title: Human Resources Business Partner
jobs.description:
Human Business Partner â Remote

Reports To: Senior Director of Human Resources

Cardiovascular Services of America (CVAUSA) is the largest private and independent cardiology network in the United States. Our inclusive and diverse network brings together top cardiovascular specialists and thought leaders who offer regional perspectives and a broad strategic vision for the future of patient care.

Who We are and what we do:
Â Â 
Headquartered in Orlando area, Cardiovascular Associates of America aims to bring the best cardiovascular physicians in one network with the common mission of saving lives, reducing costs, and improving patient care through clinical innovation. Through CVAUSAâs physician-centered practice management model, physicians drive clinical care and their practice culture, while benefiting from the business expertise and shared resources available through CVAUSA for better patient outcomes.

Position Summary
The Human Resources Manager serves as a trusted HR partner supporting the National Services Organization (NSO) and a network of independent physician practices in a multi-site healthcare environment. Reporting to the Senior Director of Human Resources, this role is responsible for providing practical HR guidance with a strong focus on employee relations, talent acquisition, and leadership support while ensuring consistent HR practices across a growing organization.

This position is ideal for an experienced HR professional who enjoys balancing strategic partnership with hands-on execution. The HR Manager works closely with physicians, practice administrators, operational leaders, and corporate stakeholders to address employee concerns, support organizational growth, recruit top talent, and foster positive workplace cultures while respecting the unique identity of each practice.

Success in this role requires sound judgment, exceptional relationship-building skills, strong business acumen, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, evolving organization.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Employee Relations & HR Partnership
Â 
  • Serve as the primary HR partner to assigned business leaders, physicians, and practice administrators, providing practical guidance on employee relations, performance management, organizational policies, and HR best practices.
  • Handle employee relations matters from initial intake through resolution, including conducting workplace investigations, documenting findings, and recommending appropriate corrective actions.
  • Coach leaders through difficult conversations, performance concerns, conflict resolution, employee engagement, and policy interpretation.
  • Balance employee advocacy with sound business judgment while minimizing organizational risk.
  • Identify employee relations trends and recommend proactive solutions to strengthen leadership effectiveness, improve retention, and enhance workplace culture.
  • Build trusted relationships with leaders across multiple locations while supporting the unique culture of each independent practice.
Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning
  • Partner with hiring managers to identify staffing needs and develop recruiting strategies for clinical, administrative, and corporate positions.
  • Manage full-cycle recruitment including sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer coordination, and hiring.
  • Collaborate with recruiting resources and hiring leaders to improve candidate experience and reduce time-to-fill.
  • Coordinate and support onboarding to ensure new employees successfully integrate into both the organization and their individual practice culture.
  • Assist leadership with workforce planning to support organizational growth, expansion, and acquisitions.
HR Operations & Organizational Support
  • Provide day-to-day HR support to assigned practices and NSO leaders.
  • Support organizational growth initiatives, including onboarding new practices and assisting with HR integration efforts.
  • Assist in developing scalable HR policies, procedures, and best practices that support a decentralized operating model.
  • Partner with Payroll, Benefits, HRIS, Compliance, and Operations to ensure a consistent and positive employee experience.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, and local employment laws, company policies, and regulatory requirements.
Leadership & Organizational Effectiveness
  • Build credibility and trusted partnerships with leaders at all levels of the organization.
  • Support organizational change initiatives through effective communication, coaching, and employee support.
  • Use data, sound judgment, and business insight to help leaders make informed workforce decisions.
  • Participate in HR initiatives that improve employee engagement, retention, leadership capability, and operational effectiveness.
Travel
  • Travel up to 20% to partner practices and regional locations to provide on-site HR support, conduct investigations, facilitate training, and strengthen relationships with practice leadership.
Qualifications

Education
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, or a related field required.
Experience
  • 5+ years of progressive Human Resources experience.
  • Experience supporting multiple locations or business units preferred.
  • Previous experience in healthcare, physician practice management, National Services Organizations (NSOs), or similarly complex environments is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience managing employee relations matters and conducting workplace investigations.
  • Hands-on full-cycle recruiting experience required.
Preferred Certifications
  • SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, or SPHR certification preferred.
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

The ideal candidate will:
Â 
  • Demonstrate strong expertise in employee relations and conflict resolution.
  • Think strategically while remaining willing to execute day-to-day HR responsibilities.
  • Build strong relationships and credibility with leaders across the organization.
  • Effectively coach managers on performance management, employee development, and workplace concerns.
  • Possess strong recruiting skills with the ability to identify and attract high-quality talent.
  • Thrive in a fast-paced, growing environment where priorities evolve quickly.
  • Exercise sound judgment, discretion, and professionalism when handling confidential information.
  • Demonstrate exceptional communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
  • Successfully manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail.
Working Conditions
  • Work is primarily performed in a professional office or remote office environment free from excessive noise and distractions.
  • Work area must ensure confidentiality of employee and organizational information.
  • Regular use of computers, telephones, and standard office equipment.
Physical Requirements
  • Ability to sit, stand, walk, bend, and move throughout the workday.
  • Frequent use of hands and fingers for keyboarding and other office tasks.
  • Ability to communicate effectively through speaking, listening, and reading.
  • Occasional reaching, stooping, kneeling, or crouching.
  • Ability to lift, push, pull, or move up to 10 pounds on an occasional basis.

Description de l'entreprise

CS, filiale du groupe Sopra Steria, est un acteur technologique de référence dans la conception, l'intégration et l'exploitation de systèmes critiques. Présents dans 7 pays avec plus de 2600 collaborateurs passionnés, nous intervenons au cœur des enjeux de souveraineté, de sécurité et de performance, dans des secteurs stratégiques tels que la défense, le spatial, l'énergie, l'industrie, le transport, l'aéronautique et la cybersécurité.

Notre différence ? Une expertise unique en systèmes temps réel, des solutions souveraines et durables, et une culture d'innovation forte, portée par 15 % de notre chiffre d'affaires investi en R&D. Nous accompagnons nos clients dans la réussite de leurs programmes les plus complexes, du contrôle aérien à la lutte anti-drones, en passant par les systèmes nucléaires et les centres de contrôle satellites.

En rejoignant CS, vous intégrez une entreprise humaine et innovante.***Nous livrons bien plus que des systèmes, nous bâtissons la confiance.
* Nous allons au-delà des besoins exprimés, nous préparons les défis de demain.

Forte d'un savoir-faire reconnu, elle contribue activement à renforcer la performance, la sécurité et l'innovation de l'écosystème spatial.

Nos équipes apportent leur expertise sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie des missions : observation de la Terre, systèmes de navigation et de télécommunication, sciences et exploration interplanétaire, surveillance et sécurité de l'Espace. Portées par l'IA et nos solutions souveraines, nous repoussons chaque jour les frontières technologiques des programmes spatiaux européens.

Rejoindre cette Business Unit , c'est façonner le futur de l'espace aux côtés d'experts passionnés.

* Cloud (providers européens essentiellement) / Openstack
* OpenSource
* Langages variés (Python, Node, Java, C/C++, Golang, Rust)
Qualifications

De formation Bac+5 écoles d'ingénieur ou équivalent, vous possédez une expérience entre 3 et 5 ans en tant que DevOps . La connaissance du secteur spatial est un véritable atout. Vous maitrisez la plateforme de conteneurisation Docker / OCI ainsi que le logiciel Kubernetes .

La maitrise de l' anglais professionnel (lu, écrit et parlé) est indispensable.
Vous êtes à l'écoute , autonome, curieux(se) et aimez le travail en équipe ? Vous aimez débattre au sein de l'équipe pour faire évoluer les choix et solutions techniques au cours du temps ? Alors vous êtes la pépite que nous recherchons !

* Un engagement sociétal fort : plus de 3000 associations soutenues, une politique handicap active, une culture inclusive, une démarche de numérique responsable, et des partenariats comme Elles bougent pour inspirer les talents féminins de demain.

.et bien d'autres avantages à découvrir en nous rejoignant !

Wir suchen

Integrationskraft für Schulbegleitung (m/w/d) mit Erfahrung mit Autismus in Ludwigshafen am Rhein

Ludwigshafen am Rhein - Teilzeit - Vormittag

Die Cosmea Pflege Gruppe steht für moderne ambulante Pflege und individuelle Begleitung von Menschen in ihrem gewohnten Umfeld. Mit Verlässlichkeit, Respekt, Nähe und einem starken Miteinander schaffen wir die Grundlage für eine Pflege, die Vertrauen gibt und Lebensqualität erhält.

Denn wir sind überzeugt: Gute Pflege beginnt bei einem starken Team. Unsere Mitarbeitenden sind das Herzstück unserer Arbeit – engagiert, herzlich und professionell. Gemeinsam sorgen wir dafür, dass Menschen jeden Alters die Unterstützung erhalten, die sie brauchen.

An unserem Standort in Landau in der Pfalz begleiten wir Kinder und Jugendliche bis zum 21. Lebensjahr in ihrem vertrauten Alltag – ob zu Hause, im Kindergarten oder in der Schule. Dabei steht die individuelle Förderung, Begleitung und Unterstützung stets im Mittelpunkt.

Für die 1:1-Begleitung eines Kindes suchen wir eine liebevolle, zuverlässige und engagierte Inegrationskraft für Schulbegleitung (m/w/d) mit Erfahrung im Bereich Autismus in Ludwigshafen am Rhein | Mo–Fr.

Deine Aufgaben

- In der Schulbegleitung sorgst Du dafür, dass unsere Kinder trotz Einschränkung die Schule besuchen können
- Du unterstützt die soziale und schulische Integration in die Klasse
- Du gibst Orientierungshilfen auf dem Schulgelände, im Schulhaus, oder im Klassenzimmer
- Hilfestellung bei der Strukturierung des Schulalltags und bei der Bewältigung von Übergangssituationen
- Du beobachtest das Wohlbefinden des Kindes und bietest emotionale Unterstützung
- Du sorgst dafür, dass sich das Kind sicher, verstanden und wohlfühlt
- Du bist Teil eines professionellen Netzwerkes zum Wohl des Kindes
- Unsere Kinder brauchen Abwechslung und lieben es in die Schule zu gehen. Du sorgst dafür, dass alles glatt läuft

Was wir uns wünschen

- Du hast bereits Berufserfahrung im Umgang mit Kindern und Jugendlichen
- Idealerweise Erfahrungen in der Begleitung von Kindern oder Jugendlichen mit Autismus-Spektrum-Störung (ASS)
- Du besitzt den Führerschein Klasse B
- Du bist einfühlsam, engagiert und kreativ in der Versorgung und Betreuung kleiner Patienten
- Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit und Teamgeist
- Du hast ein offenes Ohr für Eltern, Lehrer, Erzieher und einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch
- Du hast das Herz am richtigen Fleck und versorgst Deine Kinder mit Humor, Einfühlungsvermögen und Verstand

Was du von uns erwarten kannst

- Eine sinnstiftende und wertvolle Tätigkeit mit direktem Einfluss auf die schulische Teilhabe eines Kindes
- Unsere Pflegedienstleitung Bettina informiert dich in einem ausführlichen Gespräch und beantwortet alle deine Fragen
- Zum Kennenlernen findet vorab ein Treffen mit dem Kind und den Eltern statt – denn eine gute Chemie zwischen euch ist die Basis für eine vertrauensvolle Begleitung im Schulalltag
- Planbare, familienfreundliche Arbeitszeiten (Mo–Fr)
- 5 Tage Woche
- Keine Arbeitszeit während der Schulferien
- Strukturierte Einarbeitung und Unterstützung im Alltag
- Bei uns kannst du deinen Beruf und dessen Werte leben

Du möchtest deinen Beruf mit Familie und Freizeit besser vereinbaren?

Dann freut sich unsere Pflegedienstleitung Frau Bettina Hahn auf deine Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Angabe der Stellen-ID: 5042, dem frühestmöglichen Eintrittsdatum.
