jobs.title: CFD Software Developer (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description:
CFD Software Engineer (f/m/d)
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the
world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation—helping innovative
global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a
large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together
while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages
creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our
business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.
Position Overview
Are you a passionate Software Engineer who enjoys working at
the intersection of numerical methods, high-performance computing, and
real-world engineering applications? We are searching for a talented CFD
Software Engineer to join our solver development team for Simcenter Ultrafluid (formerly Altair ultraFluidX, https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/) ), a small, dynamic, and agile team delivering world-class CFD software to
industries including automotive, heavy industry, and consumer electronics.
Simcenter Ultrafluid features a native GPU-based
implementation of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM), allowing users to run
fully transient, high-fidelity aerodynamics and aeroacoustics simulations
overnight on a single compute server. The solver is designed to handle complex
geometries and demanding industrial use cases, delivering high-fidelity,
predictive simulations of real engineering processes, including turbulent
flows, thermal transport, and complex geometry handling.
If you are seeking a role where you can contribute directly
to solver development, algorithm implementation, and GPU acceleration, while
translating cutting-edge academic research in numerical methods into a
high-performance, easy-to-use software product, and collaborating closely with
the whole development team on the advancement of the code and its capabilities,
then we'd love to hear from you!
Responsibilities

- Contribute
to the code development of Simcenter Ultrafluid as part of the agile
development team
- Specify,
implement, test, and document new high-quality features of the solver in
close collaboration with the other team members
- Contribute
to performance benchmarking and code optimization in a massively parallel
GPU environment, while collaborating with other development teams across
HPC, pre/post-processing, and meshing to integrate Simcenter Ultrafluid
into the broader Simcenter ecosystem
- Collaborate
with product management, application specialists, and QA engineers to
ensure the solver meets real-world industrial needs
- Participate
in daily stand-ups as well as regular review, retrospective, and planning
meetings

Required Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience

- M.Sc.
or Ph.D. degree in mechanical engineering, computational mechanics,
computer science, or a comparable physics-based discipline
- At
least two years of hands-on experience in CFD solver development in a
commercial or academic environment
- High
proficiency in C++ and parallel programming
- Excellent
English communication skills
- Passion
for numerical simulation and a drive to find creative solutions for
challenging industrial use cases with a focus on customer value
- Willingness
to work in a close-knit, agile development team

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience
with scripting or scientific programming languages such as Python or Julia
- Solid
understanding of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM) and its application in
CFD
- Solid
understanding of GPU architectures and experience with the CUDA toolkit

Why us?
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by
default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than
200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through
real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale
and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and
inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring you curiosity
and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

Grundkenntnisse: Gästebetreuung, Fahrzeugführung, Getränke zubereiten und anrichten, Technisches Verständnis

jobs.title: Top Chance: Servicetechniker. Innen- und Aussendienst.
jobs.description:
Die Nuovo AG ist ein inhabergeführtes Unternehmen mit Sitz in Pfäffikon ZH und spezialisiert auf die Entwicklung und Produktion von Maschinenlösungen für die industrielle Eierbranche. In dieser hochspezialisierten Nische hat sich die Nuovo AG über Jahre hinweg eine starke Marktposition aufgebaut und betreut sowohl nationale als auch internationale Kunden. Neben eigenen Maschinenlösungen agiert die Nuovo AG in der Schweiz als Generalvertretung von SANOVO und Rational und ergänzt ihr Angebot damit um starke Partnerschaften.  
Zur Verstärkung des bestehenden Teams suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine technisch versierte Persönlichkeit, die Freude an einer vielseitigen Tätigkeit im Innen\- und Aussendienst mitbringt.  
Top Chance: Servicetechniker. Innen\- und Aussendienst.  
Deine Aufgaben  
Du startest mit einer sorgfältigen Einarbeitung, bei der du unseren erfahrenen Servicetechniker im Aussendienst begleitest und gleichzeitig im Betrieb die Maschinen, Abläufe und Produkte von Grund auf kennenlernst. So wächst du Schritt für Schritt in die Rolle hinein und übernimmst nach und nach eigenständig Serviceeinsätze. Nach erfolgreicher Einarbeitung liegt der Schwerpunkt deiner Tätigkeit im Aussendienst. Du installierst, wartest und reparierst Maschinen, nimmst neue Anlagen in Betrieb und stellst sicher, dass beim Kunden alles zuverlässig funktioniert. Bei Störungen bist du die zentrale Ansprechperson und sorgst für schnelle und nachhaltige Lösungen – direkt vor Ort oder auch remote. Ergänzend arbeitest du im Betrieb mit, unterstützt die interne Montage und Fertigung und kümmerst dich um die Vorbereitung der Einsätze. Dabei stellst du sicher, dass Material und Abläufe optimal aufeinander abgestimmt sind und alles reibungslos funktioniert.  
Das bringst du mit  
Technische Grundausbildung mit EFZ (Polymechaniker, Automatiker, o.ä.)  
Gute mechanische und gute elektrotechnische Kenntnisse (Schemas lesen und verstehen)  
v. V. Kenntnisse in Netzwerken (Netzwerke aufbauen, konfigurieren und Geräte integrieren)  
Erfahrung als Service\-Techniker sowie im Umgang mit Remote\-Tools von Vorteil  
Zuverlässige, belastbare und teamfähige Persönlichkeit mit einer selbstständigen sowie lösungsorientierten Arbeitsweise  
Gültiger Führerausweis Kat. B sowie gute Deutschkenntnisse  
Das erwartet dich  
Bei der Nuovo AG erwartet dich ein vielseitiger und facettenreicher Job mit viel Eigenverantwortung und einem hohen Mass an Selbstständigkeit. Du wirst sorgfältig und praxisnah eingearbeitet – gemeinsam mit einem erfahrenen Teamkollegen, der dich Schritt für Schritt an die Maschinen, Abläufe und Kunden heranführt. Für Schulungszwecke bist du zeitweise in den Niederlanden und vertiefst dort dein technisches Know\-how. Du arbeitest in einem Umfeld, in dem Teamgeist zählt: Man unterstützt sich gegenseitig, hilft einander im Alltag und zieht gemeinsam an einem Strang. Gleichzeitig triffst du auf einen jungen, engagierten Geschäftsführer, der mit viel Drive und Innovationsgeist vorangeht und das Unternehmen aktiv weiterentwickelt. Du bist unterwegs beim Kunden oder arbeitest im Betrieb. Je nach Einsatz startest du direkt von zu Hause oder vom Betrieb aus und kannst deine Einsätze eigenständig organisieren. jobs.title: Junior Business Development Manager
jobs.description:
Goal

Execute Dätwyler's New Business & Innovation commercial strategy by engaging prospective and existing customers, validating sales narratives in the field, and feeding structured market intelligence back to leadership — enabling faster, evidence-based product and partnership decisions.



Key Responsibilities

1. Customer Outreach & Pipeline Execution
•    Identify and evaluate new business opportunities, technologies, and applications aligned with strategic priorities
•    Build, qualify and maintain relationships with customers, startups, research institutions, and industry partners
•    Execute outbound prospecting campaigns defined in the strategic playbooks
•    Represent Dätwyler at trade shows, conferences, and road shows aligned to the assigned region to stay ahead of market trends.
•    Coordinate with the internal legal team to execute NDAs and joint development agreements for new prospects.


2. Customer Interviews & Narrative Validation
•    Conduct structured customer discovery interviews to surface pain points, unmet needs, and future product outlook.
•    Test and validate sales narratives and value propositions defined by senior leadership, collecting verbatim feedback.
•    Assess customer receptivity to new technologies and solutions; flag gaps or misalignments to the strategy team.
•    Gather competitive intelligence from customer conversations; document and escalate findings in a structured format.

3. Relationship Development
•    Build and maintain trusted relationships with key contacts at prospective and existing client organisations.
•    Advance conversations from initial engagement through qualification and into joint development or commercial agreements.
•    Ensure customers are onboarded smoothly to experience Dätwyler technologies; coordinate internally as needed.

4. Market Intelligence & Reporting
•    Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all leads, opportunities, and customer interactions in Salesforce CRM.
•    Contribute structured field intelligence — customer feedback, trend observations, competitor signals — to the senior strategy team.
•    Support the development of business cases by collecting quantitative and qualitative customer perspectives.
•    Provide input on opportunity prioritisation and win themes to leadership in regular pipeline reviews.

5. Cross-Functional Collaboration with BUs
•    Work with Marketing and Business Unit leads to align on value propositions before customer engagements.
•    Relay customer feedback and external insights to product and innovation teams to inform roadmap decisions.
•    Contribute to internal reporting and metrics tracking as directed by senior leadership.



Candidate Profile

Education & Experience
•    Master's degree in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related field.
•    2–5 years of experience in sales, marketing, commercial operations, or business development — ideally in an industrial, medtech, or deep-tech environment.
•    Demonstrated track record of managing the early stages of a sales or partnership pipeline.

Competencies
•    Customer-facing confidence — comfortable running structured interviews and discovery calls independently.
•    Results-driven with strong action orientation; moves quickly and follows through reliably.
•    High energy and entrepreneurial mindset; thrives in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.
•    Strong data orientation; able to analyse pipeline metrics and adapt tactics accordingly.
•    Excellent verbal and written communication skills; skilled at capturing and conveying customer insights.
•    Collaborative team player with the ability to interface effectively across technical and commercial functions.

Tools & Systems
•    Proficient in Salesforce or equivalent CRM for pipeline and activity management.
•    Comfortable using AI-assisted tools for research, outreach drafting, and insight synthesis.
•    Strong Microsoft Office Suite skills (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

La société Blanc SA est une entreprise familiale de nettoyage et d'entretien basée sur la région Lausannoise. Elle est active depuis plusieurs générations dans toute la Suisse romande et emploie plus de 500 collaborateurs.

En 1946, Émile Blanc fonde à Lausanne une entreprise de nettoyage et de conciergerie. Portée par l'essor du secteur de la construction dans les années 60, Blanc SA connaît une croissance rapide et élargit naturellement son offre de services.

Au début des années 80, la troisième génération prend le relais et structure l'entreprise en départements spécialisés, dirigés par les frères Marc Olivier, Thierry et Philippe Blanc.

jobs.title: Junior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Junior Data Engineer (a)  
Imagine using your data engineering skills to improve the way cardiovascular health is monitored and managed. Hilo by Aktiia is redefining blood pressure monitoring through AI\-driven optical technology built on more than 20 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM). Their solution combines a wearable device (Hilo), a mobile app, and a cloud\-based platform for healthcare professionals — empowering users and physicians with continuous, actionable insights into blood\-pressure patterns. With more than 200,000 users, over $120M in funding, and a CE\-certified medical device already available across several markets, Aktiia is continuing to scale its technology, product ecosystem, and international presence.  
As Aktiia expands its data capabilities, we’re looking for a Junior Data Engineer who will help scale a Databricks\-based medallion Lakehouse from a primarily R\&D/Core Tech setup into a broader company\-wide data platform. Working closely with and learning directly from an experienced Senior Data Engineer, you will support the ingestion, centralization, documentation, and validation of clinical, legacy, and operational data. Your work will help transform complex and sometimes messy data sources into clean, reliable, and model\-ready pipelines used by Data Science, ML, Algorithm, and Core Tech teams.  
YourRole  
Data Ingestion \& Lakehouse Development: Design, build, and maintain data ingestion and processing pipelines within Aktiia’s Databricks\-hosted medallion Lakehouse, working under senior guidance while gradually taking on more ownership.  
Clinical \& Legacy Data Integration: Take an active role in ingesting, centralizing, and documenting clinical data currently spread across EDC platforms such as Castor and RedCap, databases, standalone archives, and other historically grown sources.  
Data Exploration \& Practical Data Archaeology: Work hands\-on with unfamiliar and sometimes messy datasets, identify structures and inconsistencies, and turn unstructured situations into reliable, usable data assets.  
Pipeline Development \& Preprocessing: Build preprocessing and ETL/ELT pipelines that provide clean, structured, and model\-ready datasets for Algorithm Development, Core Tech, Machine Learning, and Data Science teams.  
Data Quality, Validation \& Documentation: Define and apply practical standards for data quality, validation, traceability, and documentation — especially for sensitive and clinically relevant datasets.  
Observability \& Engineering Practices: Implement logging, validation checks, alerting, and basic observability for new pipelines, while contributing to shared codebase practices such as Git, code reviews, CI/CD, and testing.  
Platform Scaling \& Collaboration: Support the evolution of the lakehouse from selected technical use cases toward a company\-wide data infrastructure, working closely with the Senior Data Engineer, ML Engineers, Data Scientists, and cross\-functional stakeholders.  
Your Profile  
Academic Background  
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.  
Professional Expertise  
At least 1\+ year of practical post\-study experience in data engineering, data infrastructure, data ingestion, or a similar hands\-on technical role. You may still be early in your career, but you have already worked with real data pipelines, production\-oriented data workflows, or collaborative data platforms.  
Technical Experience  
You have solid hands\-on experience with and SQL and bring practical experience with Databricks. You are familiar with cloud environments — ideally AWS. You understand the basics of ETL/ELT pipeline design, data ingestion patterns, and data modelling, and you have worked with shared codebases using Git, code reviews, CI/CD, or testing practices. Experience with Spark, Delta Lake, or Parquet is a strong plus.  
Industry Fit  
Ideally, you have gained experience in a start\-up, scale\-up, or technically demanding environment where you worked hands\-on across the data pipeline. Exposure to regulated or data\-sensitive industries such as MedTech, Pharma, FinTech, or healthcare is a plus, especially when it comes to data quality, validation, and documentation.  
Language Skills  
English at a highly proficient level is a must. French is advantageous.  
Personality  
A curious, pragmatic, and hands\-on problem\-solver, you enjoy bringing structure into complex data environments. You work independently, ask the right questions, stay well organized, and collaborate openly with Data Engineering, Data Science, ML, Algorithm, Core Tech, and Product stakeholders. You are based in Switzerland and are comfortable working in a hybrid setup with one day per week regular presence in Neuchâtel.  
We’re looking for a pragmatic, hands\-on data builder who enjoys working with real\-world clinical and company data — someone who is excited to bring structure into scattered datasets, build reliable pipelines, and help create a modern data foundation for advanced ML and digital health applications.  
Do you want to grow your expertise in Data Engineering and cloud\-based lakehouse architectures while contributing to health technology that has a direct impact on hundreds of thousands of people? Then we’re excited to meet you! jpid576e381jm jit0730jm jiy26jm

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
DevOps Engineer (a) (80 – 100%)  
HRM Systems AG mit Sitz in Winterthur ist ein erfolgreiches Familienunternehmen mit 160 Mitarbeitenden und langer Firmengeschichte. Grossunternehmen und Unternehmensgruppen werden bei der Abwicklung von HR\-Prozessen und im betrieblichen Gesundheitsmanagement durch die im Hause entwickelten Softwarelösungen und Dienstleistungen unterstützt. Als Marktleader in ihrem Bereich steht das Unternehmen auf stabilen und finanziell gesunden Beinen. Dies ermöglicht die gezielte Investition in die wegweisende Weiterentwicklung ihrer Produkte. Auf dich warten flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, grosszügige Home\-Office\-Regelungen, sehr gute Sozialleistungen sowie moderne Arbeitsbedingungen. Mit der spürbar gelebten Wertekultur «Gemeinsam», «Mutig», «Begeistert» und «Respektvoll» bietet man dir ein attraktives Umfeld.  
Die IT von HRM Systems entwickelt sich stetig weiter. Komplexe Produkte, gewachsene Infrastrukturen und moderne SaaS\-Architekturen bringen spannende technische Herausforderungen mit sich. Um den Bereich DevOps über alle Produkte hinweg gezielt zu stärken, wird ein neues, kleines DevOps\-Team aufgebaut. Dieses Team bildet künftig die Brücke zwischen dem Produktbereich, interner Infrastruktur, Betriebsinfrastruktur und dem Entwicklungsbereich. Damit entsteht eine vielseitige Rolle mit Gestaltungsspielraum und technischer Verantwortung. Im Rahmen eines Exklusivmandats suchen wir eine:n erfahrene:n DevOps Engineer.  
Deine Herausforderung  
Du unterstützt übergreifend die Produktentwicklungsteams rund um die drei Produkte UKA Solutions, CAREMA und UKA Connect bei DevOps\-Themen und betreust die bestehende Infrastruktur.  
Du stellst den stabilen Betrieb von Produktions\- und Entwicklungsumgebungen auf Infrastruktur\-Ebene sicher.  
Du analysierst und behebst Störungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Entwicklungsteams, IT\-Services und dem externen Infrastruktur\-Provider.  
Du optimierst die Automatisierung rund um Builds, Deployments, Testing, Monitoring und Alerting.  
Du bringst technische Konzepte voran und schaffst die Grundlage für eine stabile, sichere und wartungsarme Infrastruktur.  
Du arbeitest mit Technologien und Werkzeugen wie GitLab, OpenShift, Docker, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, ELK, Grafana und Nagios.  
Du übernimmst übergreifende Themen wie die Verwaltung von Lizenzen und Zugriffsberechtigungen für Entwickler.  
Du entwickelst ein neu entstehendes DevOps Team aktiv mit und bringst deine Ideen für langfristig tragfähige Lösungen ein.  
Deine Qualitäten und Begabungen  
Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im DevOps oder DevOps\-nahen Umfeld  
Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder entsprechende Berufserfahrung (du kommst entweder aus der Softwareentwicklung und hast dich in Richtung DevOps entwickelt oder du bringst einen Infrastruktur\-Background mit starkem DevOps\-Engineering Verständnis mit)  
Von Vorteil sind Kenntnisse von mehreren Technologien, welche sich mit denen bei HRM decken: OpenShift, Kubernetes, Docker, PostgreSQL, CI/CD, GitLab  
Du gestaltest gerne mit und bringst deine Ideen ein  
Du fühlst dich in einem Umfeld wohl, in dem noch nicht alles abschliessend definiert ist, und gehst Themen proaktiv, analytisch und lösungsorientiert an.  
Deutsch bist du verhandlungssicher  
Möchtest du ein DevOps\-Team von Grund auf mitgestalten und deine Erfahrungen einbringen? Suchst du ein stabiles Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen gehört werden?  
Dann freut sich auf deine Bewerbungsunterlagen oder auf deinen Anruf. jpid44b52f6jm jit0730jm jiy26jm

We are proudly thinking forward. We prioritize reinvention, individuality, and always making the next leap in innovation.  
To strengthen our position in the veterinary orthopedics market and to accelerate the success of our fast\-growing company, we are looking for a  
SENIOR VICE PRESIDENT, PRODUCT \& BUSINESS OPERATIONS  
The Senior Vice President, Product \& Business Operations is responsible for building and leading an integrated global organization spanning Product Management, Research and Development, Clinical Evaluation, Manufacturing, Global Supply Chain, and Quality.  
This is a hands\-on executive leadership role for an experienced builder who can bring structure, clarity, accountability, and operating discipline to a decentralized, entrepreneurial organization. The successful leader will establish effective departments, develop strong Directors, implement practical processes and SOPs, and create consistent operating cadences that enable teams to work together as one streamlined organization.  
The role owns the end\-to\-end idea\-to\-stock operating model: from product strategy and development through manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and product availability. This leader will ensure that business priorities are translated into executable plans, products reach the market on time and on specification, and the organization is structured to scale.  
This role suits an experienced builder who thrives on shaping and strengthening organizations. The successful candidate will bring demonstrated experience building or transforming functions within a start\-up, scale\-up, private\-equity\-backed, multi\-brand, or similarly entrepreneurial organization — rather than only inheriting mature, fully established functions.  
YOUR MISSION  
Organizational Leadership and Development  
Lead and develop leaders across Product Management, R\&D, Clinical Evaluation, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Quality  
Build a capable Director\-level structure with clear ownership, reporting lines, accountability, and decision rights  
Establish succession plans and leadership\-development priorities for critical functions  
Foster ownership, collaboration, transparency, and constructive accountability  
Serve as a hands\-on player\-coach who stays close to the work to understand issues and make informed decisions

Establish scalable SOPs, workflows, governance structures, and decision rights  
Create consistent leadership, portfolio, supply, capacity, and performance reviews  
Implement meaningful KPIs, dashboards, and accountability measures across each responsible function  
Improve prioritization, resource allocation, issue escalation, and decision\-making.  
Identify and communicate risks, constraints, and trade\-offs early  
Lead annual and long\-range operational planning in partnership with the CEO, Finance, Commercial, and other leadership functions  
Functional Leadership and Accountability  
Partner with and set direction for the Directors leading Product Management, Research \& Development, Clinical Evaluation, Manufacturing, and Global Supply Chain  
Hold ultimate accountability for outcomes across all functions, working through these leaders and their teams to:  
Product Management — sustain a prioritized, market\-aligned portfolio and rationalize SKUs while preserving appropriate clinical coverage  
Research \& Development — drive disciplined, stage\-gated development, on\-time and on\-specification launches, and a sustainable innovation pipeline  
Clinical Evaluation — ensure robust clinical evidence, post\-market follow\-up, and strong clinical input from surgeons, KOLs, and advisory boards  
Manufacturing — drive reliable manufacturing performance, global production standards, and sound capacity, footprint, and investment decisions

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Clarify and reinforce functional ownership, decision rights, and reporting relationships  
Strengthen consistent leadership and operating cadences  
Refine the integrated idea\-to\-stock process, including roles, governance, handoffs, escalation points, and KPIs  
Refine and align prioritized plans for Quality, Supply Chain, Clinical Evaluation, Product Development, and Business Operations  
Identify immediate risks affecting launches, product availability, quality, customers, or business continuity  
First 12 Months  
Quality is established as a functioning department with clear leadership, accountability, processes, and measures  
Directors are set up for success and effectively leading their respective functions.  
Priority product launches are delivered on time, on specification, and at the expected quality level  
Supplier change control, capacity review, launch governance, and integrated planning processes are operating consistently  
Product, operational, and business priorities are connected through a common operating model  
Lead times, product availability, inventory performance, and service levels show measurable improvement  
Cross\-functional teams understand how work moves across departments and where decisions are made  
The organization is structured to scale and support a potential future separation of Product and Operations leadership

Quality System Engineer with DHT Technical Capabilities  
Roche Switzerland bridges the gap between pharmaceuticals and diagnostics. Important research and development functions are located here. For our long\-term client, F. Hoffmann\-La Roche AG in Basel, we are looking for a  
Quality System Engineer with DHT Technical Capabilities  
Background:  
Digital Health Technologies (DHTs), including those with medical device capabilities, are essential for enhancing patient value and supporting data\-driven clinical decision\-making. To meet the diverse measurement needs across clinical trials, the organization collaborates with multiple third\-party DHT manufacturers. While DHTs provide critical evidence, their implementation requires specialized technical expertise and introduces additional complexity to study delivery.  
A limited number of internal experts currently possess the required DHT Technical Capabilities to manage regulatory identity assessments, technical documentation, manufacturer data reviews, and change control activities. This capacity gap creates bottlenecks that may delay study initiation and impact successful DHT integration.  
The organization is seeking a Quality Systems Engineer Consultant to provide additional DHT Technical Capabilities, supporting regulatory assessments, documentation reviews, change control, remediation activities, and knowledge transfer. The consultant will help strengthen capabilities, ensure compliance, and enable effective integration of DHTs across Roche Pharma’s clinical study portfolio.  
The assignment is based within the Digital Endpoints and Patient Solutions (DEPCS) group’s Product Management and Design team and supports the broader product development portfolio.  
Tasks \& Responsibilities:  
Serving as the single point of contact: for technical conversations with third party device manufacturers regarding design controls, risk management, and agreements. Act as the Subject Expert (SME) on device requirements and technical nuances; also ensure these elements are appropriately integrated into study protocols and documentation.  
Compile and maintain the "Asset List" (Technical Documentation), perform technical reviews of manufacturer data, and author or review technical content for submission documents.  
Digital \& Regulatory Identity: Co\-lead the regulatory characterization of DHTs with the Product Management \& Design Leaders, which involves providing input into Roche’s internal Device Regulatory Assessment and supporting updates.  
Change Control: Act as the intake point and primary assessor for changes during a study, rigorously evaluating the impact on technical accuracy, documentation, and overall study integrity. Work will also help inform third party manufacturers of updates needed in their design control documentation.  
Evaluation: Support manufacturer qualification activities with Quality, Product Managers, Business Strategy \& Operations and Procurement teams to evaluate vendor capabilities and identify technical gaps to inform viability of use as a third party manufacturer.  
Remediation: Oversee the manufacturer's delivery and lead any needed remediation efforts (when needed) to address updates to documentation.  
Review Manufacturer Design History Files (DHFs) and product development documentation: from the third party DHT product manufacturers  
Conduct Risk Management and computer systems validation (CSV) for products not classified as medical device, when necessary and per Roche’s global standard operating procedures (SOPs)  
Ensure compliance with Roche’s internal quality standards and global standard operating procedures (SOPs) for medical devices, including sourcing, clinical investigation, risk management, and clinical performance procedures.  
Draft or support product managers, clinical scientists, or other clinical teams with drafting technical documentation or risk management plans to meet Roche SOP, ISO standards or Health Authority Requirements.  
Support upskilling: activities and plans to train team members new to medical device development, design control, regulatory assessment and quality documentation activities.

BA/BS degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Informatics, Biomedical, related technical field or equivalent practical experience. Masters or advanced degree in Engineering, Quality Management, or related field.  
7\+ years’ experience in the medical device or pharmaceutical industry  
In\-depth knowledge and experience executing ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 62304,IEC 82304, IEC 60601\-1, 21 CFR 820, 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11, and GAMP 5, with a strong emphasis on medical device regulations and quality management systems

Experience executing ISO / IEC 27001 and cybersecurity aspects related to development of medical device products

Experience with GCP / GxP practices and GMP

Track record of effectively working in a matrix environment with global team members

jobs.description:
You will be working on designing and building the geospatial data pipeline that powers our products. As part of our data team you will be heavily involved in our "ground truth," finding and integrating novel datasets, staying ahead of the latest research, and building the high\-performance services that bring our map to life. A part of this role also centres on our points\-of\-interest (POI), geocoding, and search capabilities, the systems that let users find places and turn addresses or names into precise locations.  
Data Engineer \- Geospatial Domain 80% \- 100%  
Who we’re looking for  
As a key member of our early\-stage team, you will work across our data stack, from raw data sourcing and processing to the APIs that serve it.  
Your primary focus will be on building robust, scalable pipelines to ingest, process, and optimize massive geospatial datasets for our applications.  
You will also stay on the pulse of the latest geospatial research, experiment with new data sources and algorithms, and collaborate directly with the product team to shape our data strategy.  
What you’ll be doing:  
Sourcing and integrating foundational datasets from open sources like OpenStreetMap, regional government portals, and commercial providers.  
Designing and building ETL/ELT pipelines to clean, transform, and load geospatial data into our core database.  
Optimizing data for performance, including generating vector tiles and structuring data for fast, low\-latency queries.  
Developing and maintaining high\-performance APIs in Go to expose our mapping data to our mobile and web applications.  
Researching and implementing cutting\-edge techniques in areas like spatial indexing, routing algorithms, POI/address conflation, and geocoding to make our map smarter.  
Managing and scaling our geospatial database infrastructure, likely using PostGIS.  
Collaborating with product and design to understand data requirements and deliver features that delight users.  
Building and curating our POI dataset; ingesting, deduplicating, and conflating places from multiple sources into a single authoritative record.  
Designing forward and reverse geocoding pipelines to translate between addresses, place names, and coordinates with high accuracy.  
Developing search and ranking logic (e.g. autocomplete, fuzzy matching, relevance scoring) to return the right result from a partial or messy query.  
Requirements:  
A strong portfolio or GitHub profile showcasing relevant data engineering or backend projects.

jobs.title: Mystery Shopper in Latvia
jobs.description:
Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

jobs.title: Mystery Shopper in Lithuania
jobs.description:
Mystery Shopper in Lithuania

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR
A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest, reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

jobs.title: Instruktor/ Veespordijuhendaja (eFoil – elektriline lendav laud) suvehooajaks
jobs.description:
Oleme valmis värbama ka alaealisi. Hooajaline töö mere ääres — õpetad inimesi sõitma elektrilise surfiga, nautima elu ja tundma vabadust

Tööülesanded: Mida sa tegelikult teed?
Sa ei istu kontoris. Sa ei vasta e-kirjadele 8 tundi järjest. Hommikul tuled mere äärde. Päike tõuseb Tallinna lahel. Võtad vastu esimesed külalised — mõned erutunud, mõned natuke hirmul. Annad neile 15-20 minutit ohutusinstruktaaži. Selgitad. Naeratad. Tekitad usalduse. Lähed nendega vette või paadiga kõrval. Näed hetke, kui inimene esimest korda lendab üle vee. Nende nägu ütleb kõik. Filmid neid paadilt, kaldalt — sisu, mis läheb viraalseks. Hoolitsed varustuse eest nagu oma asja eest. Laed akud, puhastd tahvlid, hoiad kogu ala korras ja puhtana. Järgmine klient peab nägema täiuslikku — mitte seda, mis järele jäi. Õhtul — loojang mere kohal. Saun. Ice bath.Jacuzzi. Klientide tänulikud sõnad.

Omalt poolt pakume: Mida sa saad vastu?
→ Tasuta eFoil-sõit! Klientidele see maksab 200€ tunnis. Sinu jaoks — tasuta. → Töö maailma ühe coolima spordiga päikesetõusu ja -loojangu ajal → Tulemustasu + boonused → Sinu nägu on meie sotsiaalmeedia — ehitame koos brändi → Võimalus meiega kasvada — Euroopa, maailm on järgmised → Oled osa millestki, mida pole varem olnud — uue turu ehitamine

Muud nõuded: Keda me otsime?
→ Sa oled füüsiliselt aktiivne — see töö nõuab ikka jõudu, vastupidavust ja liikumist → Sa oskad hästi ujuda ja tunneksid end vabalt avatud vees → Suhtled inimestega loomulikult — see on su tugevus, mitte kohustus → Räägid eesti keelt + inglise ja boonuseks - vene keelt → Oled vastutustundlik ja rahulik ka siis, kui kõik ei lähe plaanipäraselt Me otsime inimest, kes näeb mis on vaja — ja teeb ära. Kes kliendi naeratuse nimel läheb sammu kaugemale ilma, et keegi paluks. Kes vee peal teeb kiireid otsuseid ise — rahulikult, kindlalt. Kes võtab vastutuse enda peale — mitte ei otsi, kelle peale näidata. Positiivsus ei ole siin soov. See on nõue. Energiat, initsiatiivi ja täielikku pühendumist — iga päev, mitte ainult headel päevadel. Suur boonus (aga mitte kohustuslik): → Kogemus surfimises, kite, wake, SUP või muus veespordis → Oled filminud videoid või tead, kuidas Instagram/TikTok toimib → Oled varem töötanud instruktori, giidi või teenindajana Pole kunagi eFoil'i sõitnud? Pole probleemi. Õpetame sind.

jobs.title: Director of Customer Experience
jobs.description:
About us

LifeMD is a leading provider of virtual primary care, telehealth, and specialized treatment programs serving hundreds of thousands of patients nationwide. Our vertically integrated platform combines 50-state licensed providers, in-house pharmacy and lab integrations, and proprietary technology that enables safe, high-quality, and affordable care.

At the heart of this transformation is our team of developers, engineers, and tech innovators building state-of-the-art systems that make healthcare smarter, faster, and more accessible. From architecting scalable backend systems to crafting intuitive user experiences, we are pushing boundaries every day.

Recognized as one of the fastest-growing healthcare tech companies (#166 on Deloitte Fast 500 in 2023), LifeMD is not just a healthcare company â it's a tech company revolutionizing healthcare.

About the role

LifeMD is seeking a strategic, data-obsessed Director of Customer Experience to lead and elevate our remote customer operations. This role sits at the intersection of technology, clinical empathy, and operational excellence. We are looking for someone who has built and continuously evolved high-performing, technology-enabled CX organizations; deploying AI voice and chat tools, engineering data-driven performance cultures, and creating differentiated, concierge-level experiences that drive loyalty and growth.

Reporting directly to the SVP of Operations & Patient Experience, you will translate the executive team's vision and strategy into operational reality,surfacing the voice of the customer, driving measurable performance, and partnering cross-functionally to embed customer insights into decisions across the organization. If you thrive in fast-moving health tech environments and believe exceptional customer experience is a commercial advantage, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Remote Contact Center Leadership

  • Lead, scale, and continuously optimize a remote contact center team across multiple channels (voice, chat, email, SMS). Setting KPIs, driving performance expectations, and driving continuous improvement.
  • Set and enforce service level standards, workforce management practices, scheduling, capacity models, and escalation protocols
  • Build a high-accountability, coaching-first culture across team leads and frontline agents

Customer Experience

  • Develop and maintain service blueprints and experience standards across contact and service touchpoints that transform support from a transactional function into a driver of loyalty and advocacy
  • Champion a culture of empathy, accountability, and customer-centricity across the entire CX organization

AI & Technology Integration

  • Own the performance of AI-powered support functions including AI voice (conversational IVR), chatbots, and agent-assist tools â monitoring deflection rates, containment quality, sentiment signals, and escalation patterns
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to evaluate, implement, and iterate on AI tooling that augments agent performance and improves resolution rates without sacrificing human connection
  • Ensure deep integration between CX technology and broader customer-facing platforms including EHR, CRM, and marketing automation systems
  • â¢ Stay current on emerging customer support technologies and serve as the internal subject matter expert on responsible AI use within a healthcare context

Data-Driven Performance Management

  • Define, track, and improve core CX metrics: first contact resolution, average handle time, CSAT, NPS, escalation rate, AI containment rate, retention, and reactivation
  • Monitor NPS trends surfaced through the CX function and partner with the Manager of Patient Experience to close the loop on customer feedback and drive operational improvements
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reporting cadences that provide real-time operational visibility to your team and to the SVP
  • Conduct root cause analysis on performance gaps and translate findings into structured improvement plans
  • Synthesize customer insights, VOC data, and operational trends into clear, executive-ready briefings

Commercial Impact & Customer Lifecycle

  • Align CX operations with revenue and retention goals, connecting CSAT, NPS, and resolution metrics to commercial outcomes including retention, upsell conversion, and reactivation
  • Identify patterns in customer friction that represent risk to renewal, referral, or acquisition, and advocate for fixes cross-functionally
  • Support onboarding and activation workflows that reduce time-to-value; contribute to behavioral engagement and churn prediction strategies

Quality Assurance

  • Design and maintain a rigorous QA framework covering interaction quality, compliance, empathy standards, and clinical accuracy
  • Establish calibration processes across QA reviewers to ensure scoring consistency and fairness
  • Use QA insights to inform targeted coaching, training curricula, and process improvement

Budget Management

  • Manage the CX department budget within parameters, including headcount planning, vendor contracts, and technology spend
  • Identify cost optimization opportunities without compromising service quality or customer outcomes; present trade-off analyses and recommendations

Remote Transition & Operational Build-Out

  • Lead the operational transition to a fully remote customer service model, owning the end-to-end migration across people, process, technology, and compliance workstreams
  • Partner with HR, IT, Legal, and Operations to execute the transition with minimal disruption to the customer experience, establishing remote workforce policies and tooling standards
  • Use the transition as an opportunity to redesign foundational processes and eliminate legacy inefficiencies

Team Leadership & Development

  • Recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing team of managers, team leads, QA specialists, trainers, and agents
  • Build workforce planning, career pathing, and succession pipelines within the CX organization
  • Design the management rhythms, coaching frameworks, and recognition programs that attract and retain top talent in a fully remote environment

Cross-Functional Partnership & Internal Alignment

  • Serve as a key operational partner to the Manager of Patient Experience, ensuring alignment between customer-facing service operations and the broader patient experience program
  • Collaborate closely with the Manager of Patient Experience to align on messaging touchpoints, technology integrations, and shared data â recognizing that the customer journey spans both functions and requires active coordination to deliver a coherent experience

Creative Director
jobs.description:
About The Opportunity

LMG Staffing Solutions is partnering with a collaborative, design-driven digital agency to identify a Creative Director for a contract opportunity based in Philadelphia.

This role brings together brand strategy, creative leadership, and digital expertise to help clients solve complex business challenges through compelling, human-centered experiences. You will lead the strategic and creative vision across a diverse portfolio that may include healthcare, higher education, enterprise organizations, and emerging brands.

The ideal candidate can guide engagements from discovery through execution, lead multidisciplinary teams, strengthen creative quality, and connect creative recommendations to measurable business outcomes.

What You'll Do

Strategic Brand Leadership

  • Lead the development of brand strategies, positioning, messaging frameworks, and digital experience recommendations
  • Connect strategic and creative recommendations to client goals, audience insights, and business objectives
  • Facilitate discovery sessions, stakeholder workshops, and strategic planning engagements
  • Translate research and business insights into compelling brand narratives, messaging platforms, and customer experience strategies
  • Identify opportunities across marketing, digital experiences, products, and services
  • Partner with client services teams to align recommendations with client priorities, budgets, and long-term goals

Creative Leadership

  • Establish the strategic and creative vision for client engagements
  • Develop creative briefs with clear direction, measurable objectives, and actionable guidance
  • Lead multidisciplinary teams across branding, web, UX/UI, content, digital marketing, and campaign development
  • Provide thoughtful creative direction and feedback that strengthens ideas and maintains brand integrity
  • Ensure work is strategically grounded, human-centered, and aligned with business outcomes
  • Mentor designers, writers, strategists, and other creative team members
  • Help foster a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing creative culture

Client Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to executive stakeholders and marketing leaders
  • Present creative concepts, brand strategies, and campaign recommendations with confidence
  • Facilitate conversations that connect business goals with creative opportunities
  • Build alignment across client stakeholders and internal teams
  • Collaborate with account and project management teams to support successful delivery while protecting strategic and creative integrity

Research & Strategic Planning

  • Lead stakeholder interviews, audience research, competitive analysis, surveys, and workshop facilitation
  • Synthesize complex information into clear recommendations and executive-ready presentations
  • Apply design thinking and human-centered problem-solving to uncover meaningful insights
  • Monitor trends in branding, customer behavior, digital experiences, marketing, technology, and AI-enabled solutions
  • Contribute strategic and creative thinking to new business opportunities

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience leading brand, digital, or integrated creative initiatives within an agency or consulting environment
  • Proven experience developing brand strategies, creative campaigns, digital experiences, and integrated marketing initiatives
  • Strong understanding of branding, UX/UI, web design, digital marketing, content strategy, and customer experience
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary teams across strategy, design, content, marketing, and technology
  • Exceptional storytelling, facilitation, presentation, and executive communication skills
  • Ability to translate complex business challenges into simple, compelling creative solutions
  • Experience presenting to executive leadership and facilitating strategic workshops
  • Strong understanding of modern digital ecosystems, including websites, CMS platforms, paid media, marketing automation, analytics, and emerging AI-enabled experiences
  • Collaborative leadership style grounded in curiosity, empathy, accountability, and continuous learning

Why This Role

  • Contract opportunity with a collaborative, design-driven agency
  • Lead strategic and creative work across diverse client engagements
  • Shape brand strategies, digital experiences, and integrated campaigns
  • Partner directly with executive stakeholders and marketing leaders
  • Mentor multidisciplinary creative teams and elevate creative standards
  • Contribute to new business growth and agency thought leadership
  • Balance creative excellence with measurable business impact

If you are a strategic creative leader who enjoys building brands, guiding teams, and shaping digital experiences that move organizations forward, we would love to connect.

Good job opportunities with us

We are constantly hiring people for various jobs on behalf of our customers in hotel cleaning, facility management, kitchen work, and furnishing.

We are currently looking for reinforcements in several areas in Greater Stockholm.

As an employee and customer, you can feel secure with us, as we have collective agreements and are members of Visita, Almega, and the Confederation of Swedish Enterprise.

jobs.title: Marketing Assistant
jobs.description:
Venture Media is a full-service content marketing agency. We help businesses grow through social media, podcast production, SEO and AI visibility, and full-funnel content systems. We are a small, fast-moving remote team that ships real client work every week.


The role

We are looking for a Marketing Assistant to support content production and daily execution across our client accounts and internal brands. You will keep the content engine running: scheduling posts, prepping assets, and running research. Your job will be across assistant and marketing work, so you should like variety.


Marketing expertise is a plus for this role, but it is not required. What matters most is having a basic understanding of marketing and a genuine desire to learn and develop deeper expertise. We use automation and clear systems for the heavy lifting, so your job is less about busywork and more about keeping things organized, checking quality, and helping our content and clients look great. You will work directly with the founder and learn how a modern agency runs end to end.


What you will do

  • Content coordination and publishing. Schedule and publish blogs and posts, keep our content calendar organized, and make sure everything goes out on time. Much of the writing is already automated, so your role is organizing, reviewing, and adding the final human touch.
  • Quality control. Do a first pass on assets from our editors, proofread copy and decks before they go to clients, and make sure feedback actually gets addressed.
  • Research and reporting. Run market research for projects as needed, and help pull simple analytics reports so we know what is working.
  • Social and community support. Help manage engagement and distribution across our platforms, and keep our own brand active and consistent.
  • Light marketing execution. Learn the basics of SEO and AI search visibility, and help apply them to our content. We will teach you this piece by piece.
  • General right-hand work. Jump on whatever the day needs. Some days that is research, some days it is organizing a project in our task tools, some days it is prepping something for a client.


What we are looking for

  • Bachelor's in a related field or equivalent hands-on experience
  • 1 to 2 years in a marketing, social media, communications, or administrative role, ideally at an agency 
  • Extremely organized and proactive, able to juggle multiple priorities and stay detailed under deadline
  • Comfortable with the major social platforms (Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube) and scheduling tools
  • Familiar with project management software
  • A reliable communicator who keeps managers updated and follows through without being chased
  • A flexible team player who adapts to shifting priorities and jumps in where needed
  • Clear written English and comfort in an async remote setup
  • Available during US Pacific business hours so we can work in real time
  • Dedicated to this as your main full-time focus, not a side gig


Nice to have (not required)

  • SEO or AI search visibility experience
  • Experience with task managers like ClickUp


Who this is not for

This is not a fit if you need constant hand-holding, avoid feedback, or prefer slow work with a lot of meetings. We move fast, hold clear standards, and expect you to own your tasks.


What you get

  • An hourly rate of $20 to $25 USD, based on your experience.
  • Direct mentorship from the founder and a front-row seat to how a marketing agency runs
  • Real room to grow. As we grow, you grow, in both responsibility and pay
  • A long-term home, not a short-term contract


How to apply

Submit your resume and a short note about yourself, and answer this one question: what is one thing you would most want to get better at in this role, and why?


We read every application that answers it.

jobs.title: Backend Developer
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region â this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

Â 

The Role

We are looking for backend engineers to build the core systems behind BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for engineers who can build reliable APIs, workflows and financial product infrastructure that can scale across markets, partners and millions of users.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Build backend services and APIs for onboarding, accounts, payments, cards, transfers, rewards, travel, FX, KYC and risk flows.

  • Design reliable systems that can support real customer transactions, operational workflows and future financial products.

  • Integrate with internal systems, financial partners, payment providers, AI services and third-party platforms.

  • Own backend quality across reliability, security, latency, observability, data integrity and incident handling.

  • Work with product, frontend, mobile and AI teams to launch features quickly and safely.

  • Improve existing systems by simplifying flows, removing manual work and automating repeatable processes.

    Â 

What We're Looking For

  • Strong backend engineering experience in production systems.

  • Good understanding of APIs, databases, authentication, authorization, queues, jobs, events and integrations.

  • Experience building services used by real customers or internal operations at meaningful scale.

  • Strong debugging, reliability, security and data quality mindset.

  • Able to make practical trade-offs between speed, correctness, scalability and maintainability.

  • Fintech, payments, banking, wallet, KYC, fraud or risk experience is a strong plus, but not required if fundamentals are strong.

Â 

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want isolated backend tasks.

  • People who ignore security, data consistency, monitoring or operational risk.

  • Developers who cannot work with fast-changing product requirements.

  • Candidates who talk about scale but have not handled production systems.

  • People who exaggerate impact without being clear on ownership.


The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

Â 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in India. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in India.

Â 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Â 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Technical interview

3. CEO / final round


For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Job Summary

We are MHCLG

Here at the Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government (MHCLG), we work on things that make a real difference to peopleâs lives. Whether it's through the homes we live in, the work of our local councils, or the communities weâre all part of, our work is at the top of the political agenda. We have ambitious and far-reaching outcomes to achieve, so thereâs never been a more exciting time to join us.

  • Apply for a proxy vote

jobs.title: Mezgėjas-vadybininkas
jobs.description: Darbo pobūdis apima lininių drabužių mezgimą naudojant 6 ir 8 klasės mezgimo mašinas, užtikrinant tikslų technologinių parametrų laikymąsi. Atliekamas siūlų parinkimas pagal gaminio konstrukciją ir sezoniškumą, siekiant išgauti reikiamą audinio struktūrą ir kokybę. Užtikrinama kokybės kontrolė viso proceso metu, koreguojant mezgimo įrangos nustatymus, jei to reikia. Paruošti drabužiai pateikiami pardavimui, atliekant jų fotografavimą, žymėjimą ir pristatymą klientams. Siuntas reikia supakuoti, pristatyti į siuntų terminalus arba užsakyti siuntimo paslaugas, kontaktuojant su klientais. Galimas dalinis darbas iš namų.

jobs.title: Automekaanikko, Rovaniemi
jobs.description:
StaffMill Oy (https://www.staffmill.fi/) etsii asiakkaalleen Rovaniemelle ammattitaitoista automekaanikkoa vakituiseen ja kokoaikaiseen työhön.

Työssäsi vastaat autojen monipuolisista huolto- ja korjaustöistä, ja päivittäinen arki koostuu erityisesti määräaikaishuolloista, jakopäähuolloista sekä ilmastointijärjestelmien huolloista. Lisäksi tehtäviisi kuuluu autojen sähköjärjestelmien sekä mekaanisten alustajärjestelmien vianmääritys ja korjaus. Hyödynnät työssäsi monipuolisesti autodiagnostiikan ja vianetsintälaitteiden tarjoamia työkaluja, joiden avulla paikannat viat tehokkaasti ja varmistat laadukkaan korjausjäljen.

**Odotamme sinulta:**

- Vankkaa kokemusta ja ammattitaitoa automekaanikon tehtävistä

- Autodiagnostiikan ja vianetsintälaitteiden hallintaa

- Osaamista sähkö-, hybridiajoneuvo- ja polttomoottoritekniikasta sekä mekaanisista alustajärjestelmistä

- Hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja asiakaspalvelutaitoja

- Suomen kielen taitoa

- B-ajokorttia


Eduksi katsomme englannin kielen taidon.

**Tarjoamme sinulle:**

- Luotettavan työnantajan tuen

- Nopean puhelinyhteyden mieltäsi askarruttavissa asioissa


Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa rekrytointikonsultti Anniina Ahtonen numerosta 044 323 7009 (tavoitettavissa arkisin klo 8-16).

Jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian oheisesta linkistä, käsittelemme hakemukset heti niiden saavuttua.

Sánas provides an alternative respite service for children and teenagers with intellectual disabilities and/or autism. Through our centre we provide a range of relaxing and engaging activities, as well as supporting engagement in local amenities. Job role Sánas provides alternative respite support for children and young teenagers with an intellectual disability and/or autism. The centre operates an after school and weekend service during term time, and the centre is open every day during school holidays. Through our purpose-designed centres in Finglas, Balbriggan and Wicklow, we provide an environment that promotes a range of needs, from therapeutic and relaxation to stimulating and developmental. As well as on-site engagement, we also encourage the use of local indoor and outdoor community amenities. Our team of Direct Support Workers are overseen by Senior Direct Support Workers and Team Leads who follow carefully developed person-centred plans for each person in the service. We are hiring enthusiastic people who are passionate about developing the lives of children and teenagers in their community.

Etsimme nyt sähkölaitekorjaajaa asiakasyrityksemme palvelukseen pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen pienten käsikäyttöisten sähkölaitteiden korjaus- ja huoltotehtäviin Turkuun.

Työtehtäviin kuuluu erilaisten pienlaitteiden, kuten piensähkötyökalujen mm. porakoneiden, sirkkelien ja lämmittimien korjaukset ja huollot sekä muut mahdolliset aputehtävät korjaamolla. Huolto- ja korjaustyöt tehdään asennusohjeiden mukaisesti ja työntekijä saa tarvittaessa opastusta työhönsä. Toivomme, että sinulla olisi jo jonkin verran kokemusta korjaus ja huoltotehtävistä. Eduksesi katsotaan sähköalan koulutus sekä sähkötyöturvallisuuskortti. Tarkempi työnkuva tulee muodostumaan työntekijän taitojen mukaisesti.

Sinua odottaa osaava työyhteisö, joka on tukenasi aloittaessasi tehtävässäsi. Työtehtäviin järjestetään perehdytys. Töitä tehdään arkisin yhdessä vuorossa klo 8:00 – 16:00 korjaamon tiloissa.

Tulet työllistymään vakituiseen työsuhteeseen suoraan asiakkaamme palvelukseen.

Yritys tarjoaa ammattitaitoosi perustuvan palkkauksen sekä mahdollisuuden pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen.

Kiinnostuitko työtehtävästä? Täytä työnhakulomake osoitteessa alrekry.fi!

Asiakkaamme käyttävät palveluamme työtehtävissä suorittavista tehtävistä ammattitaitoa vaativiin tehtäviin kuin myös suunnitteluun ja johtotehtäviin. Asiakkaamme ovat aktiivisia toimijoita monilta eri aloilta vahvimmin edustettuna teollisuus-, logistiikka-, tuotanto-, palvelu- ja kuljetusaloilla.

Kiinnostuitko! Jos haluat tietää enemmän, soita rohkeasti minulle ja kysy lisää. Tavoitat minut parhaiten ma - pe klo 9-14.00 välillä p.09 4542 7744 / Ida. Voit myös lähettää viestin sähköpostilla osoitteeseen hr.alrekry@alrekry.fi.

Olemme luotettava ja vakavarainen työnantaja vuodesta 2004. Toimintatapamme on tehdä parhaamme, että asiakkaamme onnistuvat tavoitteissaan. Pitkä kokemuksemme on osoittanut, että voit luottaa meihin.

jobs.title: Lagermedarbejder søges til Fiskelogistik Gruppen A/S
jobs.description:
Lagermedarbejder nathold søges – Minimum 37 timer pr. uge – Frederikshavn

Forudsætningen for at du kan søge denne stilling er at du har lastbilkørekort, samt truckcertifikat.

Jobbeskrivelse:
Arbejdet består i at modtage stykgods (fersk og frossen fisk). På lageret sorteres/ompakkes godset før det læsses på bilerne til videre distribution ud i vores rutenet.  

Du vil indgå i et team på 2 øvrige medarbejdere – som arbejder i en turnus om at dække vagterne. Den daglige arbejdstid i turnussen er fra kl. cirka 17.00 – til cirka 00.00. Herudover vagt hver anden søndag af cirka 8 timers varighed.

Den ideelle kandidat:

- Besidder relevant brancheerfaring

- Har praktisk erfaring med lastning og losning af pallegods

- Er fleksibel og møder til tiden

- Er engageret og villig til at yde en ekstra indsats

- Arbejder selvstændigt og med høj kvalitet i opgaveløsningen

- Kan fremvise en straffeattest ved ansættelse

Vi vil gerne have stabile og langvarige ansættelsesforhold.

Vi tilbyder

- Ordnede arbejdsforhold med fokus på sikkerhed og kvalitet

- Et positivt og samarbejdsorienteret arbejdsmiljø med engagerede kolleger

- Løn og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst

- Fleksible arbejdsforhold med ansvar og struktur

- Turnusordning

Fiskelogistik Gruppen A/S (FLG) er en af Danmarks førende transportvirksomheder indenfor fiskerierhvervet med fokus på indenrigsmarkedet dk-dk

Vi er en familiejet virksomhed med en stærk holdånd, et tæt fællesskab og vi sætter altid mennesket i centrum.

Fiskelogistik Gruppen er en niche virksomhed. Som national transportør er vi bevidst om vores ansvar over for vores kunder, der er afhængige af vores ydelser. Det handler om levering til tiden i den rette temperatur og fra dag til dag.

Vi har en resultatorienteret og handlingsorienteret kultur med fokus på nytænkning. Vi forventer, at alle bidrager til kulturen uafhængigt af stilling i virksomheden. Kundens rolle er central i Fiskelogistik Gruppen med fokus på kvalitet, service og fleksibilitet. Medarbejderne er den vigtigste ressource, hvilket stiller krav til medarbejderne, men giver også muligheder for udvikling og ansvar i jobbet.

Generelt hos os:

  • Frihed under ansvar i et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med meget brede rammer til at udvikle forretningen og med en kort beslutningsproces

  • Engagerede og kompetente kolleger der brænder for at gøre en forskel

  • Gode ansættelsesvilkår efter overenskomst, herunder pensionsordning, sundhedsforsikring og personaleforening, m.m.

Generelt får du en stilling i en dynamisk virksomhed med gode kolleger og med en uformel omgangstone samt humor.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.
