Junior Legal and Transactions Officer

The role will primarily include assisting our Fund Administration team in all aspects of operation and administration of a portfolio of funds and other structures (e.g. client on boarding, company secretarial, legal, corporate governance, and regulatory) mainly in the private equity and real estate sector.

The individual will assist our clients with regular transactions, preparation of board packs, coordination of board and shareholder/investor meetings, preparation of minutes, creating and updating statutory registers (e.g. directors, limited partner, and shareholder) and other transfer agency functions.  The individual will be required to attend client board and other meetings. The individual will also liaise with fund manager clients, third parties (including lawyers) and other external advisors necessary to ensure smooth operation of the client portfolio and to ensure that deadlines are met. The individual will work within a small client team, reporting on a daily basis to the relevant Langham Hall administrator, manager and director.

In conjunction with the above duties, the individual will also assist with the initial on-boarding of clients, including agreeing the service agreements.

Key Responsibilities

• Act as point of contact for client and be actively involved in assisting with transactions (e.g. investments, divestments) of real estate, private equity and debt transaction-related administration including review of legal documents and liaising with client/ legal counsel as required
• Assists in client on-boarding (drafting service agreements, preparing service level agreements, managing AML compliance process)
• Assists client in opening of bank accounts including liaising with banks and completing bank forms
• Actively involved in incorporation of Luxembourg companies/ funds including ability to liaise with the notary and review / draft articles
• Assist in organisation and co-ordination of board/ shareholder meetings (ensuring completeness of board packs, sending convening notices, agenda's)
• Drafting legal documents, preparation and review of board meeting agenda and minutes, written resolutions
• Liaise with compliance team to ensure all AML and KYC requirements for client on boarding, payments, investors admission in done on time
• Keep all shareholders and directors registers up to date and signed
• Perform all statutory filings in RCS and ensure that any and all publications are made on timely basis, for any modifications in the articles of a company and any other corporate actions requiring RCS publications
• Take ownership and responsibility of ensuring all internal electronic and paper files and updated and organised on a regular basis

Skills Knowledge and Expertise

• Graduated with Master or Bachelor's degree preferably in Legal, LLM, Corporate Law, Business Law, Commercial Law
• First experience in Corporate, Company or Fiscal law is an advantage
• Motivated and ability to work within a team and contribute towards its success in a growing team
• Highly organised and have good attention to detail
• Excellent communication skills in English, with French and German a strong asset (both written and oral).

Benefits

Langham Hall takes the development of its employees very seriously and offers sponsorship of a professional qualification (e.g. ILA Cosec Pillar 1/ ICSA) as part of the package.

About Langham Hall

Langham Hall provides premium quality accounting, fund administration and investor reporting services to Real Estate and Private Equity Fund clients.

Langham Hall invests in people and in developing them professionally.  We are extremely proud of our leadership-focused culture which fosters a dedicated, approachable and collaborative way of working.  We offer the opportunity to progress your career and study professional qualifications; through intensive training and where applicable, full exam tuition and study support.

Langham Hall is a fast-growing company and as such staff experience a variety of responsibilities and inclusion in exciting initiatives beyond their day-to-day role.  Employees are supported and encouraged to deliver a first-class service and opportunities are identified at an early stage for employees to engage with our clients which enables them feel involved and challenged in their work.

We are proud of our positive working culture which is reinforced through our employees and our extremely low staff turnover and we seek out people that believe in our values.

Learn more about Langham Hall by visiting our website: https://www.langhamhall.com/

German-speaking Assistant Manager Accounting in Luxembourg, Diekirch or Weiswampach (m/f)
BDO Luxembourg is looking for a German-speaking Assistant Manager Accounting in Luxembourg, Diekirch or Weiswampach!

Who are we?

BDO is present in over 166 countries, and we offer an extensive range of services in the areas of Audit, Tax, Advisory, Accounting, Business Services and Outsourcing.

At BDO Luxembourg, our mission is to provide our clients with our expertise of our global network tailored to the unique needs of the Luxembourgish market, delivering personalized service and building valued relationships.

With over 650 people representing more than 40 nationalities, we embrace diversity and encourage skill development and ownership among our team members.

Our core values, honesty, integrity, quality, respect, and responsibility define our culture. Hence, our People can expect to grow in a stimulating work environment that nurtures professional development and fosters inclusivity.

What will you do?

• Meet the needs of clients (mainly start-ups, large companies, SMEs, family businesses and the self-employed) with regard to accounting, tax and administrative processes, in particular by keeping day-to-day accounts, preparing tax returns and annual accounts/reports;
• Supervise the general accounting performed by your team;
• Review and finalise the preparation of annual tax returns, linked to their respective accounts;
• Be in regular and proactive contact with your clients and be committed to building long-lasting and trusting relationships with them. Your ability to anticipate and respond to their needs makes you their preferred contact;
• Be involved in improving internal and digital processes;
• Participate in the acquisition of new customers using your knowledge of your customers, the latest trends, the market and your network;
• Train, motivate and develop your team, because your own success is measured by that of your team.

This offer is for you if:

• You are a chartered accountant or you will soon be qualified;
• You will have at least 5 years' professional experience managing a portfolio of local commercial clients within a fiduciary or Big-4 firm in Luxembourg;
• Your leadership and technical expertise are recognized by your team;
• You are highly organized, detail-oriented and able to coordinate several tasks at the same time to meet deadlines;
• You have an independent, conscientious and goal-oriented mindset;
• You are fluent in French and German and possessing a good English level, knowledge of Luxembourgish is considered as an asset.

What is waiting for you:

• 13th month + performance bonus + pension plan
• Car leasing scheme, mobility budget
• Lunch vouchers
• Extra days of annual leave
• Flexible hours & homeworking
• Parking access
• Canteen on site
• Free access to our fitness room
• Career development opportunities & continuous learning and development through a wide range of trainings on technical and soft skills
• Company mobile phone and laptop

Are you willing to grow your career in a multicultural, pleasant and dynamic environment? Then, take your chance!

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

jobs.title: Head of Client Excellence (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description:

Job description

Head of Client Excellence

We are looking for an experienced Head of Client Excellence to join a RegTech company providing SaaS solutions to the financial services industry. The company supports leading asset managers, management companies, depositaries, fund administrators, and other financial institutions in managing their oversight and controls, optimizing business processes, strengthening data governance, and automating operational workflows.
Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer, this is a senior, strategic, and hands-on position combining business development, sales, client excellence, operational transformation, and consulting. The successful candidate will lead strategic initiatives aimed at improving revenue
generation, service delivery, strengthening client relationships, and driving operational excellence while contributing to the company's commercial growth.

Core Expectations

• Build trusted relationships with clients while identifying opportunities to expand existing accounts and develop new business.
• Demonstrate a strong understanding of the financial services industry, particularly the asset management ecosystem and its operational challenges.
• Combine strategic thinking with a hands-on approach and a strong sense of ownership.
• Provide strategic leadership across client excellence and professional services initiatives.
• Drive organizational improvements through process optimization, governance, and cross functional collaboration.

Key Responsibilities

New Business Development & Commercial Growth

• Actively prospecting new organizations and initiating conversations with potential clients.
• Building and managing a strong commercial pipeline through structured prospecting, relationship development, and disciplined follow-up.
• Owning the full sales cycle, from initial engagement and solution presentation through negotiation and closing.
• Developing compelling business cases and demonstrating value to senior business and technical stakeholders.
• Setting and achieving ambitious business development targets linked to revenue growth and market expansion.
• Monitoring market trends, competitor positioning, and evolving clients needs to identify new opportunities.
• Supporting account expansion strategies, including upselling, cross-selling, and partner-led opportunities where relevant.
• Identify and develop new business opportunities within the financial services industry.

Strategic Leadership & Operational Excellence

• Drive process optimization initiatives that improve efficiency, scalability, and service quality.
• Implement practical governance and reporting frameworks to support operational performance and decision-making.
• Develop KPIs and performance metrics to monitor delivery, resource utilization, and client outcomes.
• Promote a culture of continuous improvement through structured feedback and best practice sharing.

Consultancy & Client Excellence

• Lead strategic initiatives to continuously improve client experience and professional services delivery.
• Act as a trusted advisor to internal stakeholders, supporting organizational transformation and change management initiatives.
• Develop scalable operating models, delivery standards, and best practices to enhance consistency and efficiency.
• Foster collaboration across Professional Services, Product, Commercial, and Technology teams to ensure seamless client delivery.
• Monitor delivery performance and recommend improvements to maximize client satisfaction and operational effectiveness.

Contracts, licensing, pricing and commercial models

• High familiarity and experience with making commercial proposals to customers.
• Have contracts and contract management in the fingers.
• Be able to seamlessly apply and guard licensing, pricing and contracting practices of the company.
• Can create new commercial models if and when needed.

Profile

Professional Qualifications

• Master's degree in business, Finance, Engineering, Management, or a related field.
• 5+ years of experience in consulting, professional services, business transformation, client success, or strategic leadership roles.
• Experience in process optimization, organizational improvement, and operational excellence.
• Good knowledge of the financial services industry, particularly asset management, including its operating models, regulatory environment, and key market participants.
• Experience working with SaaS, RegTech, FinTech, or technology-enabled services is highly desirable.
• Commercial mindset with experience developing client relationships and contributing to business growth.
• Familiarity with Agile methodologies and project management tools (e.g. Jira, Confluence) is an advantage.
• Excellent communication skills in English; French or any additional language is considered an asset.

Personal Characteristics

• Strategic, hands-on, and results-oriented with a strong sense of ownership.
• Excellent relationship builder, able to influence stakeholders at all organizational levels.
• Client-focused with a consultative mindset and a passion for delivering value.
• Entrepreneurial, proactive, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate ideas into practical solutions.
• Highly communicative, team player with other functions such as Product and Finance, and dares to challenge customers by protecting the interest of the company when needed.
• High level of integrity, accountability, and collaborative spirit.

jobs.title: Business Manager - Finance (m/f)
jobs.description:
Business Manager - Finance (M/F)

Luxembourg | req1130

BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

We are hiring a Business Manager to work directly with the Chief Finance Officer, a member of the Executive Committee. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role that blends strategic insight, operational execution, and stakeholder engagement across the bank's finance landscape.
Your next challenge:

1. Strategic Insight & Information Management

• Structure complex topics, challenge assumptions, and prepare forward-looking positions.
• Monitor internal and external developments (e.g. market trends, industry shifts, regulatory changes, finance trends) and flag relevant risks or opportunities.
• Research and prepare materials, briefings, and presentations on diverse topics - either proactively or at the Executive's request.

2. Operational Support & Execution

• Prepare high-quality content (slides, briefings, memos) and coordinate inputs from across the business line.
• Ensure the Executive is fully briefed for meetings and urgent topics.
• Coordinate and participate in meetings, taskforces, and workgroups - internally and externally - ensuring follow-up on action items.
• Synthesize workshop documentation and ensure the Executive is always well-prepared.

3. Stakeholder Management & Communication

• Act as a trusted liaison between the Executive and internal/external stakeholders.
• Build a strong network within the Executive's departments and across the bank.
• Facilitate alignment, cascade key messages, and ensure two-way communication across N-1/N-2 levels.
• Identify conflicts, flag issues for intervention, and engage in brainstorming sessions with the Executive.

4. Project Leadership

• Independently lead and drive complex, high-stakes projects aligned with the Executive's strategic priorities.
• Take ownership of key issues before escalation and proactively propose solutions.
• Demonstrate initiative, problem-solving, and leadership readiness.
• Deepen your business acumen and gain a comprehensive understanding of the business line's functioning.

Your skills:

• Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering - or equivalent.
• Minimum 6 years of experience in banking, finance or a relevant strategic role, ideally with a consulting background.
• Strong analytical skills and advanced Excel proficiency.
• Solid understanding of finance.
• Fluent in French and English; additional languages are a plus.
• Strong knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and project management.
• Excellent communication and presentation skills: Ability to convey complex information clearly and persuasively in both written and verbal formats.

This includes preparing and delivering impactful presentations to diverse audiences, ensuring clarity and strategic alignment.

• Politically astute, discreet, and capable of navigating complex stakeholder environments.
• Dynamic, proactive, and willing to go the extra mile.
• Solution-oriented with complex problem-solving and critical thinking skills.

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.

BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

NB: The selected candidate will be asked to provide an extract from the criminal record (no.3) as evidence of integrity and justified with regard to the specific needs of the position to be filled. Other documents will be collected, to the extent legally permitted, to perform background checks.

jobs.title: DMLRO (m/f)
jobs.description:
MLRO

Luxembourg
Hybrid - 3 days in the office, 2 from home

We are an energetic and collaborative compliance team operating in a fast-paced environment, where no two days are the same, handling a wide range of cases and queries submitted by all departments while ensuring we consistently meet our regulatory obligations. As the business continues to grow, we are expanding the team to support increasing volumes of escalations, working closely with colleagues across different 3S Money jurisdictions. This role requires strong attention to detail, a proactive mindset, and confidence in communicating with stakeholders at all levels. As a MLRO, you will support the wider compliance team with financial crime investigations and contribute to wider compliance activities, alongside managing ad hoc tasks as required.

Our Mission

3S Money is reinventing international finance. Founded in 2018, our mission is to help growing businesses securely send, receive and exchange money in over 65 currencies, across 190 countries. With offices in seven countries and over 200 employees, you'll be joining a high-energy, high-impact team that's achieved profitability and has a wealth of opportunity ahead.

Our Culture

We value and pride ourselves on caring personally, staying curious and achieving impact through collaboration, not competition. We're ambitious and pride ourselves on ownership for our roles and growth, where hierarchy is minimal, giving everyone a voice to drive positive change.

What You'll Be Doing

• Demonstrating strong knowledge and practical application of Luxembourg AML/CFT, sanctions and financial crime requirements applicable to a CSSF-regulated electronic money institution, including the Law of 12 November 2004, CSSF Regulation 12-02, relevant CSSF circulars and guidance, the Law of 10 November 2009 on payment services, and applicable EU regulations.
• Developing and maintaining strong knowledge of EU and Luxembourg sanctions and restrictive measures requirements, including UN sanctions as implemented in Luxembourg, and understanding UK and US sanctions regimes where relevant for group risk, correspondent banking, counterparties, transactions or contractual obligations.
• Confidently working with other senior management to provide up-to-date information for risk management and sanctions compliance and helping conduct assessments to measure any potential risk impacts to 3s Money.
• Contributing to or leading awareness-raising and training for the first and second line of defence staff, including formal classroom training, workshop sessions, or informal Q&A sessions.
• Undertaking special projects as needed or supporting the financial crime operations team on targeted risk issue remediation, taking ownership of specific tasks.
• Reviewing compliance onboarding practices and documentation, liaising with the business as required, and making recommendations for improvements.
• Supporting the CCO with the review, escalation and reporting of suspicious activity to the Luxembourg FIU, including preparation and documentation of internal suspicious activity reports, STR/SAR decisions, client exit recommendations, and related audit trail.
• Communicating compliance and risk management requirements to internal and external clients, addressing queries and concerns, and assisting with the delivery of staff training.
• Working closely with the CCO to ensure that all local requirements pertaining to Compliance and Financial Crime are closely tracked for changes, maintaining awareness of regulatory and legal changes in the Financial Crime space, and providing timely updates.
• Acting as a delegated point of contact for Luxembourg authorities, including the CSSF and Luxembourg FIU.

What we're looking for

You are an experienced professional working in fintech or traditional banking preferably with a thorough knowledge of the financial crime risks which arise from corporate, institutional, or small-medium sized entities. Experience in correspondent banking, trade or merchant banking is a plus.

You have a deep understanding of EU and UK regulations, industry standards and best practices. In addition:

• Strong knowledge of Luxembourg AML/CFT and sanctions requirements applicable to CSSF-regulated financial sector professionals, ideally including experience with payment institutions, electronic money institutions, fintechs, correspondent/payment flows, trade-related payments, and corporate client risk.
• Experience dealing with Luxembourg regulatory expectations, CSSF requests, FIU reporting, suspicious activity reviews, customer exits, enhanced due diligence, sanctions escalation, and audit-ready case documentation.
• At least 5 years of relevant work experience / Financial Crime experience.
• Ability to escalate risks promptly and appropriately and/or failure of standards to be met, to management.
• Ability to analyse reports, identify failings and notify same together with recommendations for remediation.
• Ability to multi-task and work to tight deadlines.
• High ethical standards with the ability to handle sensitive and confidential matters with absolute discretion.
• You are fluent in English; with any European language as an excellent benefit to the team.
• Knowledge of the UK and EU regulatory environment and key financial crime regimes, and emerging trends. Any specialism in EU, UK or US sanctions regimes is a plus.

In return for your hard work

• Competitive Salary + Stock options (after 12 months) + Local Benefits
• Clear progression opportunities within a high-performance environment where results are recognised and rewarded
• Hybrid working setup in our wonderful city-centre office
• We foster non-BAU projects in our team, we want you to explore new avenues and expand your expertise to benefit your professional pathway & our teams
• And much, much more...

Our commitment to you

We are an equal opportunities employer

We make recruiting decisions based on your skills and experience. Our passion and focus will always be to work with the best people. We're creating services for everyone, so it's imperative we work with everyone. Our diverse team has been the foundations to our success in building more efficient products, making better decisions and establishing an inclusive place to work.

jobs.title: Electro-Mechanical Engineer (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
Description de tâches:
About HITEC Founded in 1986, HITEC is a 100%-owned Luxembourg engineering and technology company with around 60 employees, designing and building high-technology solutions across satellite ground segment, mission-critical communications, industrial testing and measuring equipment, and intelligent traffic management systems. With a multi-disciplinary, client-centric approach, we serve private, institutional and public-sector clients nationally and internationally, in more than 30 countries.The successful candidate will work on the following product lines: satellite ground segment equipment, industrial testing instruments and mission-critical systems, across the full development cycle from concept, design and dimensioning to commissioning, testing and validation.
Your Activities
· Dimension and select motion related components such as motors, drive systems, controllers, motion safety components
· Design, dimension, implement, test and maintain electro-mechanical and motion-control solutions, including PLC code, for internal products and external customers
· Provide design and analysis services supporting product development across HITEC's business units, in close collaboration with mechanical engineering
· Actively support the testing process by maintaining and driving functional tests, using existing or new test plans
· Define, document, implement and test new features and technologies in existing or new products
· Start-up in-house designed machinery and commercial components
· Contribute to technical documentation and to the team's technology survey activities
· Occasional travel abroad (approximately 10 to 20%) for supplier and customer site visits, installations or commissioning may be required
· Interact with internal and external customers, partners and suppliers to support, integrate and promote HITEC's electrical and automated solutions
· Help develop and put in place best practices in product design and verification
· Pro-actively introduce, document and disseminate new technologies and concepts as part of the team's technology survey activities
· Collaborate across electrical, mechanical and software engineering within our small and cross-functional team Your Profile
· Engineer, Master's degree in electrical or automation engineering
· Control theory background and knowledge of PLC programming languages (PLCopen Structured Text)
· Knowlege of PC-based programming languages (Java, C++, C or Python) is considered a plus
· At least 5 years of relevant experience, including electro-mechanical devices such as electrical motors and power electronics
· A good understanding of safety risks related to electro-mechanical machinery and the related electrical safety concepts to address them
· Comfortable working in an English-speaking environment, including technical discussions and documentation; French, German or Luxembourgish considered a plus
· Ability to adapt to new situations and work with a variety of stakeholders and partners Why Join HITEC? A small, cross-functional teamThe engineering teams being relatively compact means that you will work across the full lifecycle of a product rather than one narrow task, that you are exposed to adjacent disciplines (electrical, mechanical, software), and people who join the team typically take on broader or more senior responsibilities faster than in larger organisations.
4 main fields of activity
HITEC Luxembourg develops, produces and maintains Satellite Ground Segment solutions for space and satellite applications used in commercial, defence and scientific projects. Over the past 25 years, we have provided numerous projects within Europe, from the tropics to the polar regions, ensuring secured and reliable operations for our customers.
The company develops and produces industrial Testing Instruments used in R&D and in quality control to measure physical properties of rubber fillers and battery materials. Being a reference on the market, our instruments are used worldwide by all major producers and users of these materials to ensure compliance with ASTM standards.
The Mission Critical offering enables organizations to communicate, collaborate and maintain real-time situational awareness when it matters most. From emergency response and defense operations to critical infrastructure and public safety, our solutions provide secure and resilient connectivity, enabling teams to access, share and act on critical information wherever they operate, even in the most challenging environments.
The Traffic Management department provides engineering and maintenance services for intelligent transportation systems. We design and implement cutting-edge smart mobility solutions that improve road safety, optimize traffic flow, and support sustainable transportation strategies for connected and autonomous mobility, while ensuring the reliability and performance of road infrastructure.

For this Graphic Designer, with 5+ years of experience, the compensation range is $2,500 - $3,333 USD GROSS per month as a contractor. This range is designed to accommodate early-career professionals and reflects the foundational skills and potential for growth within the role.

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Graphic Designer who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ to join our dynamic team . This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

In this role, you will be instrumental in crafting visually compelling designs that resonate with our brandâs ethos and captivate our target audience. As a Graphic Designer at Sezzle, you will work closely with the marketing, product and even sales teams to produce high-quality visuals that drive engagement and elevate our brand presence across different digital platforms.

What You'll Do:

  • Visual Branding: Follow brand guidelines to develop and maintain consistent visual branding across all channels, including websites, email, print, and sales decks.
  • Creative Design: Conceptualize and design graphics for various marketing efforts, including in-app banners, emails, landing pages, sales decks, and display ads.

What We Look For:

Why Sezzle?

  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

jobs.title: Human Resources Generalist
jobs.description:
Title: HR Generalist/Recruiter

Location: Remote (Washington State preferred)

6 month contract to hire

Pay: $30-32/hr


Required Skills & Experience


Qualifications:

- 3+ years of experience in Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, or a combined HR/Recruiting role.

- Experience managing payroll, benefits administration, and employee lifecycle processes.

- Proven full-cycle recruiting experience.

- Strong knowledge of employment laws and HR best practices.

- Experience with HRIS, payroll, and applicant tracking systems.

- Excellent communication, organizational, and relationship-building skills.

- Experience recruiting within legal, immigration, professional services, or consulting environments is preferred.


Job Description


Our client is seeking an HR Generalist & Recruiter to oversee all aspects of people operations and recruiting. This role is a 50/50 blend of Human Resources and Talent Acquisition, supporting a remote workforce while helping attract, hire, and retain top talent across legal, immigration, and business operations functions. The ideal candidate is a hands-on HR professional who is equally comfortable managing payroll and benefits as they are sourcing and recruiting candidates. This individual will serve as a trusted partner to leadership and help build scalable people processes to support continued growth.


Key Responsibilities:


Human Resources

- Administer employee benefits programs, enrollments, and employee support.

- Coordinate payroll processing and ensure accurate employee records.

- Manage workforce planning, employee onboarding, and offboarding activities.

- Maintain compliance with federal, state, and local employment laws.

- Support employee relations, performance management, and policy administration.

- Maintain HRIS and employee documentation.

- Partner with leadership on workforce management and organizational planning.


Talent Acquisition

- Lead full-cycle recruiting for legal, immigration, paralegal, attorney, case management, and corporate support positions.

- Partner with hiring managers to define hiring needs and recruitment strategies.

- Source, screen, interview, and coordinate candidates throughout the hiring process.

- Manage job postings, applicant tracking systems, and recruiting metrics. - Build talent pipelines for future hiring needs.

- Create a positive candidate experience and strengthen the employer brand.


Benefits packages for this role will start on the 1st day of employment and include medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as HSA, FSA, and DCFSA account options, and 401k retirement account access with employer matching. Employees in this role are also entitled to paid sick leave and/or other paid time off as provided by applicable law

jobs.title: TEHNIČAR/KA NA PAKIRANJU – ELEKTRIČAR/KA - MEHANIČAR/KA
jobs.description:
HRVATSKI DUHANI dd dio su grupe British American Tobacco, jedne od vodećih svjetskih multinacionalnih kompanija u području duhanske industrije. Zahvaljujući našim zaposlenicima nastavili smo rasti, stoga tražimo motiviranu i odgovornu osobu za rad na poziciji: Tehničar/ka na pakiranju – Električar/ka Mehaničar/ka Glavne odgovornosti i zadaci:
  • Zadužen za održavanje linije strojeva obrade duhana i otklanjanje pronađenih nedostataka najranije moguće
  • Većinu radnog vremena za vrijeme obrade duhana provodi na linijama pakiranja , a po potrebi pomaže ostalim članovima odjela održavanja u provođenju radnih zadataka prema potrebi na drugim linijama u pogonu, uključujući linije sjetve i otkupa duhana, te sustave zbrinjavanja otpada, hlađenja i grijanja, zraka, vodovoda i elektroinstalacija
  • Upravljanje hidrauličnom prešom gotovog proizvoda - Automatski/Ručni mod
  • Popravak i remont linija obrade duhana, linija sjetve i otkupa duhana
  • Rad na čišćenju u II smjeni, po potrebi otklanjanje manjih kvarova
  • Svakodnevno provjeravanje podešenosti strojeva, te izvršenje potrebnih postavki (IWS)
  • Svakodnevno kontroliranje ispravnosti vezačica izlaznih proizvoda (SIGNODE), kao i zamjena povezne trake nakon potrošene
  • Rastavljanje strojeva u slučaju potrebe, popravak i zamjena neispravnih komponenti strojeva
  • Izvršava preventivne i interventne radove održavanja električnih i mehaničkih instalacija, sustava automatske kontrole i električnih motora
  • Prati rad, funkcionalnost i stanje električne i mehaničke opreme na tvorničkoj razini
  • Održavanje, popravci i zamjena električnih i mehaničkih komponenata i sklopova na opremi iz svog djelokruga.
  • Radi na remontu pogona obrade duhana (GLT), linija otkupa duhana i linija sjetve duhana
  • Redovno provjerava radno stanje opreme, radi tehnička podešavanja, obavještava Voditelja održavanja o uočenim problemima
  • Odgovoran za funkcionalnost opreme
Uvjeti
  • Potrebna stručna sprema: SSS-srednja stručna sprema
  • Zahtijevana struka: Tehničke struke, elektro ili mehaničkog smjera
  • Radno iskustvo: Najmanje tri godine radnog iskustva u struci
Prednosti
  • Sposobnost brze identifikacije i problema rješavanja
  • Iskustvo u razumijevanju tehničke dokumentacije
  • Položen ATK ispit stručni ATK ispit strojara kotlovskog postrojenja i pripreme vode
  • Odgovornog odnosa s mogućnošću prioriteta rada i planiranja unaprijed
  • Može raditi pod pritiskom i učinkovito upravljati vremenom
  • Izvrsna sposobnost vođenja evidencije
  • Komunikacijske vještine
  • Fleksibilnost
  • Sposobnost da se sam motivira i motivira druge
  • Sposobnost postavljanja prioriteta
  • Sposobnost rada u timu
  • Tehnička obuka za GLT strojeve
  • Razumijevanje sustava održavanja
  • Vozački ispit: Kategorija B
Nudimo pogodnosti i pogodnosti:
  • Briga o zdravlju: dopunsko i dodatno zdravstveno osiguranje (sistematski i specijalistički pregledi i slično), osiguranje zaposlenika od nezgode (24/7), besplatno korištenje teretane.
  • Financijske pogodnosti: Božićnica, regres za godišnji odmor, naknada za podmirivanje troškova prehrane, potpora za rođenje djeteta, naknada za troškove prijevoza,
  • Priznanja i nagrade: godišnji bonus, godišnja korekcija plaće, razna nefinacijska nagrađivanja putem nominacija za prepoznavanje truda i postignuća.
  • Balans privatnog i poslovnog: plaćeni i neplaćeni dopust za razne osobne potrebe, slobodan radni dan povodom rođendana zaposlenika, skraćeni petak, razna online savjetovanja za zaposlenike i programi pomoći te savjetovanja za razne životne teme.
  • Okruženje koje pokreće: podršku od strane kolega i voditelja, kontinuirani razvoj kroz stručno usavršavanje, obilježavanje događaja gdje slavimo uspjeh i izražavamo zahvalnost prema našim zaposlenicima.
Trajanje ugovora: Na određeno vrijeme na 3 mjeseca s mogućnošću zasnivanja radnog odnosa na neodređeno vrijeme. Raspon bruto I plaće: 1.080,00 – 1.350,00 € Životopis i molbu dostaviti na e-mail adresu: uz obaveznu naznaku u naslovu mail-a za koji točno natječaj se prijavljujete. Prijavite se na oglas i pridružite se uspješnoj međunarodnoj grupi. Veselimo se Vašoj prijavi!

jobs.title: Global Mobility Vendor Management Professional (w/m/d) (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
jobs.description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Global Mobility Vendor Management Professional (w/m/d) und verstärken Sie unser Center of Excellence. In dieser Funktion übernehmen Sie die operative Steuerung, Governance und Optimierung von externen Dienstleistern, die internationale Mitarbeitereinsätze und globale Mobilitätsservices unterstützen.

Die Rolle kombiniert die direkte Verantwortung für ausgewählte Dienstleister und Servicebereiche (z. B. Relocation, Umzugs- und Destination Services) mit der operativen Steuerung und Governance von Dienstleistern in Leistungsbereichen, die von globalen Fachexperten (Subject Matter Experts) verantwortet werden (z. B. Steuern, Immigration/Aufenthaltsrecht, Sozialversicherung usw.).

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Bevorzugte Standorte für diese Position sind Deutschland, Portugal und Polen. Bewerbungen aus anderen Ländern der EMEA-Region (Europa, Naher Osten und Afrika) können ebenfalls berücksichtigt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- Sie stellen einheitliche Governance-Standards über das gesamte Dienstleisterportfolio hinweg sicher.- Sie steuern die täglichen Beziehungen zu den Ihnen zugeordneten Service Providern und stellen sicher, dass die Leistungserbringung den geschäftlichen Anforderungen entspricht.- Sie übernehmen die Rolle des primären fachlichen Verantwortlichen für ausgewählte Dienstleisterkategorien (z. B. Relocation-, Umzugs- und Destination-Services).- Sie definieren und überwachen die Leistung der Dienstleister anhand vertraglicher Verpflichtungen durch SLAs, KPIs und Scorecards und führen regelmäßige operative Reviews sowie Leistungsgespräche durch.- Sie fungieren als Eskalationsinstanz für dienstleisterbezogene Service-Themen und treiben die Lösung von Problemen, Ursachenanalysen (Root-Cause-Analysen) sowie Korrekturmaßnahmen voran.- Sie treiben Initiativen zur Konsolidierung und Rationalisierung von Dienstleistern voran, um die Lieferantenlandschaft zu vereinfachen, Effizienzsteigerungen zu erzielen, Kosten zu senken und die Employee Experience zu verbessern.- Sie unterstützen die Implementierung von Verträgen und stellen sicher, dass vertragliche Vereinbarungen operativ umgesetzt werden, einschließlich der Einrichtung von Abrechnungsstrukturen, Bestellprozessen, Kostenallokationen und der Rechnungsprüfung.- Sie erhöhen die finanzielle Transparenz innerhalb des Global-Mobility-Portfolios.- Sie arbeiten eng mit Einkauf, Finanzen, Recht, HR und weiteren Stakeholdern in Bezug auf Dienstleisterperformance, Rechnungsgenauigkeit, Vertragsverlängerungen und Beschaffungsentscheidungen zusammen.- Sie unterstützen Compliance-, Risikomanagement- und Audit-Anforderungen und gewährleisten die Kontinuität der Dienstleisterleistungen in Veränderungsphasen.- Sie identifizieren Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung von Vendor-Management-Prozessen, Governance-Rahmenwerken, Reporting-Strukturen und der Servicebereitstellung.

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über einen Masterabschluss in Betriebswirtschaftslehre oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet.- Sie bringen mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung im Vendor Management, in HR Operations, Shared Services, Global Mobility oder im Professional-Services-Umfeld mit.- Bewerberinnen und Bewerber mit einem Bachelorabschluss und zusätzlicher einschlägiger Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich sind ebenfalls herzlich willkommen.- Sie verfügen über nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Steuerung und dem Management ausgelagerter Dienstleister in einem komplexen internationalen Umfeld.- Sie besitzen ein fundiertes Verständnis von Service Delivery, Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), Governance-Strukturen und Performance Management.- Sie haben Erfahrung in der bereichsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit mit Teams aus Einkauf, Finanzen, Recht, HR, IT, Risiko- und Compliance-Management.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit abgeschlossener Berufsaus- und Weiterbildung in Verbindung mit zusätzlich langjähriger Berufserfahrung und weiteren Qualifikationen in diesem Bereich.

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.- Sie besitzen ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten sowie eine starke Kompetenz in den Bereichen Problemlösung, Stakeholder-Management und Kommunikation.- Sie sind in der Lage, operative Detailarbeit mit strategischem Überblick zu verbinden und dabei kontinuierliche Verbesserungen voranzutreiben.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Besuchen Sie auch unsere Karriere-Seite unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
Wir legen Wert auf Diversität und Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen mit vielfältigen Hintergründen und insbesondere von Menschen mit Behinderung. #myabilityshs
Sie möchten mehr erfahren und erste Fragen gern persönlich klären – Sprechen Sie uns an: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com. Kontaktperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist Klaus Kouril.
Wir nehmen den Schutz Ihrer Daten und die Einhaltung der DSGVO und anderer Datenschutzgesetze ernst. Deshalb bitten wir Sie, uns Ihren Lebenslauf nicht per E-Mail zu schicken. Bitte legen Sie ein Profil in unserer Talent Community an, um Ihren Lebenslauf hochzuladen. Daran erkennen wir, dass Sie an Karrieremöglichkeiten bei uns interessiert sind und können Sie zu relevanten Stellen benachrichtigen. Klicken Sie hier (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/de_DE/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) , um ein Profil anzulegen.

An alle Personalvermittlungsagenturen:
Die Personalbeschaffung bei Siemens Healthineers wird intern verwaltet. Externe Unterstützung ist nur dann gestattet, wenn eine qualifizierte Agentur einen formellen Vertrag mit uns abgeschlossen hat. Unaufgeforderte Bewerbungen und Empfehlungen von Kandidatenprofilen ohne aktuelle Lieferantenvereinbarung begründen keine Zustimmung und sind somit nicht gebührenpflichtig. Wir löschen und vernichten nicht angeforderte Informationen und empfehlen, von derartigen Praktiken abzusehen. Wir danken Ihnen für die Einhaltung unserer Richtlinien.

Siemens Healthineers Deutschland wurde mit dem Zertifikat Great Place to Work® ausgezeichnet.

jobs.title: Payroll Manager (German Payroll) (Lohn- und Gehaltsbuchhalter/in)
jobs.description:
Viking is a global leader in experiential travel with a fleet of more than 100 ships, exploring 21 rivers, five oceans and all seven continents. Designed for curious travelers with interests in science, history, culture and cuisine, Chairman and CEO Torstein Hagen often says Viking offers experiences For The Thinking Person™. Viking has more than 450 awards to its name, including being rated #1 for Rivers and #1 for Oceans five years in a row by Condé Nast Traveler in the 2025 Readers’ Choice Awards. Viking is also rated a “World’s Best” by Travel + Leisure—no other travel company has simultaneously received such honors by both publications.  

Please note that we can only accept applicants who are eligible to work in Switzerland or in possession of a valid work permit.

ROLE DESCRIPTION

The Payroll Manager is responsible for the end‑to‑end German payroll process for approximately 700 employees. The role reports to the Senior Payroll Manager and is based at our Operational Headquarters in Basel, Switzerland.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Responsible for the monthly payroll run in SAP and SuccessFactors
- Recording and reviewing ongoing wage changes in master data and variable payroll data
- Verification of master data for new hires, departures, and changes
- Monthly reports to health insurance, social security institutions, as well as the relevant tax office
- Reporting accident reports to the relevant employers' liability insurance association
- Communication with authorities and insurance companies, including preparation of employer certificates
- Handling and responding to all payroll‑related inquiries
- Assessment of employment relationships regarding social security, particularly for new hires
- Monthly preparation of payroll‑related reports
- Identify and resolve system-related issues, coordinate with the payroll support team by opening and tracking tickets and testing implemented system changes
- Providing data for social security and tax audits
- Supporting the team in various administrative tasks as well as HR projects and process improvements

KEY QUALIFICATIONS

- Several years of professional experience in German Payroll
- Advanced knowledge in German wage tax, social security regulations and labor law
- Strong skills in MS‑Office, with a particular focus on Excel (e.g. Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, data analysis …)
- Advanced experience with SAP
- Strong affinity for the technical aspects of SAP, with a proactive mindset toward problem-solving and system optimization
- Fluent in German and English, both written and spoken
- Independent, precise and reliable way of working
- Committed, flexible and team-oriented personality

EDUCATION

- Completed commercial education and further training in payroll / social insurance or at least 6 years of professional experience in Payroll

NICE TO HAVE QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience in German Payroll within an international environment
- Experience with SuccessFactors

COMMUNITY & CULTURE

- Fast-growing and dynamic environment, a modern workspace, flexible working hours

HOW TO APPLY
Please apply via our website www.vikingcareers.com (https://www.vikingcareers.com/) , including your CV in English and a one-page cover letter to introduce yourself and your interest for the role.  

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Personalverwaltung, SAP-Basis-System, Arbeitsrecht, SAP SuccessFactors
Expertenkenntnisse: Abrechnung, Personalwesen, Buchführung, Buchhaltung, Sozialversicherungsrecht
Zwingend erforderlich: Lohn- und Gehaltsbuchhaltung, -abrechnung, Lohn-, Einkommensteuer

jobs.title: Risk Manager Power & Gas (m/w/d) Trading (Risk-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Die team Gruppe kümmert sich mit rund 5.000 Mitarbeitenden um die Grundbedürfnisse aller Menschen: Ob es um die Ernährung, die Gestaltung von Wohn- und Lebensräumen oder um Energie für den Alltag geht. Als wichtiger Teil dieser Gruppe bietet die team SE mit ihren rund 350 engagierten Mitarbeitenden zentrale Dienstleistungen, die diese Mission in allen Geschäftsbereichen der team Gruppe vorantreiben.

In dieser Rolle übernimmst du eine zentrale Verantwortung für die Risikosteuerung im Energiehandel. Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Power‑ und Gas‑Portfolios über Ländergrenzen hinweg transparent, kontrolliert und im Einklang mit der konzernweit definierten Risikobereitschaft gesteuert werden.

Deine Aufgaben:

- Überwachung von Commodity-, Markt-, Kredit- und operationellen Risiken für Strom, Gas und Zertifikate (GO’s, VERs, Biomethan, EUA2) sowie tägliche Steuerung der Clearing‑Konten
- Entwicklung und Pflege von Exposure‑Reports & Dashboards für eine transparente und granulare Risikoübersicht in Echtzeit
- Durchführung von Stresstests, Szenarioanalysen und Backtesting zur Bewertung potenzieller Verluste und Treasury‑Auswirkungen
- Modellierung und Controlling von Risikoparametern (Spot, Ausgleichsenergie, Hedging, Volatilität, Margin)
- Validität Price-Forward-Curve
- Entwicklung von Modellen und Prozessen zur besseren Risikokontrolle
- Sicherstellung regulatorischer Compliance (z.B. REMIT, MiFIR, MiFID, usw.) sowie Governance über Limits, Handelskontrollen und Eskalationsprotokolle
- Bewertung von risikoadjustierter Performance (VaR, Margin‑at‑Risk, P&L‑Attribution)

Dein Profil:

- Abgeschlossenes Studium in Finance, Wirtschaft, Mathematik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Risikomanagement von Energiehandel (Power & Gas)
- Fundierte Kenntnisse in VaR, Margin-at-Risk, Stresstests, Backtesting
- Sicherer Umgang mit Risikomanagement-Software und Datenanalyse-Tools
- Analytische Fähigkeiten, Detailgenauigkeit und starke Entscheidungsstärke
- Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch und Deutsch sowie Teamfähigkeit
- Du bringst Kenntnisse in Datenmodellierung und Systemintegration mit
-
Starte zum nächstmöglichen Termin in eine spannende und unbefristete Vollzeitstelle in Hamburg oder Fredericia und werde Teil der dynamischen Welt des Power & Gas Tradings – wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Disposer de connaissances et savoirs faire en électricité / électrotechnique, à minima un Bac pro MELEC ou acquis par l'expérience

Une bonne aisance relationnelle et le sens des responsabilités
Etre inscrit.e à France Travail

Un échange téléphonique avec notre Chargé.e de recrutement
Des tests de prérequis (électricité et logique) et un entretien de motivation en face à face
La validation de votre candidature

Compter environ deux mois de délai entre votre entretien et votre intégration dans la formation.

Ensemble, remplissons notre devoir avec détermination et passion !

jobs.title: Sourcing Manager, Corporate Services
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is growing quickly, and our Corporate Services needs are becoming more complex. We’re looking for a Sourcing Manager, Corporate Services to own strategic sourcing and supplier management across critical areas of our company.

In this role, you’ll partner closely with Finance, Legal, InfoSec, Privacy, IT, Compliance, HR, and Facilities to lead sourcing processes, negotiate commercial terms, manage supplier performance, and help teams make clear decisions across cost, quality, speed, risk, and experience.

We’re opening this role to bring strategic sourcing support earlier into the decision-making process, helping leaders clarify the right approach, surface trade-offs, and move faster with confidence as Notion scales. Done well, this role will drive savings and cost avoidance while helping us build supplier agreements that protect the business and support how our teams work.

You’ll be a close partner to our HR and Facilities teams in particular, building sourcing plans that translate business needs into the right supplier strategy, sourcing motion, and negotiation posture.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Deliver measurable savings and cost avoidance across Corporate Services spend, helping fund new initiatives while protecting service quality.

 - Build strategic procurement plans with business partners, starting with HR and Facilities/Real Estate, translating business needs into clear sourcing strategies and negotiation plans.

 - Operate as an extension of stakeholder teams—surfacing trade-offs early, aligning on decisions, and driving clean execution without last-minute fire drills.

 - Partner closely with Legal and Finance to structure deals the business can live with: clear commercial terms, understood budget impacts, and risk-aware contracting.

 - Reduce risk across our vendor portfolio by strengthening contract coverage, supplier governance, and performance management routines.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - 5+ years of experience in sourcing, procurement, category management, or a related field, including 3+ years owning Corporate Services categories such as Facilities/Real Estate, HR Services, Travel, Marketing Services, or Contingent Workforce.

 - Experience independently leading complex sourcing events end to end, including RFx, supplier evaluations, commercial negotiations, and contract execution.

 - Strong business judgment and analytical rigor, including spend analysis, benchmarking, building business cases, and measuring savings/cost avoidance.

 - Deep understanding of source to contract and procure to pay practices, with the ability to guide teams through intake, approvals, vendor onboarding, POs, and contract handoffs without slowing the business down.

 - Strong cross-functional partnership with teams such as Legal, Finance, InfoSec, Privacy, IT, and Compliance, including command of key commercial and legal terms and a track record of reducing risk while delivering value.

The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. jobs.title: Project Architect (data centers)
jobs.description:
Laitila Architects has an exceptionally strong routine and long experience in permitting and localizing demanding international data center projects in Finland. We have worked in numerous billion-euro hyperscale data center projects as a permit team leader, architectural, landscape and principal designer, as well as a Due Diligence expert.

In this role, you will be part of our localization team and ensure that our international clients' massive concepts are smoothly adapted to Finnish legislation and regulatory requirements. Your tasks may also include more traditional architectural and principal design of industrial and business premises.

Laitila Architects is an architecture firm focused on creating functional, people-centered spaces that support smoother everyday life for businesses and organizations. The firm has extensive experience in designing residential, office, commercial, and industrial environments, covering both new construction and renovation projects. Laitila Architects emphasizes solutions that are appropriately scaled and tailored to the specific needs of each client. The company operates as part of United Founders, a community of seasoned construction industry professionals, offering multidisciplinary expertise and collaboration opportunities. This setting provides team members with a supportive professional network and diverse project work.

**Role Description**

The Architect / Principal Designer is a full-time, hybrid role based in Helsinki, with the flexibility to work partly from home. In this position, the architect will lead and develop architectural concepts, prepare design documentation, and act as principal designer in projects from early planning to execution. Daily tasks include coordinating with clients, engineers, and other stakeholders, ensuring compliance with regulations, and aligning designs with project budgets and schedules. The role involves overseeing project integration across disciplines, participating in design reviews, and guiding junior team members. The architect will also contribute to continuous improvement of internal design processes and digital tools used in project delivery.

**We expect from you:**

- **Education and experience:** You have a relevant university degree in architecture (within EU), and eligibility or licensure to act as principal designer (pääsuunnittelija) in Finland, and preferably previous work experience in the design of data center and/or industrial projects. Understanding of Integration between architectural, structural, and building systems, and ability to collaborate effectively with other design disciplines. Competence in Project Management, including planning, scheduling, stakeholder coordination, and quality control. Proactive, organized, and able to take responsibility for project outcomes in a collaborative, non-hierarchical work environment.

- **Software expertise:** We primarily use **Autodesk Revit** BIM software in our projects. In addition, we consider knowledge of other tools we use (AutoCAD, Solibri Model Checker, Twinmotion) to be an advantage.

- **Authority expertise:** You have excellent knowledge of Finnish building regulations and local permit processes, as well as construction practices.

- **Language skills:** We constantly work with international design teams and clients, so we require fluent Finnish and English language skills.


**What do we offer?**

**A unique project portfolio:** You will get to work with real large-scale international projects as well as significant domestic industrial players.

**Agile and supportive work community:** We are part of **the United Founders** expert network, which offers its shareholder companies and employees the flexibility of a small company but the resources of a large organization and multidisciplinary expert support (e.g. structural, fire and building technology in the same ecosystem).

**Competitive benefits:** We offer, among other things, a separate incentive scheme (customer acquisition bonus) for bringing new business to the company.

**Job-specific salary 4500 – 5500 eur/month**

jobs.title: Technicien de maintenance (H/F)
jobs.description:
PREVIMED est une entreprise dynamique, ambitieuse et en pleine expansion.

Notre activité professionnelle est principalement dédiée à la fourniture de défibrillateurs automatisés externes (DAE) et de produits associés (consommables, armoires murales, signalétique) ainsi qu'aux prestations d'installation, de maintenance des DAE et de formation en secourisme.
À ce jour, nous élargissons notre offre en incluant la vente d'équipements de protection individuelle (EPI) et de matériel médical et paramédical.

Vous aimez le travail de terrain, l'autonomie et le contact client ? Nous recherchons une personne sérieuse, organisée et motivée pour réaliser des opérations de maintenance et de contrôle sur des équipements de santé sur le secteur PACA.

À l'aise avec les outils numériques, vous savez gérer vos interventions, participer à la planification de vos rendez-vous lorsque nécessaire et assurer un suivi rigoureux de vos comptes-rendus. Le poste implique des déplacements quotidiens, quelques découchés occasionnels ainsi que de petites interventions techniques simples.

Formation assurée. Permis B obligatoire. Des connaissances en secourisme serait appréciées. Repas remboursés par notes de frais.

Nous favorisons l'intégration avec un accompagnement interne dès votre arrivée et privilégions un confort de travail dans un environnement dynamique et une ambiance positive.

Le poste prévoit une période de formation dans nos locaux ainsi que sur le terrain.

Débutant accepté.

Type d'emploi : 39h, CDI.

Ouverture de poste, démarrage au plus tôt.

Horaires : Du lundi au vendredi.

Rémunération : 2247.99 Euros bruts / 39h

Lieu du poste : PACA - Siège de l'entreprise : LA FARE-LES-OLIVIERS.

Meillä on myös poikkeuksellisen kivoja työkavereita, erinomaisia henkilöstöetuja ja harvinaisen paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia.

Työt ABC- Liikennemyymälässä ovat ravintola-alan työtehtäviä ja sopivat arjen vaihtelevuudesta ja iloisessatyöympäristössä työskentelystä nauttivalle tiimipelaajalle. Meillä pääset kehittymääntodelliseksi ABC-moniosaajaksi. Teemme työtä tiiminä, joten arvostamme hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä valmiutta työskennellä monipuolisissa ABC-salin, -keittiön ja Hesburgerin tehtävissä. Olet etsimämme henkilö, mikäli sinulta löytyy iloista asiakaspalveluasennetta, hyvät sosiaalisettaidot, reipasta oma-aloitteisuutta ja nautit tekemisen meiningistä. Aikaisempi kokemus, koulutus ja osaaminen keittiötyöstä ovat eduksesi. Tehtäviisi kuuluvat monipuoliset keittiön työtehtävät, mukaan lukien a´la carte -annosten ja lounaiden valmistus sekä Hesburgerin tehtävät. Työvuoromme sijoittuvat joustavasti ABC:n aukioloaikoihin, joten edellytämme joustavuutta työskennellä monipuolisessa vuorotyössä. Olethan myös täysi-ikäinen, 18-vuotta täyttänyt.

Miksi hakea Eepeelle?
Erityisen hyvät henkilöstöedut! Miltä kuulostaisi -25 % alennus S-ryhmän ravintoloista? Tai henksuhintainen hotellihuone viikonlopuksi? Suomen parhaimmiksikin kutsutuista S-ryhmän ja Eepeen henkilöstöeduista voit lukea esimakuatäältä.
Koko henkilöstöämme koskevatulospalkkiojärjestelmä
Kattavat työterveyspalvelut sekä liikunnan ja hyvinvoinninEpassi-edut
Mahdollisuus ottaa vastaan lisätyötä muista yksiköistämme, osaaminen huomioiden

Haku on avoinna 4.8.2026 saakka. Käsittelemme hakemuksia ja teemme valintoja jo hakuaikana, joten hae viipymättä - toivottavasti saamme sinut työkaveriksemme mahdollisimman pian!

ABC Alavudella sinua odottava mukavat työkaverit , iloinen huumori sekä kunnon perehdytys tehtäviisi.

Eepee on osuuskauppa,jonka omistavat sen yli 95 000 asiakasomistajaa. Tarjoamme toimialueellamme työpaikan 1300 palvelualan ammattilaiselle 71 toimipaikassamme.
Eepeellä teemme ihan tavallisia töitä. Tavallisuus on voima, joka erottaa meidät muista. Meillä työ ei ole vain peruspesti, mutta samalla se on juuri sitä. jobs.title: Europcar søger en FP&A Manager
jobs.description:
FP&A Manager

Vil du spille en central rolle i at styrke finansiel styring, rapportering med stort forretningsaspekt i en dynamisk biludlejningsvirksomhed med sund vækst? Til at løfte vores finansfunktion til næste niveau søger vi en analytisk stærk FP&A Manager.

Om rollen

 Som FP&A Manager har du en nøglerolle i at udvikle og styrke virksomhedens rapportering, business controlling, FP&A og BI på tværs af den danske forretning. Udover den danske forretning, vil en mindre del af de opgaver, der hører til rollen, også gå med at supportere og drive den finske budget og forecast proces.

Med reference til vores Finance Director har du og dit team ansvaret for at sikre høj kvalitet i den månedlige rapportering samt drive vores forecast- og budgetprocesser i tæt samarbejde med forretningen. Du vil derfor spille en væsentlig rolle i videreudvikling af vores eksisterende, solide fundament.

Samtidig fungerer du som et centralt bindeled til koncernens finansfunktion, hvor du sikrer rettidig, konsistent og veldokumenteret rapportering og bidrager til at skabe transparens og sammenhæng i den finansielle performance.

Dine primære ansvarsområder

  • Sikre høj kvalitet i månedlig rapportering til ledelse og koncern

  • Koordinere og kvalitetssikre rapporteringspakker til Europcar Mobility Group Finance

  • Drive og udvikle budget- og forecastprocesser i Danmark og Finland

  • Udvikle og styrke brugen af forretningsdata, herunder rapporteringsværktøjer, dashboards og datagrundlag

I dag består vores FP&A afdeling af to controllere, der hver dag arbejder målrettet og ambitiøst for at levere til forretningen. Afdelingen er et godt sted i sammenhold og kultur. Og der er ønske om, at du som leder fokuserer på at teamet går fremtiden i møde med den rette støtte og ser løft af kompetencer og udvikling som vejen derhen.

Ansvaret for teamet indebærer også, at:

  • Sikre klare prioriteringer og høj kvalitet i leverancer

  • Udvikle teamets kompetencer og arbejdsprocesser

  • Skabe et motiverende og professionelt arbejdsmiljø

Udover dit fokus på os og teamet, har vi naturligt også et fokus på dig, så dit faglige og professionelle bidrag i virksomheden stemmer overens med det, vi søger.

Derfor forestiller vi os, at du:

  • Har en relevant videregående uddannelse inden for økonomi, finans eller lignende

  • Har dokumenteret solid erfaring med FP&A, controlling eller reporting – gerne fra en større organisation eller koncern

  • Har erfaring med budget- og forecastprocesser

  • Kan demonstrere god forretningsforståelse og evner at omsætte data til indsigt

  • Trives i en rolle med både operationelle og udviklingsorienterede opgaver

  • Har ledelseserfaring eller er klar til dette næste skridt i din karriere

Hvis du kan se dig selv i rollen og synes vi lyder interessante, kan vi opsummeret tilbyde:

  • En central rolle med stor indflydelse på udvikling af afdelingen

  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling

  • En attraktiv markedsrelevant lønpakke. Yderligere oplyses forud for eventuel forhandling.

  • Indtræden i en finansafdeling med stærkt sammenhold og høj faglighed

  • En arbejdshverdag i en organisation, hvor der er højt til loftet og plads til mennesket.

Vi hører rigtig gerne fra dig via vores karriereportal. Men har du forinden spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Finance Director, Thomas Lyngholm Jacobsen +45 61 99 99 87 | TLJ@europcar.dk

We welcome and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender reassignment, nationality, sexual orientation, age, disability status, religion, or any other dimension of diversity. We are dedicated to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and fostering an environment of equity and inclusion, where respect for one another is essential. If you need any accommodations or assistance during the application or interview process, please let us know. Together, through mutual respect, we can create a more equitable and inclusive future.

Europcar Mobility Group is a global mobility player, with 75 years of mobility services expertise and a leading position in Europe.  “We help to change the way you move” is what we stand for and brings us together.

We offer to individuals and businesses a wide range of car and van rental services, be it for a few hours, a few days, a week, a month or more, on-demand or on subscription, relying on a fleet of more than 250.000 vehicles, equipped with the latest engines including an increasing share of electric vehicles.

Our brands address differentiated needs, use cases and expectations: Europcar® - a global leader of car rental and light commercial vehicle rental, with a premium positioning, Goldcar® - a frontrunner at providing low-cost car rental services in Europe, and Fox-Rent-A-Car®, one of the main players in the car rental market in the US, with a "value for money" positioning.

Customers’ satisfaction is at the heart of the Group’s ambition and that of our more than 8,000 employees, everywhere we deliver our mobility solutions, thanks to a strong network in over 130 countries.

More info at: www.europcar-mobility-group.com

jobs.title: Head Waiter / Head Waitress for Restaurant Aihki | Pyhätunturi, Finnish Lapland
jobs.description:
**Join the award-winning team at Restaurant Aihki in Pyhätunturi!**

We are looking for a **Head Waiter / Head Waitress**to join Restaurant Aihki, part of the Sunday Morning Resort in the heart of Pyhätunturi.

Restaurant Aihki is known for its modern Nordic cuisine, where locally sourced, pure ingredients take centre stage. Our restaurant has twice been recognised among **Finland's Best Restaurants** by _Kauppalehti Optio_ (2022 & 2023, rating 16+).

As our Head Waiter / Head Waitress, you will be responsible for the smooth day-to-day operation of the dining room as well as special events. You will lead, inspire and support the front-of-house team while ensuring outstanding service and memorable guest experiences. Working closely with our kitchen leadership, you will oversee the daily operations of the restaurant floor, maintain service quality and contribute to the continued development of our dining experience.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with people, taking responsibility and delivering exceptional hospitality. You approach your work with ambition, creativity and professionalism, while possessing excellent organisational and communication skills. Previous supervisory experience in hospitality is highly valued, together with a relevant education in the restaurant industry. Most importantly, we are looking for someone who is genuinely passionate about hospitality and committed to creating unforgettable guest experiences.

**Your responsibilities include:**

- Leading the daily front-of-house operations at Restaurant Aihki

- Welcoming and serving guests with professionalism and genuine warmth during breakfast, lunch and dinner service

- Supervising, training and motivating the restaurant team

- Ensuring excellent guest service and supporting upselling opportunities

- Maintaining the highest standards of food and beverage service

- Coordinating wine service and contributing to the development of wine lists and beverage recommendations together with the restaurant and kitchen teams

- Managing the wine cellar and beverage inventory together with the restaurant and kitchen teams

- Collaborating with the kitchen management in planning menus, special events and dining experiences

- Maintaining quality standards, guest satisfaction and close cooperation with the wider management team


**We are looking for someone who has:**

- Previous supervisory experience in a restaurant environment, preferably in fine dining or high-quality à la carte service

- An excellent customer service mindset and strong interpersonal skills

- The ability to remain organised, calm and positive under pressure

- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to adapt quickly to changing situations

- Good command of Finnish and English (additional languages are considered an advantage)

- A relevant qualification in hospitality or restaurant management, together with a willingness to continue developing professionally

- A genuine interest in high-quality food, wines and memorable dining experiences

- A valid Hygiene Passport and Alcohol Serving Passport


**We offer you:**

- The opportunity to work in one of Finland's most highly regarded restaurants, recognised for its modern Nordic cuisine

- An inspiring and unique workplace surrounded by the beautiful landscapes of Pyhätunturi, Finnish Lapland

- A varied and responsible role where you can develop your skills and contribute to the restaurant's future

- A welcoming, professional and close-knit team

- Comprehensive onboarding before your employment begins

- The possibility of staff accommodation at an affordable rent

- Comprehensive occupational healthcare and local employee benefits

- Access to shared company season passes for Pyhä Ski Resort during the winter season

- The opportunity to work in a Sustainable Travel Finland certified company

- An excellent location close to Pyhä Ski Resort and local services

- A competitive salary based on the MARA collective agreement, with the final salary determined according to your experience and qualifications


**Employment**

The position begins in **late November or early December 2026** and continues until the end of the winter season in **late March / early April 2027**.

This is a **full-time seasonal position**.

**About us**

Restaurant Aihki offers modern Nordic cuisine inspired by the pure flavours of Finnish Lapland. We create memorable dining experiences built around local ingredients, seasonal produce and respect for the surrounding Arctic nature. Alongside traditional Lapland flavours, our cuisine embraces contemporary Scandinavian influences, creating dishes that always have a story to tell.

Throughout the season we organise themed dining events and guest chef evenings, giving our team the opportunity to participate in exciting culinary experiences beyond everyday restaurant service.

Take a look at our Instagram **@restaurantaihki** to see some of our previous events and culinary experiences.

Restaurant Aihki is part of **Sunday Morning Resort**, a boutique hotel offering personalised hospitality and unforgettable experiences in the heart of Pyhätunturi. Together with Parkside Pyhä apartments, our sustainable activity services and award-winning dining experiences, **Sunday Morning Collection** creates authentic and high-quality Lapland experiences for guests from around the world.

Learn more about Restaurant Aihki: **https://sundaymorning.fi/restaurant-aihki**

**Interested?**

Please send your application with the subject:

**Head Waiter / Head Waitress - Restaurant Aihki / \[Your Name\]**

Include your CV and salary expectation, and tell us about your background, experience and why this role interests you.

We review applications throughout the recruitment period, so we encourage you to apply as early as possible.

- **https://sundaymorning.fi**

jobs.description:
**A varied reception role in a boutique resort surrounded by the peaceful landscapes of Finnish Lapland. Could you be the missing piece of our team?**

We are looking for a **Receptionist** to join our team at **Sunday Morning Resort** in Pyhätunturi, Finnish Lapland.

Our reception is at the heart of the resort, giving you the opportunity to be involved in many aspects of our daily operations. Whether you are just starting your career in hospitality, already have extensive experience in the industry, or bring valuable customer service skills from another field, we'd love to hear from you. We believe diverse backgrounds strengthen our team.

As a Receptionist, you will be responsible for a wide range of guest service tasks. We look after our guests warmly at the front desk, by email, over the phone and through various booking channels.

**Your responsibilities include, among others:**

- Check-in and check-out procedures for **Sunday Morning Resort** and **Parkside Pyhä**

- Managing accommodation and activity reservations, including ensuring bookings, restaurant reservations and activities are correctly arranged, preparing welcome letters, and recommending local experiences

- Handling accommodation and activity payments, including advance payments and on-site payments

- Selling additional services and making reservations

- Managing OTA reservations, guest communication and upselling (Booking.com & Expedia Group)

- Working closely with all resort departments to ensure a seamless guest experience

- Maintaining the presentation and sales of our small souvenir shop located at reception, as well as keeping the coffee station tidy

- Covering the Concierge / Guest Relations role when required (a new position for the upcoming winter season), including lobby bar service and in-room deliveries

- Assisting other departments when needed, for example with meeting services or housekeeping
