jobs.title: Sprechen Sie Deutsch und möchten Sie in Aarhus, Dänemark, arbeiten?
jobs.description:
Business Development Representative (german-speaking)

Alfotech sucht einen deutschsprachigen Business Development Representative in Aarhus (Dänemark). Du betreust Kunden, erstellst Angebote und begleitest den gesamten Verkaufsprozess im B2B-Bereich.

Position Overview:

We are looking for a motivated and energetic Business Development Representative (BDR – Internal Sales) to join our team in Aarhus, Denmark. This role is ideal for someone with a few years of experience in sales, who is eager to grow their career and make a significant impact in the German-speaking market. You will play a key role in supporting our sales efforts by engaging with clients, generating quotes, and maintaining strong relationships.

The role is situated in Aarhus, Denmark and is a great opportunity for a German sales representative already living in Mid-Jylland or someone dreaming of relocating to the hidden Scandinavian gem of Aarhus.

About Alfotech:

Alfotech is a premier technical supplier of spare parts and custom solutions for the food and pharmaceutical industries. With over 40 years of industry expertise, we are a trusted partner for European food and pharmaceutical production. Our commitment to innovation, quality, and customer satisfaction ensures the quick and secure supply of a wide range of spare parts and tailored solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Engage with incoming leads and inquiries, responding promptly to customer queries and providing information about our products and services.

  • Generate quotes for inquiries from new and existing German customers.

  • Proactively follow up on quotes send to new and existing German customers.

  • Collaborate with the product team to offer tailored solutions and create proposals that address the specific needs of clients.

  • Work with the marketing team to provide insights and identify growth opportunities for better ads and marketing content.

  • Manage the entire sales cycle from lead generation to closing deals, handling negotiations and overcoming objections to achieve sales targets.

Qualifications:

  • Fluent in German and English, with excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • A third language, such as Danish or Dutch, would be a great advantage, but not a requirement.

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in sales, preferably in a B2B environment within the technical or industrial sector.

  • Proven ability to build and maintain client relationships.

  • Results-oriented mindset with a track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.

  • Highly organized with excellent time management skills, capable of prioritizing tasks and managing multiple projects simultaneously.

  • Team player with a collaborative attitude and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and ERP software is a plus.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary package

  • Vibrant company culture with a supportive team environment.

  • Several annual social events.

  • Dynamic work environment with many Danish colleagues.

  • Comprehensive training and ongoing professional development opportunities.

  • Private health insurance.

If you are a proactive and results-driven individual passionate about driving business growth and delivering exceptional customer experiences, we invite you to join our team at Alfotech.

Apply now by sending your CV to job@alfotech.eu

jobs.title: Team Leader – Night Shift Operations
jobs.description:
Are you ready to lead one of our most critical operational teams?

As our Night Shift Team Leader, you will be responsible for the overall leadership, performance, and operational management of our night shift operation, ensuring that customer deliveries are executed safely, efficiently, and on time.

You will report directly to the Operations Manager and become part of the site's leadership team.

As we operate in a GDP-regulated environment, compliance, quality, traceability, and continuous improvement are fundamental to everything we do.

 

About the Role

The Night Shift operation is responsible for the complete handling of outbound shipments, including picking, packing, and final distribution.

You will lead a team of approximately 10 employees, consisting of both full-time and part-time staff from many different nationalities and cultural backgrounds.

Working closely with the Shift Supervisor, you will ensure that staffing levels, operational flow, capacity planning, and daily priorities support an efficient, compliant, and high-performing operation.

As Team Leader, you are responsible for both people leadership and operational excellence. You will create an engaging working environment while continuously improving processes, quality, productivity, and delivery performance.

 

Key Responsibilities

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Overall responsibility for the daily execution of the night shift operation

  • Leading, coaching, motivating, and developing employees

  • Ownership of operational processes and continuous process improvements

  • Ensuring compliance with GDP requirements, internal procedures, and quality standards

  • Investigating operational deviations, incidents, and quality-related issues

  • Monitoring and improving KPIs and operational performance

  • Planning staffing, capacity, and operational resources

  • Driving productivity, service quality, and delivery reliability

  • Supporting recruitment, onboarding, and employee development together with HR

  • Implementing new processes, systems, and continuous improvement initiatives

  • Collaborating closely with day shift management and support functions to ensure an efficient end-to-end operation

  • Promoting a positive safety culture and ensuring compliance with Health & Safety requirements

  • Producing products on scooter with the team

 

Your Profile

We are looking for an experienced and visible leader who enjoys creating results through people and thrives in a fast-paced operational environment.

We expect that you:

  • Have proven people management experience within warehousing, logistics, distribution, manufacturing, or similar operational environments

  • Are a hands-on leader who enjoys working close to the operation and your employees

  • Have experience with KPI management and performance management

  • Can maintain structure and overview in a complex operation with many simultaneous activities

  • Have experience working with shift-based operations and hourly-paid employees

  • Are data-driven and possess some IT skills

  • Communicate clearly and are able to create engagement and commitment across the organisation

  • Remain calm under pressure and make sound decisions in a dynamic environment

  • Enjoy working with colleagues from different nationalities and cultures

  • Lead by example and are willing to go the extra mile when required

  • Have excellent organisational skills and a strong attention to detail

  • Are fluent in both English (the company's operational language) and Danish, both written and spoken

Experience working within a GDP-regulated or pharmaceutical logistics environment will be considered an advantage but is not essential.

 

What We Offer

We offer an exciting leadership opportunity where you will have a direct impact on one of the company's most critical operational functions.

In return, we offer:

  • A key leadership position with significant responsibility

  • The opportunity to influence and develop our night shift operation

  • A professional and well-structured logistics environment

  • Close collaboration with an experienced leadership team

  • Opportunities for professional and personal development

  • Competitive salary, pension scheme, and employee benefits

  • A comprehensive onboarding programme and thorough training

 

Working Hours

This is a permanent full time position of 37 hours per week. The ordinary night shift schedule is distributed across six working days according to a fixed roster. The precise daily working hours, including paid working time and breaks, are stated in the employment contract.

You will work six days per week according to a fixed roster.

Scheduled working hours are between 00:00 AM to 07:00 AM.

Flexibility is expected during periods of high operational demand, employee absences, vacations, or other business requirements.

Salary
Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.

The guaranteed salary, including eligible fixed salary components and pension contributions, will meet the applicable minimum salary requirement under the Danish Supplementary Pay Limit Scheme

Location

Nordsjælland, Denmark

Interested?

If you would like to become part of a professional organisation where quality, compliance, and operational excellence are at the heart of everything we do, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position will be filled once the right candidate has been identified.

jobs.title: Finance Accountant
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Duties include accounts receivable settlement, bill verification, risk control/compliance oversight, and cross-functional settlement coordination. Key Responsibilities Financial Accounting & Reporting: Responsible for daily accounting operations related to European and American business units, including general ledger maintenance, journal entries, and account reconciliations. Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in accordance with IFRS/GAAP and internal company policies. Assist in the consolidation of financial data for the international business sector. Shared Services Operations: Process high-volume transactions efficiently within the shared service framework, ensuring adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Standardize financial processes for the Europe & America region to improve efficiency and reduce errors. Handle accounts payable (AP) and accounts receivable (AR) inquiries and resolve discrepancies promptly. Compliance & Tax Support: Ensure compliance with local tax regulations and statutory reporting requirements in relevant European and American jurisdictions. Collaborate with external auditors and tax advisors during audit periods and tax filing seasons. Monitor changes in international financial regulations and advise the team on necessary adjustments. Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with local business teams in Europe and America to provide financial insights and support decision-making. Coordinate with the central CFO team to implement global financial strategies and system upgrades (e.g., ERP optimization). Assist in budget preparation and variance analysis for the assigned region. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field. Professional certification (CPA, ACCA, CMA) is a plus. 3+ years of experience in finance or accounting, preferably within a multinational corporation or a shared services environment. Solid understanding of International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) or US GAAP. Proficiency in English (written and spoken) is required for communication with overseas teams. Strong proficiency in Excel and familiarity with major ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite). Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities. Hours of Work: 40 hours per week (Monday to Friday - 9.00am to 6.00pm) Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Drift og renholdsansvarlig
jobs.description:
Bli med på en spennende vekstreise hos Four FM 🚀

Four FM er en nordisk leverandør av Facility Management-tjenester med sterke entreprenørielle røtter, fornøyde kunder og engasjerte medarbeidere. Vi vokser videre i Norge og søker nå en Drift- og renholdsansvarlig som ønsker å være med og påvirke både sin egen rolle og hvordan vi jobber i fremtiden.

Dette er en unik mulighet for deg som trives med ansvar, liker å være tett på den daglige driften og ønsker friheten til å forme din egen arbeidshverdag.

Hos oss får du muligheten til å drive entreprenørskap i et allerede etablert selskap. Vi ønsker deg som ser forbedringsmuligheter, utfordrer eksisterende arbeidsmåter og vil være med på å videreutvikle vår virksomhet.

Om rollen 🌏

Som Drift- og renholdsansvarlig vil du ha det overordnede ansvaret for renholdsleveransen til flere kunder i Oslo-området. Rollen er operativ og hands-on, og du vil være en viktig støtte både for kunder og medarbeidere i den daglige driften.

Du vil lede og følge opp et team av renholdere, hvor deler av arbeidet utføres på ettermiddag og kveld. Du vil jobbe tett med våre kunder, følge opp kvaliteten i leveransen, støtte medarbeiderne dine og sikre at driften fungerer effektivt hver dag. Du får stor frihet til å forme rollen og arbeidsmetodene dine. Vi søker deg som motiveres av å ta eierskap, ser forbedringsmuligheter og ønsker å bidra til vår videre vekst. Stillingen rapporterer til Nordic Cleaning Manager.

Ansvarsområder 📊

• Sikre høy kvalitet i leveransene og høy kundetilfredshet.

• Følge opp den daglige driften ute hos kunder.

• Lede, motivere og utvikle renholdsteamene.

• Rekruttere, onboarde, utvikle og følge opp medarbeidere gjennom hele ansettelsesforholdet.

• Ansvar for opplæring og videreutvikling av ansatte.

• Håndtere og følge opp medarbeidernes tidsrapportering.

• Sørge for at rutiner, instrukser og arbeidsmetoder er oppdaterte og implementerte.

• Utarbeide bemanningsplaner og koordinere ressurser ved fravær og ferie.

• Identifisere forbedringsmuligheter og bidra til kontinuerlig utvikling av arbeidsprosesser.

• Følge opp HMS-rutiner og sikre etterlevelse av lover, krav og interne prosedyrer.

• Bygge gode relasjoner med kunder og fungere som en naturlig kontaktperson.

Hvem er du? ✨

Du er en person som liker å ta ansvar og få ting gjort. Du trives med å være tett på driften og motiveres av å skape struktur, kvalitet og gode resultater sammen med andre.

For å lykkes i rollen tror vi at du:

• Er en synlig og tilstedeværende leder.

• Trives i en operativ rolle med stor variasjon.

• Er selvstendig og løsningsorientert.

• Har en sterk gjennomføringsevne.

• Liker å utvikle mennesker og bygge team.

• Motiveres av å være med på en vekstreise.

• Ser muligheter der andre ser utfordringer.

Kvalifikasjoner ✔

• Erfaring med personalledelse.

• Erfaring fra renholdsbransjen.

• Erfaring med onboarding og oppfølging av medarbeidere.

• God forståelse for drift og bemanningsplanlegging.

• Erfaring med Microsoft 365.

• Gode kommunikasjonsevner på norsk og engelsk, både muntlig og skriftlig.

• Førerkort klasse B.

Ekstra fordeler

• Erfaring fra Facility Management-bransjen.

• Erfaring fra andre servicebransjer.

• Erfaring med arbeid i kundeleveranser og kontraktsbaserte tjenester.

Hva tilbyr vi? 🌟

• En nøkkelrolle i et selskap i vekst.

• Stor grad av frihet under ansvar.

• Muligheten til å forme rollen og påvirke hvordan vi arbeider.

• Korte beslutningsveier og entreprenøriell kultur.

• Et inkluderende og engasjert arbeidsmiljø.

Arbeidstid og Varighet 🕒🕑🕐

Fast stilling med en innledende prøveperiode. Arbeidstiden er fleksibel og tilpasses driften og kundenes behov. Rollen innebærer både administrativt arbeid og operativ oppfølging ute i leveransen. Ettersom deler av renholdsarbeidet utføres på ettermiddag og kveld, må det påregnes arbeid utenfor ordinær kontortid ved behov.

Som en del av rollen forventes det også at du deltar i den daglige driften og bidrar i renholdsarbeid ved behov, for eksempel ved fravær eller andre bemanningsutfordringer.

Startdato

Så snart som mulig, eller etter avtale.

Arbeidssted

Oslo.

Søknadsprosess

Søknadsfristen er 17. august 2026.

Intervjuer vil bli gjennomført fortløpende. På grunn av ferieavvikling kan responstiden være noe lengre enn normalt i løpet av sommeren.

Vi oppfordrer deg derfor til å sende inn søknaden så snart som mulig.

Four FM's visjon: "We Take C.A.R.E." ❤

Våre verdier er vårt moralske kompass. "We Take C.A.R.E." Hvis du brenner for å gjøre en forskjell, trives i et støttende arbeidsmiljø og tror på kraften av Compassion (omsorg), Attention (oppmerksomhet), Respect (respekt) og Excellence (kvalitet), vil vi gjerne høre fra deg!

Hos oss kan du vokse og utvikle deg i rollen din eller ta på deg nye utfordringer i organisasjonen. Første steg er å søke!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Four FM is a Nordic facility management company providing tailored services to businesses and property owners. 

We work with companies that care about their brand, their people, and the environments they operate in. As a partner, not just a supplier, we deliver flexible solutions with a strong service mindset — guided by our philosophy, We Take C.A.R.E.

jobs.description:
Gaming Supporter - Opstart den 17. august eller den 14. september.

Vi søger engagerede og kompetente medarbejdere til vores gaming support‑team hos en international virksomhed på Cypern. Du bliver en del af en dynamisk organisation med et moderne arbejdsmiljø og mulighed for at opleve den solrige middelhavsø Cypern. Udover værdifuld international erhvervserfaring får du mulighed for at udforske en kultur med stærke traditioner, smukke strande og en afslappet livsstil.

Kvalifikationer

  • Du taler dansk og er komfortabel med at tale og skrive engelsk

  • Du har gode computerfærdigheder

  • Interesse for gaming er en fordel, men ikke et krav

Benefits

  • Fast månedsløn med attraktivt bonussystem

  • Betalt træning og onboarding

  • Relocation‑pakke med flere muligheder:

    • Relocation‑support for kandidater, der flytter til Cypern

    • Mulighed for at modtage €1.500 ved selv at arrangere bolig

    • Alternativ løsning med flykompensation op til €300 og firmabolig i op til to måneder

  • Fordelagtigt skattesystem med 0 % indkomstskat op til €19.500 pr. år

  • Rabatter og tilbud hos lokale restauranter, caféer, fitnesscentre m.m.

  • Gode udviklingsmuligheder

  • Moderne, nyrenoveret og centralt beliggende kontor

  • Internationalt arbejdsmiljø

  • Hjælp til administration såsom åbning af bankkonto og migration

  • Månedlige aktivitetsdage, hvor du kan udforske Cypern

  • Support fra teamledere, HR og et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab

Hvorfor arbejde internationalt?

Et job i en international virksomhed inden for gaming, IT og tech kan åbne døren til betydelige karrieremuligheder. Du får erfaring, der styrker dit CV, udvider dine kompetencer og gør dig attraktiv for fremtidige arbejdsgivere. Samtidig får du mulighed for personlig udvikling og en unik oplevelse i et nyt land.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Send din ansøgning i dag og bliv en del af vores spændende team på Cypern!

Kontakt os på Rene@jobhuntworldwide.com eller Cathrine@jobhuntworldwide.com

jobs.title: Vi søker byggforvaltere til en av Norges største eiendomsporteføljer
jobs.description:
Er du opptatt av god eiendomsforvaltning og bærekraftige bygg? Ønsker du en nøkkelrolle i utviklingen av kommunens eiendommer? Vi har stillingen for deg. 

Som byggforvalter i Bergen kommune blir du byggeiers representant og får ansvar for en egen portefølje av eiendommer. Du vil samarbeide tett med brukere, fagmiljøer og samarbeidspartnere, og bidra til at kommunens eiendommer forvaltes på en langsiktig, effektiv og miljøbevisst måte. 

Om stillingen 
Du blir en del av en kompetent og allsidig faggruppe bestående av 15 byggforvaltere, med ansvar fra alt av historiske bygg til moderne, høyteknologiske anlegg. Sammen arbeider dere med å sikre god drift, vedlikehold og utvikling av kommunens eiendommer. 
Byggteknisk avdeling har ansvar for planlegging av vedlikehold og utvikling av eiendomsmassen. I større prosjekter vil du opptre som byggeiers representant.  
Bergen kommune er i gang med å videreutvikle sin eiendomsstrategi. Som byggforvalter vil det være viktig å arbeide i tråd med strategien gjennom ansvarlig og miljøbevisst utvikling av eiendommene, planlegge langsiktig og ha en tydelig samfunnsorientering. 


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Forvalte og følge opp en egen eiendomsportefølje  
  • Være byggeiers representant i prosjekter 
  • Planlegge og følge opp vedlikeholds-, utviklings- og investeringsprosjekter, inkludert budsjettansvar 
  • Samarbeide tett med leietakere, interne avdelinger, eksterne aktører og tilsynsmyndigheter 
  • Bidra i arbeidet med vedlikeholds- og investeringsplaner for eiendomsporteføljen 
  • Bestille og følge opp tiltak gjennom prosjektavdelingen 
  • Følge opp garanti- og reklamasjonssaker 
  • Bidra til å redusere klima- og miljøavtrykket i porteføljen 
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Høyskole- eller universitetsutdanning på bachelornivå innen byggfag eller andre bygningstekniske fag. Andre relevante fagretninger på bachelornivå innen eiendomsforvaltning kan også vurderes 
  • Relevant arbeidserfaring er en fordel, men nyutdannede oppfordres også til å søke 
  • God kjennskap til relevante lover, forskrifter og standarder innen fagområdet er en fordel 
  • Gode digitale ferdigheter 
  • God skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne på norsk 
  • Førerkort klasse B 
  • Utdanning fra utlandet må være godkjent av DSB/NOKUT   
Personlige egenskaper

Vi ser etter deg som: 

  • Arbeider strukturert og analytisk 
  • Tar initiativ og har gjennomføringsevne 
  • Samarbeider godt og bygger tillit 
  • Evner å håndtere varierte oppgaver og interessenter 
  • Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt. 
Hvorfor velge oss

Etat for bygg og eiendom er en av Norges største eiendomsforvaltere, med ca. 850 ansatte og ansvar for over 1000 bygg med til sammen rundt 1,3 millioner m² bygningsmasse. Vi forvalter blant annet skoler, barnehager, sykehjem, administrasjonsbygg, idrettsanlegg og uteområder.  

Hos oss får du:

  • en samfunnsviktig rolle med stor påvirkningsmulighet 
  • et sterktfagmiljø og gode utviklingsmuligheter 
  • et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø
  • mulighet til å bidra til bærekraftig utvikling av offentlige bygg 

Etaten er sertifisert etter ISO 9001 (kvalitet) og ISO 14001 (miljø).

organizuoja  sandėlių ūkio darbą, jų techninį aprūpinimą, turto apsaugą, jo išdavimą;

jobs.title: Hardware Test Engineer/Technician  - Testingeniør/tekniker – Assembly & Test, Carpus
jobs.description:
English:

Kongsberg Maritime AS and its Automation & Control business unit deliver world-leading automation solutions for i.a. process control and safety systems to offshore vessels and oil & gas installations worldwide. We are in an exciting growth period and are looking for a dedicated hardware Test Engineer to strengthen our dedicated team and who wants to be part of our journey ahead.

As a HW Test Engineer with us, you will be part of our dynamic team composed of different experience, expertise and age. We emphasize sharing knowledge and cultivating a work culture that not only facilitates the best possible well-being, but also promotes an efficient working day.

Your tasks will be related to assembly and connection, testing, and troubleshooting of new and upgrades deliveries of Kongsberg Maritime's equipment. You will also be involved in other tasks in the department such as training apprentices and new employees, developing and maintaining the department's internal documentation such as work instructions and checklists, as well as the department's process and improvement work.

Our products are mainly positioning management, thruster control and automation control systems.

We are looking for a person who is motivated to take responsibility for quality and efficiency in project implementation, focuses on good cooperation, competence sharing and clear communication.

 

Does this sound exciting? Do not hesitate to apply – we assess candidates on an ongoing basis.

 

Responsibilities

  • Assembly and installation of HW project deliveries.
  • Distribution of networks and network tests in customer projects.
  • Testing and debugging of HW and SW on our systems.
  • Some electromechanical work.
  • Close collaboration and communication with project management.
  • Further development of test documentation.
  • Continuous improvement work.

 

Qualifications and experience

  • Certificate in relevant subject areas such as electrical, automation and computer/electronics.
  • Practical experience with technical installations.
  • Experience with electromechanical work is an advantage.
  • Fluent in Norwegian and English, both oral and written.
  • General computer knowledge.
  • Good workmanship.

This employment may require a pre-employment check procedure in accordance with company security standards, role or site requirements. Please note that this might affect the offer process or employment.

 

You are the person who

  • Is independent and proactive, makes things happen and takes responsibility for the result.
  • Is solution-oriented, creative and enjoys working with varying documentation and short delivery deadlines.
  • Communicates in a clear, precise and structured manner.
  • Collaborates well with others, enjoys sharing knowledge and experience, and supports others in achieving the team's goals.
  • Actively contributes to a positive work environment.
  • It is important that you maintain a high level of orderliness and organization, even during busy periods, follow internal procedures, and can handle hectic days without becoming stressed.

At Kongsberg Maritime, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We encourage you to apply, even if you do not meet every requirement. Your unique perspective is valuable to us. Your skills, attitude and perspective could be exactly what we are looking for!

 

What we can offer

  • International working environment and collaboration across teams.
  • An inspiring and safe working environment.
  • Professional development and career opportunities.
  • The opportunity to work with newly developed and sustainable technology designed to solve the challenges of the future.
  • Favourable insurance agreements and pension plans.
  • Flexible working hours and holiday arrangements.

 

Work location: Kongsberg - Carpus


Contact person:
Orlando Zuleta Ortiz, Group Manager, tel +47 958 85 177
Nikolaj Agger, Department Manager, tel.: +47 907 02 841

 

Norwegian:

jobs.title: Vi søker renholdere til våre Airbnbs! Fleksibel jobb med god lønn.
jobs.description:
Vi søker renholdere. Her har du en fleksibel jobb med konkurransedyktig lønn.

Hva vi ser etter

Hvem ser vi etter?

Pålitelig og nøye: Vi er superhost på Airbnb, og denne statusen er utrolig viktig for oss at bevare. Vi trenger derfor noen som er nøye med detaljene og pålitelig i arbeidet. Det er utrolig viktig at man kommer til avtalt vask.

God kommunikasjon: Du må være god til å kommunisere for at vi skal kunne samarbeide godt i den daglige driften. Ærlighet er også veldig viktig for oss.

Ønsker en enkel og fleksibel jobb: Denne jobben passer perfekt for deg som ønsker en fleksibel jobb.

Optimalt sett, så ønsker vi en som kan jobbe fast deltid-fleksibelt i noen få måneder (des-april/mai), for å sen overgå i fast 100% mot våren (ca april-mai).

I søknaden til denne stillingen, vill det være svært verdifullt om du kan inkludere en kort tekst som bekrefter din forståelse av viktigheten av lojalitet til å komme til avtalt vakt, samt utførelse av arbeidet på en måte som sikrer gjestenes tilfredshet.

Fortell gjerne om dine planer og ønskninger for 2026.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Nordisk Standard er en nyetablert bedrift med flere leiligheter sentralt i Oslo. Vi har høye ambisjoner om å vokse antallet leiligheter og streber etter å opprettholde høy standard og utmerket service for våre gjester. For å lykkes med dette, er det avgjørende å ha utmerket renhold.

Arbeidsoppgaver :

  • Vasking av sengetøy i leilighetene/fellesvaskeri i bygget.

  • Rengjøring av overflater, støvsuging, vaske gulv, bytte sengetøy, vaske toaletter, tømme søppel og ta oppvasken.

  • Fylle på med nødvendigheter som toalettpapir, såpe, sjampo, balsam og oppvaskmiddel.

Vi har selv håndtert dette i to år, og vår erfaring er at gjestene er flinke til å etterlate leilighetene i god stand.


Vi tilbyr

Hva tilbyr vi?

Godt betalt: For riktig, pålitelig kandidat, så ønsker vi å gi høyere enn vanlig tarifflønn.

Fleksibilitet: Vi prøver å være så fleksible som mulig med gjestene i forhold til innsjekk. Dette gir oss mulighet for å være fleksibel med våre ansatte ift hvordan de ønsker å forme sin dag. Hvis noen boliger har sen innsjekk, så kan man være fleksibel med når boligen rengjøres.

God arbeidsmiljø: Vi er en bedrift som sørger for god service, både for gjestene og for våre ansatte. Vi ønsker at du skal trives godt og sørger for å være oppmerksom på dine behov å ønsker at du skal føle deg verdsatt i jobben din.

Muligheter for fremtiden: Hvis man får bygget opp fortrolighet, så finnes muligheter for ansvar over vasketeam mot høysesongen (mai-sept) neste år og lønnsøkning iht ansvar.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Nordisk Standard ønsker å tilby turister i Norge det lille ekstra for å gjøre oppholdet minneverdig. Vi har utvalgte leiligheter med god Nordisk standard for et hyggelig bomiljø. Som en nystartet bedrift har vi en visjon om å vokse og tilby flere boliger og leiligheter og forbedre vårt tilbud kontinuerlig.

jobs.title: Build the industrial cooperation function driving Kongsberg Maritime’s growth in the naval defence market
jobs.description:
Kongsberg Maritime has clear ambitions for significant growth within the maritime defence segment. Over many years, the company has successfully developed, sold and delivered advanced solutions, including propulsion systems and stabilisers, to navies and coast guards worldwide.

Our activities within the maritime defence market are expected to grow further through a broader offering of products, solutions and services. The most important growth will come from increased focus on automation and control, energy, and digital services, including maritime simulators.

Industrial cooperation is a central part of international defence trade and represents an important strategic tool for winning contracts, both in Norway and internationally. Offset and industrial cooperation are therefore defined as strategic core elements in Kongsberg Maritime’s continued development within the Naval market. As a result of this strategic focus and increasing activity level, a dedicated central function for industrial cooperation is now being established. In this context, we are seeking a Director Industrial Cooperation who will play a leading role in building and further developing this function. The position reports to the Director Operations, Naval Systems.

High travel activity should be expected during certain periods

Responsibilities:

  • Establish, develop and build the Industrial Cooperation function in Kongsberg Maritime
  • Participate in international sales campaigns as the responsible lead for industrial cooperation, and contribute to the execution and follow-up of agreed industrial cooperation agreements
  • Negotiate cooperation agreements with international partners and suppliers to secure Norwegian participation in programmes, technology development and international market access
  • Follow up, manage and report on industrial cooperation agreements in accordance with governmental requirements and internal objectives
  • Maintain and further develop relationships with authorities in Norway and internationally
  • Contribute to further developing industrial cooperation as a strategic tool for winning Norwegian and international contracts

Desired qualifications and personal qualities:

  • Technical or commercial education at master’s level, and/or education from a military academy
  • Strong business understanding with an analytical and commercial approach, solid technological insight and knowledge of the defence industry and its framework conditions
  • Experience from business development, including experience with international negotiations and cooperation
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Norwegian and English

As a person you are:

  • Independent, proactive and structured, with the ability to work effectively both independently and in cross-functional teams
  • Have strong execution skills, excellent relationship-building abilities and confidence in dialogue with both industry and authorities

We offer:

  • An important role in a growing company
  • We offer competitive pay based on objective criteria to ensure fairness and internal equity along with pension contributions, health- and employee insurance
  • An exciting and varied area of responsibility where you can influence your own working day
  • A positive working environment with extensive experience and expertise
  • Good career and development opportunities in an international company
  • Different benefits, such as programmes, company cabins fitness centre and more

This employment will require a pre-employment check procedure in accordance with company security standards, role or site requirements. In addition, a security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority will be required. The successful candidate may start to work with limited access whilst the clearance is being processed. Please note that this might affect the offer process or employment.

Work location:
One of Kongsberg Maritime’s locations in Norway

Would you like to know more? Please contact: Håvard Klokkerud, Director Operations, Naval Systems, tel.  +4797118648

In close collaboration with customers and research environments, we develop technology that solves real challenges at sea. Today, more than 30,000 vessels operate with our systems on board. Kongsberg Maritime has more than 8,300 employees in 35 countries.

jobs.title: Drive technical sales within our naval segment as Technical Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
Kongsberg Maritime is currently experiencing significant growth within the maritime defense segment. To succeed in business development, developing and delivering integrated system solutions to navies and coast guards globally, we are now strengthening our technical team within Naval Systems.

We are seeking a Technical Sales Engineer who will contribute throughout the entire sales process – from early business development and solution design to contract and project start-up.

For many years, Kongsberg Maritime has successfully delivered products such as propulsion systems and stabilizers to navies and coast guards around the world. Going forward, further growth is expected by offering a broader portfolio of products, solutions, and services to the defence market.

This growth will largely be driven by expansion within bridge, automation and control systems, energy and power solutions, as well as digital services such as maritime simulators. Uncrewed and autonomous vessels are and will continue to be an important component of future naval forces. Kongsberg Maritime already holds a strong international position in this field, with early deliveries in the commercial sector and ongoing initiatives targeting navies and coast guards.

In this role, you will be a key contributor to realizing this growth through close collaboration with customers, the business development and sales organization, and additionally, product and technical departments.

Periods of extensive travel should be expected.

Key responsibilities:

  • Establish, present, and promote integrated system solutions to end-users, procurement organizations, and partners
  • Provide technical sales support throughout the entire process, from early business development and proposal work to contract and project start-up
  • Take responsibility for defining and coordinating the technical scope, cost estimation, and risk assessments, in close collaboration with other business units and technical teams

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer, K Group
jobs.description:
K Group's BHI (Building and Home Improvement) eCom team is looking for an experienced full-stack developer. Are you looking for a change of scenery, or want to explore new challenges on developing a larger system with multiple deployments? And if delivering business value, technical debt management and agile methodologies sound like good ideas, this could be your next career move.

The BHI eCom Team

The teams mission is to develop the Cyclone platform powering the eCom solutions for K-Rauta, Byggmakker and K-Bygg. We have developed our own eCom platform, called Cyclone, serving our Building and Home Improvement businesses in Finland, Sweden and Norway with many different ERPs in the back end, a part of our larger Building and Technical Trade business. The Cyclone dev team is a distributed and multinational agile software development team. We are fulfilling business needs by developing front-ends and microservice capabilities integrating with the back-ends. We subscribe to a DevOps-philosophy – everyone is empowered to not just implement features, but also to improve and support the platform.

Your Role as a Senior Developer

As a senior full-stack developer in the team you will be contributing to the teams backlog. You dont just develop your own code, but also review code from other team members, lead by example and help the team strengthen engineering practices by coaching and mentoring other developers. You have a central role in architectural planning and building and leading the technical direction in the team. You also coordinate with the rest of the team and our stakeholders and support your teams product owner in maintaining and refining the backlog.

What We Are Looking for:

- 5+ years of hands-on software product development experience - Strong understanding of core programming concepts and computer science fundamentals
- Solid knowledge of microservices architectures
- Proficiency in TypeScript, React and modern frontend technologies (HTML, CSS, browser APIs). You write clean, maintainable and accessible code following best practices
- Experience in designing and building secure and scalable services and APIs with Node.js
- Solid SQL fundamentals; you are able to design schemas and write efficient, performant queries
- Knowledge of unit, integration and end-to-end testing and building validation strategies
- Hands-on experience of integrating generative AI into products or development workflows
- Practical experience in secure coding practices and mitigating common risks (e.g. OWASP Top 10)
- Passion and vision to contribute to our common platform, demonstrating technical leadership and making our team better as a whole
- An ability to work collaboratively, as well as independently, as part of a team
- Fluent communication in English, which is our working language
- A degree in engineering, major in information technology, software- or web development – or equivalent experience
- You can make it to Kalasatama in Helsinki once a week to be with the team on-site
- Please also note you will need the existing right to work in Finland. K Group is unable to sponsor work permits or visas

If you have relevant public code samples, GitHub projects or other examples of your work, youre welcome to include them in your application.

Our Tech Stack:

HTML – SCSS – TypeScript – React – Redux – Node.js – REST APIs – Single Page Apps – Docker – GitHub Actions – Kafka – PostgreSQL – Mocha – Jest – WebpackWhat We Can Offer You:

The K Group offers attractive opportunities for driving the trading sector forward. Youll be working in a key function of a leading sector company and innovate solutions for its core operations in the grocery trade, building and technical trade, and car trade.

This role is worth your attention because you'll get:

- A great multinational team, suitably professional yet not too serious
- A cool and complex micro-service based omnichannel platform to work with
- The ability to work in a fast-moving environment where your input really matters
- An open work culture where you bring your own ideas to the table, both technically, and improving our services and ways of working as well
- Extensive employee benefits unique to the K group. These include, among others: Culture & sport benefit (ePassi), shopping benefits that apply in K-Group stores and staff shops, own occupational health care services and leisure time accident insurance
- We also have several benefits offered by our partners, including optical stores, accommodation and travel, as well as sports & wellbeing services
- For office days - modern office with several accommodations (e.g., collaboration and break areas throughout the office, gym, health care services, restaurant and cafeteria) along good connections in Kalasatama, Helsinki

At K Group, you get to create solutions that make peoples everyday lives easier, with the strength of data gathered from 1.5 million daily customer encounters. Youll have your finger on the pulse of our consumer and business customers in the grocery trade, building and technical trade and car trade, and get to take part in various interesting projects.

For digital experts with their eye on the future, we offer vast amounts of data and the chance to harness their creativity to improve peoples everyday lives. Our culture encourages reinvention, experimentation, mistakes and learning.

Corporate responsibility is integrated into K Groups day-to-day activities, and we strive to help our customers make good choices. We want to make life easier for our customers by offering them quality products and services that promote welfare. The focus of our responsibility work is on the welfare of both people and the environment.

Feeling Interested? Dont Delay Applying!

We review applications during the application period and move forward as soon as we find the right person. The process typically includes three interviews, including one technical interview and at least one onsite meeting. Well keep all candidates informed during the process.

When filling the application please invest time in sharing your own thoughts and ideas instead of asking guidance from AI assistants. We want to learn more about you in your own words. This is something well consider in the hiring process.

For more information, contact Max Romant

jobs.description:
Are you ready to embark on an exciting and important journey as the Director Security & Crisis Management at Kongsberg Maritime? As the leader of our Security & Crisis Management team you will play a crucial role in driving our security efforts and delivering reliable solutions to our global operations.

Within the group security office our mission is clear: to build and enhance strategic and operational security and deliver reliable and sustainable security management to our valued operatives. Through a collaborative approach, both internally and externally, we will foster a security focused culture together. With a constant focus on uncertainty, we explore new technologies and ways to work to stay ahead of the unknown.

As the Director Security & Crisis Management in Kongsberg Maritime, you have the competence, motivation, and leadership to transform our security goals into actionable strategies that make a difference. You will effectively assess, strategize and communicate plans and initiatives to our organisation, fostering successfully implemented security strategies on a global scale.

Your key accountabilities include:

  • Be Kongsberg Maritime’s main point of contact in Security related issues
  • Own KM’s Security strategy, set targets and core focus within the area in line with KM direction and external factors

  • Ensure professional and updated threat assessments and plans for crisis management
  • Ensure KM operates within relevant laws and regulation
  • Responsible for KM’s global Security & Crisis Management team
  • Report to SVP Naval Systems and the CEO at Kongsberg Maritime

Qualifications and experience for the role

  • Relevant higher education at master or bachelor level within relevant fields

jobs.title: Lärare i barnomsorgen 100%
jobs.description:
Mariehamns stad söker två lärare i barnomsorgen för tillsvidareanställning på heltid från och med 1.9.2026 eller enligt överenskommelse.
Sista ansökningsdag 12.8.2026.

FORMELLA BEHÖRIGHETSKRAV
Behörighet enligt landskapsförordning (2020:99) om barnomsorg och grundskola.
Har du svensk examen? Ansök med ett erkännande från Ålands landskapsregering som bifogas ansökan.
Saknar du full behörighet? Har du relevant utbildning och erfarenhet kan du ändå komma i fråga för en tidsbegränsad anställning om inga behöriga sökande finns.

VI SÖKER DIG SOM
Vill bidra till att barn får trygga, roliga och stimulerande uppväxtvillkor
Har ett engagerat, respektfullt och professionellt förhållningssätt till barn, vårdnadshavare och kollegor
Är nyfiken och vill utvecklas tillsammans med arbetslaget
Sprider arbetsglädje, ser möjligheter i vardagen och delar med dig av erfarenheter

VARFÖR DU KOMMER ATT TRIVAS HOS OSS
Hos oss möts du av god personaltäthet, trygghet och gemenskap. Vi värnar om ett nära och stödjande samarbete, både inom arbetslaget och med det breda nätverk som finns runt barnen. I vardagen samarbetar vi med bland annat kurator, talterapeut, speciallärare och socionom - en styrka som gör att vi kan ge varje barn bästa möjliga stöd och förutsättningar att utvecklas.

Varje daghem har dessutom en egen barnskötarpool, som fungerar som korttidsvikarie vid behov, utöver grundbemanningen, vilket ger flexibilitet och trygghet i verksamheten.

Inom barnomsorgen pågår flera inspirerande utvecklingsarbeten - bland annat satsningar på välbefinnande, NPF-anpassning av lärmiljöer och positiv psykologi.

VI ERBJUDER DIG OCKSÅ
Sjukvårdtjänster
Friskvårdsförmåner
Arbetskläder
Möjlighet till utbytesledighet

Tack vare korta avstånd mellan arbetsplatser får du dessutom mer tid till fritid och återhämtning.

ARBETSTID & SEMESTER
Arbetstid för heltid :38,25 timmar i veckan. För lärare ingår i dessa timmar en planeringstid om 4,5 timmar per vecka
Semester: 38 dagar vid fullt erfarenhetstillägg enligt AKTA.

VÅR VERKSAMHET
Vi skapar en kreativ och utvecklande miljö för barn 1-6 år, där omsorg, lek och lärande går hand i hand. Våra barngrupper består av 11-21 barn beroende på ålder, vilket ger både god personaltäthet och hög trivsel.

Vi ser varje barn som kompetent och unikt, och vill att alla ska känna sig sedda och bekräftade. Leken är hjärtat i lärandet - både fri lek inomhus och utomhus. Natur, rörelse, sagor, musik och kulturaktiviteter är viktiga delar av vår vardag, som stimulerar barnens nyfikenhet och glädje.

VILLKOR
Prövotid tillämpas
Tillträde enligt överenskommelse
Utdrag ur straffregistret krävs enligt lag innan anställning
Lön enligt avtal AKTA

SÅ ANSÖKER DU
Ansök via länken i annonsen och fyll i uppgifterna noggrant - din ansökan bedöms mot andra sökande. Efter första ansökan kan du logga in och uppdatera ditt CV för andra tjänster inom Mariehamns stad. Intervjuer kan hållas löpande under ansökningstiden.

Christian Eriksson, christian.eriksson[at]edu.mariehamn.ax

jobs.title: Netkiosken på Kastetvej søger en butiksassistent og potentielt Souschef.
jobs.description:
Butiksassistent til Netkiosken Kastetvej/ Potentielt Souschef.

Netkiosken Kastetvej i Aalborg søger en butiksmedhjælper til faste vagter ca 20-25 timer ugentligt, primært i dagtimerne, men med en ugentlig aftenvagt. Til en person med de rette evner vil der med tiden være mulighed for at glide over i en stilling som Souschef med flere timer og højere løn.

Der vil være mulighed for flere timer om aftenen og i weekenden hvis man er klar på at hjælpe sine kolleger når de vil have byttet vagter eller ved sygdom. Fra midt november til midt januar forventer vi at du kan arbejde fuld tid, da denne periode er vores absolut travleste, idet ”Black Friday” er over os. Oplæringen forventes opstartet i begyndelsen af august.

Vi er en større kiosk i Aalborg, som har fokus på at tilfredsstille vore mange kunder. Vi tilbyder et stort udvalg af spilmuligheder, Danske spil, og Cashpoint samt mange spilleautomater. Ligeledes har vi et udvalg af kioskvarer og er pakkeshop for GLS, DAO, Post Nord, Bring, UPS og DHL. 

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil bestå af kundeekspedition, vareopfyldning og diverse forefaldne opgaver. Med tiden vil flere ansvarsområder pålægges den ansatte hvis man har de rette evner. I sådanne tilfælde vil lønnen øges i forhold til det nedenstående. Ender man med at komme over i stillingen som Souschef, betyder det også, at man har telefonvagten hver anden uge og har ansvaret for at hjælpe personalet når de ringer om spørgsmål og møder op når det ikke kan løses via telefonen.

Arbejdstiderne er typisk hverdage i tidsrummet 8.00-17.00 Desuden ser vi gerne at du hjælper dine nye kollegaer en gang imellem med deres vagter samt lejlighedsvis hjælper ved sygdom hverdag, aftner og weekender. I ferieperioder vil der være mulighed for en del ekstra vagter.

Du skal være indstillet på at man periodevis arbejder alene og have autoritet samt god kundekontakt. Ligeledes skal du have overblik til at holde butikken pæn og ryddelig.

Stillingen er ideel for en der afholder et sabbatår, og erfaring fra tankstation eller supermarked vil være et plus. Hvis man ønsker at blive Souschef vil det være ønskeligt, at man har erfaring med at have personaleansvar fra tidligere stillinger.

Timelønnen er i prøvetiden, de første 3 måneder, 120 kr. Derefter 135kr. indtil første år og efter første år 145 kr. I tilfælde af at man bliver Souschef er lønnen selvfølgelig en anden og efter evner.

jobs.title: 100% Remote Technical Implementation Manager (Hotel PMS / CRS Integration Specialist) EN (Hotelfachmann/-frau)
jobs.description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Hotel Revenue Manager; Hotel Systems Experte

Stellenbeschreibung:
Hotel PMS use Experience Required (please do not apply if you have never used a hotel PMS)

Location: Fully Remote (EU preferred – Spain / Portugal / Southern Europe or global if compatible with EOR or contractor setup)
Employment Type: Full-Time (Flexible Hours)
Experience Level: Experience with hotel systems required
Salary Range: €30.000 - 45.000

Company Overview

Hotel Res Bot is a fast-growing SaaS company building AI-powered automation systems for the hospitality industry.

Our platform automatically reads incoming reservation emails and generates tailored offers for guests.

Unlike many traditional hotel systems, we work entirely with live real-time data from PMS, CRS, IBE, and Channel Manager APIs. Because of this, stable integrations and accurate data flow are critical to our product.

This is where this role comes in.

Job Summary

Are you the person at the hotel everyone turns to when the PMS stops syncing, the channel manager misbehaves, or integrations break?  This can be a great transition role into hotel tech from hotel operations

We are looking for a Hotel Systems Integration Specialist to take ownership of technical connectivity and implementation for our hotel partners.

This role is focused specifically on integration execution and system connectivity. You will work closely with our Account Management and Support teams, but you will not be responsible for commercial account management or first-line customer support. Your primary responsibility is ensuring that integrations between hotel systems and our platform are configured, tested, and functioning reliably.

You will also play an important internal role by helping our developers understand new PMS, CRS, and Channel Manager integrations — translating vendor documentation, operational workflows, and real-world hotel requirements into clear technical specifications and test scenarios.

What You’ll Do (Responsibilities)

Own Technical Onboarding
Lead the technical setup and activation of new hotel clients on our platform.

Ensure Reliable Connectivity
Configure, test, and validate integrations between our system and hotel PMS, CRS, and Channel Manager environments.

Translate Hotel Requirements into Technical Specs
When hotels request specific workflows (e.g. reservation field mapping, folio posting rules, or company profile handling), analyze whether and how their PMS APIs support it.

Work with API Documentation & Testing Tools
Use tools like Postman to test API endpoints, validate responses, and confirm system behavior before implementation.

Bridge to Engineering
Translate integration findings into clear, actionable specifications and GitLab tickets for the engineering team.

Troubleshoot Integration Issues
Investigate and resolve connectivity problems such as synchronization errors, missing reservation data, or incorrect folio postings.

Guide Hotel Technical Teams
Support hotel IT, revenue, or operations teams through setup steps such as API authentication (e.g. Microsoft Graph) and simple DNS configuration (e.g. CNAME records).

What We Are Looking For

Must Have

Experience with Hotel Systems Required
Previous experience working with hotel systems (such as PMS, CRS, Channel Managers, or other hotel operations platforms) is required.

Interface (API) Curiosity & Documentation Skills
Ability to read and interpret API documentation and figure out how to validate behavior using tools like Postman.

Technical Comfort (No Coding Required)
Comfort working with structured data (JSON/XML), basic API concepts, and technical troubleshooting workflows.

Strong Communication Skills
Ability to communicate clearly with both hotel operational teams and technical stakeholders.

Problem-Solving Mindset
You enjoy investigating why systems don’t work and prefer practical solutions over theoretical perfection.

Fluent English
Written and spoken.  No German required.

Nice to Have (We Can Teach You)

- Experience using Postman for API testing
- Basic understanding of DNS / CNAME configuration
- Experience with PMS vendors such as Mews, Opera, Cloudbeds, Protel, SiteMinder, D-EDGE, SynXis, or Apaleo
- Previous experience in hotel tech (PMS, Channel Manager, CRS, IBE vendors)

What Success Looks Like

Within 6 weeks, you will be independently:

- Onboarding and configuring hotel system integrations
- Testing API endpoints and validating integration behavior
- Translating hotel requirements into clear technical specifications
- Creating actionable engineering tickets for integration work
- Supporting live troubleshooting of connectivity issues

Culture & Working Style

We are a fully remote, international team operating in a trust-based environment.

We value:

- Remote & flexibility first – work from anywhere, structure your day how it works best for you
- High autonomy with high responsibility – you own your work end-to-end
- Strong error culture – mistakes are expected as part of learning; we focus on fixing and improving, not blaming
- Respectful communication – direct feedback is welcome, personal attacks are not
- Pragmatism over perfection – we prefer working systems over theoretical perfection

We work in a fast-moving environment where clarity improves over time through iteration, not upfront perfection.

Benefits

- Fully remote position
- Flexible working hours
- Direct access to engineering and product teams
- High autonomy and ownership
- Opportunity to grow into technical product or engineering roles
- Equipment provided (laptop + accessories if needed)

How to Apply

Please send your application to: career@hotelresbot.com

Please include:

- CV or short professional background
- Brief cover letter explaining: - Your experience with hotel systems (PMS, CRS, Channel Managers, etc.)
- Your comfort level with reading API documentation and using tools like Postman
- Why you are interested in hotel SaaS implementation and connectivity

Ergänzende Informationen:
Homeoffice:
Umfang: Maximal 100%
Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Grundkenntnisse: Datenaustauschformat JSON, Tourismusplattformen und Buchungssysteme
Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Reservierung (Hotel- und Gaststättengewerbe), Hotelverwaltungs-, Reservierungssystem Opera

Company

jobs.title: Job i udlandet - Dansk onlinecasino søger kundeservicemedarbejder
jobs.description:
Vi søger en dygtig kundeservicemedarbejder til vores kontor i Gzira, Malta med opstart hurtigst muligt. Din primære opgave bliver at besvare indkomne skriftlige henvendelser fra vores kunder via e-mail og chat. Vores mål er at sikre, at alle kunder modtager professionel vejledning og den bedst mulige service. Der vil desuden være mulighed for at få flere ansvarsområder i takt med dine præstationer og kompetencer.

Som kundeservicemedarbejder er service din vigtigste opgave. Du skal have lyst til at formulere dig skriftligt, være løsningsorienteret og brænde for at yde en fremragende kundeoplevelse. Ingen opgave er for stor eller for lille, når det handler om at hjælpe vores kunder.

Dine opgaver:

  • Besvare kundeforespørgsler via e-mail og chat.

  • Sikre, at komplekse kundehenvendelser bliver løst hurtigt og tilfredsstillende.

  • Yde teknisk support og vejledning om spil.

  • Overvåge hjemmesidens tilgængelighed og funktionalitet samt rapportere fejl og problemer.

  • Deltage i test af nye produkter og tjenester.

  • Medvirke til at promovere nye produkter og kampagner.

  • Bidrage til andre arbejdsopgaver i virksomheden efter behov.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er serviceorienteret, udadvendt, hjælpsom og imødekommende.

  • Har fremragende skriftlige danskkundskaber og gode engelskkundskaber.

  • Er ansvarsbevidst og motiveret for at nå interne mål.

  • Arbejder struktureret og har sans for detaljer.

  • Har erfaring med digitale arbejdsopgaver – det er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Gode muligheder for udvikling og ansvar

  • Danske kollegaer med et danske chefer

  • Sociale arrangementer

  • Hjælp med praktiske ting ved flytning til Malta

  • 150 euro til flybillet

  • Relocationpakke, så du kommer godt fra start med bolig

Stillingen er på fuld tid og omfatter vagter alle ugens syv dage, fordelt på fem ugentlige vagter inden for tidsrummet kl. 08.00–21.00.

Lokation: Gzira, Malta. Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte os.

jobs.title: Senior SCADA Consultant (m/f/d) (Software-Architect)
jobs.description:
Do you want to contribute to a secure, reliable construction and operation of renewbale assets for a international and market-leading asset management consultancy within the renewable energy industry? PEAK Wind is looking for a Senior SCADA Consultant who can be an integrated part of our SCADA and Cyber Security team, ensuring best-in-class deliverables for our clients, and building a bridge between technical, commercial, and operational OT and SCADA assets.

Trusted Advisors for Developers and Investors for some of the Largest Renewable Assets
At PEAK Wind, we specialise in operations, asset management, and project management of renewable energy assets. We take pride in providing best-in-class commercial, financial, and operational advisory and support to our clients. We work with some of the world’s largest infrastructure investments and are proud to count market-leading utilities, investment funds, and Independent Power Producers among our clients.

Solution-driven Senior SCADA Consultant with Technical Network Know-how
Based in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Hamburg, or Zaragoza you will be supporting clients in all aspects of the project lifecycle, from early development to operation.

We are a dedicated team of mixed seniorities and nationalities with a collaborative way of working. SCADA and Cyber Security is a key area for our clients and receives increased attention on both greenfield and brownfield projects. The team works across different disciplines ensuring seamless integration, operation, and Cyber Security of OT, ICS, and SCADA systems.

Your responsibilities include:

- Drafting and reviewing requirements suppliers and service providers of OT systems, SCADA, and Cyber Security for renewable assets, mainly within onshore and offshore wind
- Negotiating SCADA and Cyber Security requirements in various supply and service contracts on behalf of our clients
- Designing basic network archtiecture and identifying functional requirements from network designes
- Supporting operational teams on OT, SCADA, and Cyber Security investigations and improvements
- Identifying and integrating technical upgrades, new systems, and functionalities
- Managing sub-suppliers for performance management, defining maintenance, and optimizing the reliability

Experienced SCADA Consultant with a holistic mindset:
We are looking for a candidate with knowledge within OT/SCADA systems and Cyber Security. You have broad experience working with SCADA, critical OT or IT systems, across the array of different systems used in production environments. Furthermore, you are familiar and used to working with security standards such as ISO270xx, IEC62443, NERC-CIP, or similar. Knowledge of industrial computer networks is an advantage but not a requirement.

Irrespective of your background, you are solution-oriented and like to find smarter and more efficient ways to solve problems. You are motivated by solving problems and finding solutions that work in the real world and not just on paper. Preferably you have experience in project management or experience from a Supervisor position, which has given you commercial awareness and the ability to work independently. Experience in the wind turbine industry will also be considered an advantage.

The ideal candidate is self-driven, proactive, and has a solution-oriented attitude. You are a good communicator with a proven ability to build sound business relationships and represent them in project meetings and presentations. As PEAK Wind is an international company, you need to have good English communication skills.

Experience the Highest Degree of Involvement
PEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity and our values of Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity are materialized through our team members every day. Here you will be able to utilize your financial skills while developing a strong understanding of renewable energy assets. We offer an opportunity to get on board and experience the highest degree of involvement and responsibility in PEAK Wind’s global renewable energy team. Together with the rest of the team, you will play an instrumental part in the continued success of PEAK Wind. Above that, you will participate in an entrepreneurial environment, with a focus on cooperation and a desire to change the status quo. The position will also offer global exposure as our clients work globally.

Interested and want to know more?
If you have any questions or want to know more about the position, please contact People & Development via recruitment@peak-wind.com (recruitment@peak-wind.com) . We look forward to receiving your applications & CVs as soon as possible. Please apply through ‘Apply’ at the bottom of the page. Applications will be assessed on an ongoing basis.

PEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.

jobs.title: Uimaopettaja ja/tai vauva- ja perheuinnin ohjaaja (TURKU)
jobs.description:
Tavallinen työ? Ei ihan.

Etsitkö pientä lisätyötä, jossa jokaisella työtunnilla on aito merkitys ja jossa pääset näkemään tuloksia välittömästi lasten ja perheiden riemuna?

Liikutaan ilosta Oy (GoBabyGo) on toiminut vuodesta 2015 lähtien pidettynä lastenliikunnan tarjoajana Turun alueella.

Tarjoamme monipuolisia uinti- ja liikuntaryhmiä reilusti yli 100 eri viikkotunnilla, ja kanssamme työskentelee ammattitaitoinen, noin 15 hengen ohjaajatiimi.

Meidän sydämenasiamme on luoda turvallisia, opettavaisia ja iloisia liikuntahetkiä vedessä sekä maalla. Kaikki ryhmämme ovat aina alusta loppuun ohjattuja sekä suunniteltuja kokonaisuuksia.

Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden työskennellä viihtyisässä omassa toimipisteessämme Katariinakodissa (Meriläistentie 1, 20740 Turku).

Yksityinen allas on 33 °C lämmin ja syvenee 80–120 cm, mikä takaa täydellisen opetus- ja oppimisympäristön. Taataksemme parhaimman palvelun, pidämme ryhmäkoot pieninä (noin 10 lasta/ryhmä). Ohjattavat ryhmät ovat alkeisuimakoulusta tekniikkauimakouluun.

Lisäksi tuurausmahdollisuuksia on Esikon palvelutalolla (Vähäheikkilä) sekä kylpylähotelli Caribian vauva- ja perheuintiryhmissä.

Haemme nyt yhtä superenergistä aikuista ohjaajaa syyskaudesta 2026 alkaen. Syyskautemme starttaa elokuussa ja merkityksellinen työ voi alkaa tästä!

Sovit loistavasti meille, jos tunnistat itsesi näistä:

Sinulla on noin 3 vuotta työkokemusta alalta ja ohjauskielesi on Suomi.

Työ vaatii vahvaa oma-aloitteisuutta ja taitoa ohjata lapsi- ja perheryhmiä itsenäisesti ja varmasti. Odotammekin, että sinulla on kokemusta työskentelystä lasten kanssa ja kuuluva sekä selkeä ääni.

Sydämellistä asennetta! Olet aina iloinen, energinen ja aidosti lapsirakas aikuinen. Osaat kohdata lapset ja perheet lämpimästi.

Katsomme eduksi SUH:n uimaopettajan koulutuksen.

Arvostamme myös esimerkiksi omaa kilpauintitaustaa ohjauskokemuksen lisäksi sekä voimassa olevaa ensiapukoulutusta (EA-kortti).

Työajat ja palkkaus:

Kyseinen ohjausvuoro sijoittuu yhteen arki-iltaan klo 16.15–19.45, joten työ sopii hyvin esimerkiksi opintojen, äitiysloman tai toisen työn rinnalle.

Tarjoamme joustavat palkkausvaihtoehdot tilanteesi mukaan:

Laskutuksella: 35 € / h (oman yrityksen tai kevytyrittäjäpalvelun kautta)

jobs.description:
Opis poslova: - vodi upravni postupak radi utvrđivanja komunalnog doprinosa te izrađuje rješenja o utvrđivanju komunalnog doprinosa, - vrši obračun komunalnog doprinosa, te vodi evidenciju o obvezama Grada Malog Lošinja prema rješenjima o komunalnom doprinosu, - vodi upravni postupak utvrđivanja komunalne naknade, vrši obračun komunalne naknade i donosi rješenja, vodi evidenciju o obveznicima komunalne naknade, vodi postupke u vezi naknade za uređenje voda te u svezi toga kontinuirano usklađuje izdana rješenja sa stanjem na terenu te pravovremeno zadužuje nove obveznike i vodi knjigovodstvenu evidenciju i ostale poslove u svezi naknade za uređenje voda, - vodi evidenciju obveznika plaćanja komunalne naknade i naknade za uređenje voda te pravovremeno ažurira istu te glede fakturiranja dostavlja podatke u računovodstvo, vrši očevid na terenu te izmjeru površina na licu mjesta glede sređivanja podataka kod utvrđivanja obveze plaćanja komunalne naknade, te izrađuje zapisnike o izvršenoj izmjeri, - surađuje sa svim pravnim subjektima radi utvrđivanja stanja, ažuriranja podataka i olakšavanja postupka identifikacije novih obveznika komunalne naknade, - zaprima zahtjeve, vodi postupke, obrazlaže i predlaže nadležnim tijelima Grada osloboađanje od plaćanja komunalne naknade za pojedine obveznike, vrši obračun i donosi rješenja spomeničke rente Pročelnik Upravnog odjela za komunalni sustavi gospodarstvo Grada Malog Lošinja, temeljem odredbe članka 17. i 19. Zakona o službenicima i namještenicima u lokalnoj i područnoj (regionalnoj) samoupravi ("Narodne novine" broj 86/08, 61/11, 04/18, 112/19, 17/25), raspisuje J A V N I N A T J E Č A J za prijam u službu u Upravni odjel za komunalni sustav i gospodarstvo Grada Malog Lošinja na radno mjesto - viši stručni suradnik za obračun komunalnog doprinosa, komunalne naknade, naknade za uređenje voda i spomeničke rente: 1 izvršitelj / izvršiteljica na neodređeno vrijeme uz obvezni probni rad u trajanju od tri mjeseca Posebni uvjeti: - sveučilišni diplomski studij ili sveučilišni integrirani prijediplomski i diplomski studij ili stručni diplomski studij pravne, ekonomske ili građevinske struke, - najmanje jedna (1) godina radnog iskustva na odgovarajućim poslovima, - položen državni ispit, - poznavanje rada na računalu Osim navedenih posebnih uvjeta, kandidati / kandidatkinje moraju ispunjavati i opće uvjete za prijam u službu utvrđene člankom 12. Zakona o službenicima i namještenicima u lokalnoj i područnoj (regionalnoj) samoupravi (punoljetnost, hrvatsko državljanstvo, zdravstvena sposobnost za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta na koje se osoba prima), a za njihov prijam u službu ne smiju postojati zapreke iz članka 15. i 16. istog Zakona. Na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola. Natjecati se mogu i kandidati / kandidatkinje koji nemaju položen državni ispit uz obvezu da kandidat / kandidatkinja koji bude primljen u službu, ispit položi u zakonskom roku. Ako kandidat / kandidatkinja ostvaruje pravo na prednost pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom zakonu, dužan / dužna je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo, te priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, u kojem slučaju imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate / kandidatkinje samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidati / kandidatkinje koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju na temelju Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“ broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21) i Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata („Narodne novine“ broj 84/21) dužni su u prijavi na oglas pozvati se na to pravo te uz prijavu priložiti propisanu dokumentaciju. Informacije o dokazima koje treba priložiti mogu se naći na internetskoj stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja Republike Hrvatske https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843 na kojoj se nalaze i dodatne informacije o dokazima koji su potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju temeljem gore navedenih zakona. Kandidati / kandidatkinje koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju na temelju članka 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (''Narodne novine'' broj 157/13 i 152/14) dokazuju to javnom ispravom o invaliditetu na temelju koje se osoba može upisati u očevidnik zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom. Za kandidate / kandidatkinje prijavljene na natječaj koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja, provesti će se prethodna provjera znanja i sposobnosti putem pisanog testiranja i intervjua. Ako pozvani kandidat / kandidatkinja ne pristupi testiranju i/ili intervjuu, smatrati će se da je povukao / povukla prijavu na natječaj. Na web-stranici Grada Malog Lošinja: www.mali-losinj.hr, objaviti će se opis poslova i podaci o plaći radnog mjesta koje se popunjava, način i vrijeme obavljanja prethodne provjere znanja i sposobnosti kandidata / kandidatkinja, područja provjere te pravni i drugi izvori za pripremanje kandidata / kandidatkinja za tu provjeru. Na istoj web-stranici te na oglasnoj ploči Grada Malog Lošinja na adresi u Malom Lošinju, Riva lošinjskih kapetana 7, objaviti će se vrijeme održavanja prethodne provjere znanja i sposobnosti kandidata / kandidatkinja, najmanje 5 dana prije održavanja provjere. Kandidati / kandidatkinje obvezni su uz prijavu priložiti:
  • životopis,
  • dokaz o ispunjavanju uvjeta stupnja obrazovanja (stručne spreme) i struke određene ovim natječajem,
  • dokaz o hrvatskom državljanstvu (preslik domovnice ili osobne iskaznice), odnosno za osobe sa stranim državljanstvom ili osobe bez državljanstva dokaz o ispunjavanju uvjeta propisanih posebnim zakonom i prethodno odobrenje središnjeg tijela državne uprave nadležnog za službeničke odnose presliku dokaza o državljanstvu (osobne iskaznice, putovnice ili domovnice),
  • dokaz o radnom stažu (elektronički zapis o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje),
  • dokaz o traženom radnom iskustvu od najmanje 1 godine na odgovarajućim poslovima (potvrda dosadašnjih poslodavaca o vrsti poslova i trajanju radnog odnosa, preslika ugovora o radu, rješenja i sl. iz kojih mora biti vidljivo ostvareno radno iskustvo na poslovima tražene stručne spreme i struke),
  • ukoliko kandidati / kandidatkinje imaju položen državni ispit dužni su dostaviti dokaz o položenom državnom stručnom ispitu (preslik uvjerenja odnosno svjedodžbe)
  • uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata / kandidatkinje ne vodi kazneni postupak (ne starije od 3 mjeseca),
  • vlastoručno potpisanu izjavu da ne postoje zapreke iz članaka 15. i 16. ZSN-a, i da poznaje rad na računalu.
Pisane prijave na natječaj, vlastoručno potpisane od strane podnositelja prijave, s navedenom kontakt adresom, telefonskim brojem i e-mail adresom, te s dokazima o ispunjavanju uvjeta, podnose se u roku od 8 dana od dana objave natječaja u Narodnim novinama, preporučeno putem pošte ili osobno na adresu: Grad Mali Lošinj, Mali Lošinj, Riva lošinjskih kapetana 7, s naznakom «Natječaj za prijam u službu u Upravni odjel za komunalni sustav i gospodarstvo Grada Malog Lošinja“». Osoba koja ne podnese pravodobnu i/ili urednu prijavu ili za koju se utvrdi da ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja, neće se smatrati kandidatom / kandidatkinjom prijavljenim na javni natječaj. Urednom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u natječaju. O rezultatima natječaja kandidati / kandidatkinje biti će obaviješteni u zakonskom roku.

jobs.title: BIROJA ADMINISTRATORS
jobs.description:
COBELEC PS (reģ. nr. 40203663858) ir Latvijā reģistrēts uzņēmums, kas apvieno divu pasaules līmeņa infrastruktūras gigantu — Cobra un Elecnor — zināšanas un pieredzi. Mūsu galvenais mērķis ir sniegt izcilību enerģētikas un transporta infrastruktūras projektos, šobrīd koncentrējoties uz vēsturiski nozīmīgā Rail Baltica projekta īstenošanu. Mēs apvienojam starptautisku vērienu ar vietējo izpildi, piedāvājot profesionāļiem iespēju strādāt pie tehnoloģiski sarežģītiem un ilgtspējīgiem risinājumiem. Pievienojieties mums, lai veidotu nākotnes savienojumus un kļūtu par daļu no komandas, kas maina Eiropas mobilitātes ainavu.

Meklējam proaktīvu un organizētu Biroja administratoru/-i, kurš/-a spēj veiksmīgi koordinēt biroja ikdienas procesus, pārvaldīt vairākus uzdevumus vienlaikus un nodrošināt efektīvu biroja darbību. Šī loma ir piemērota cilvēkam, kuram patīk dinamiska darba vide, komunikācija ar dažādām iesaistītajām pusēm un darbs starptautiskā komandā. Ņemot vērā projekta ietvaru un paredzamo ilgumu, šis amats tiek piedāvāts kā noteikta termiņa līgums uz 2 gadiem, ar iespēju to pagarināt.

Galvenie pienākumi:
